q_en: What is AIGQ, in one sentence?
q_zh: AIGQ 一句话是什么？
gold_en: Taobao's AIGQ fine-tunes a 30B MoE LLM with list-level SFT and GRPO to generate homepage HintQ queries, served nearline; 30-day A/B: attributed GMV +10.68%, orders +10.31%.
gold_zh: 淘宝 AIGQ 用列表级 SFT 和 GRPO 微调 30B MoE 大模型，生成首页 HintQ 的 query，并以准实时方式提供服务；30 天 A/B：归因 GMV +10.68%，订单 +10.31%。

q_en: Who built AIGQ and where does it run?
q_zh: AIGQ 是谁做的，用在哪里？
gold_en: AIGQ comes from Alibaba Taobao & Tmall Group, 2026. Deployed in: Taobao homepage HintQ pre-search query box, as a recall source.
gold_zh: AIGQ 来自 阿里巴巴淘天集团，2026 年。上线位置：淘宝首页 HintQ 搜索前 query 框，作为召回源。

q_en: What is the core idea of AIGQ?
q_zh: AIGQ 的核心思路是什么？
gold_en: A fine-tuned LLM generates personalized query lists, run nearline and distilled into a real-time trigger index.
gold_zh: 微调后的大模型生成个性化 query 列表，以准实时方式运行，并蒸馏成实时触发词索引。

q_en: What results does AIGQ report?
q_zh: AIGQ 报告了哪些结果？
gold_en: Online 30-day A/B in the HintQ scenario: attributed GMV +10.68%, attributed orders +10.31%, HintQ UCTR +7.42%, 7-day retention +3.73%, search UV +0.20%; 79.3% of queries and 37.3% of leaf categories from AIGQ are not covered by other channels. Offline on a Taobao test set, Cate HR@30 is 0.4704 for the think variant after IL-GRPO against 0.1998 for the production two-tower EBR, and Query HR@30 is 0.0745 against 0.0100.
gold_zh: HintQ 场景 30 天线上 A/B：归因 GMV +10.68%，归因订单 +10.31%，HintQ UCTR +7.42%，7 日留存 +3.73%，搜索 UV +0.20%；AIGQ 产出的 query 中，79.3% 以及叶子类目中的 37.3% 没有被其他渠道覆盖。淘宝测试集上的离线结果：think 变体经 IL-GRPO 后 Cate HR@30 为 0.4704，线上双塔 EBR 为 0.1998；Query HR@30 为 0.0745，对比 0.0100。

q_en: Does AIGQ have online evidence, and how long was the A/B?
q_zh: AIGQ 有线上证据吗，A/B 做了多久？
gold_en: Online evidence: Online numbers. A/B duration: 30 days. A/B traffic: not reported.
gold_zh: 线上证据：有线上数据。A/B 时长：30 天。A/B 流量：未报告。

q_en: What should I keep in mind when reading the results of AIGQ?
q_zh: 读 AIGQ 的结果时要注意什么？
gold_en: The paper does not name the A/B control group or traffic share; the gains are described as relative gains in the online HintQ system. Real-time generation is not used; personalization from the nearline cache lags behind the latest behavior until the next visit.
gold_zh: 论文没有说明 A/B 的对照组和流量占比；这些收益被描述为线上 HintQ 系统中的相对提升。 没有使用实时生成；准实时缓存带来的个性化会滞后于最新行为，要到用户下次访问才会更新。

q_en: What inputs does AIGQ use?
q_zh: AIGQ 用了哪些输入？
gold_en: IDs and tokenization: No semantic IDs; the LLM generates query text directly. Input signals: User historical behavior sequence; User profile attributes such as age, gender and city; Context such as weather and season; Online CTR ranking model score as a reward signal.
gold_zh: ID 与 token 化：不使用 Semantic ID；大模型直接生成 query 文本。 输入特征：用户历史行为序列；用户画像属性，如年龄、性别和城市；上下文，如天气和季节；线上 CTR 排序模型的分数，作为奖励信号。

q_en: What does the source of AIGQ not report?
q_zh: AIGQ 的原文有哪些没有报告？
gold_en: The source does not report: A/B control and traffic share; production QPS; PPU hardware count; number of cache runs kept per user.
gold_zh: 原文没有报告：A/B 对照组和流量占比；线上 QPS；PPU 硬件数量；每个用户保留的缓存次数。

q_en: What is CAPTS, in one sentence?
q_zh: CAPTS 一句话是什么？
gold_en: Kuaishou's CAPTS learns which history items should seed each item-to-item retrieval channel; in the Kwai online A/B it gave total app time spent +0.713% and average app time spent per device +0.586%.
gold_zh: 快手的 CAPTS 学习该用哪些历史 item 去驱动各个 item 到 item 召回通道；在 Kwai 线上 A/B 中总 App 使用时长 +0.713%，每台设备平均 App 使用时长 +0.586%。

q_en: Who built CAPTS and where does it run?
q_zh: CAPTS 是谁做的，用在哪里？
gold_en: CAPTS comes from Kuaishou, 2026. Deployed in: Kwai short-video feed, trigger selection for 4 I2I channels.
gold_zh: CAPTS 来自 快手，2026 年。上线位置：Kwai 短视频信息流，为 4 个 I2I 通道选触发 item。

q_en: What is the core idea of CAPTS?
q_zh: CAPTS 的核心思路是什么？
gold_en: Credit each history item by the watch time of the items it would retrieve, then route items to the channels where they add the most.
gold_zh: 按触发 item 能召回的内容所带来的观看时长给它打分，再把它路由到最能增加增量的通道。

q_en: What results does CAPTS report?
q_zh: CAPTS 报告了哪些结果？
gold_en: Offline on Kwai-Industrial, overall Recall@K over 3 I2I channels: CAPTS reaches R@100 0.0255, R@500 0.0963, R@1000 0.1519 and R@2000 0.1994, which is +25.0%, +17.9%, +13.8% and +10.7% relative to the best baseline at each K. Online, in a large-scale A/B on Kwai with 4 I2I channels, CAPTS against the incumbent rule-based policy: daily active devices +0.115%, total app time spent +0.713%, average app time spent per device +0.586%, total video watch time +0.506% and average watch time per device +0.395%. The summed exposure share of the four I2I channels rises from 26.24% to 27.55%. The paper says the localized change has also supported deployment in the Kwai e-commerce recommendation scenario.
gold_zh: 离线，在 Kwai-Industrial 上，对 3 个 I2I 通道合并后的 Recall@K：CAPTS 的 R@100 为 0.0255，R@500 为 0.0963，R@1000 为 0.1519，R@2000 为 0.1994，相对每个 K 下最好的基线分别提升 +25.0%、+17.9%、+13.8% 和 +10.7%。线上，在 Kwai 做了大规模 A/B，开 4 个 I2I 通道，CAPTS 对比现有的规则策略：日活设备 +0.115%，总 App 使用时长 +0.713%，每台设备平均 App 使用时长 +0.586%，视频总观看时长 +0.506%，每台设备平均观看时长 +0.395%。4 个 I2I 通道的曝光占比合计从 26.24% 升到 27.55%。论文称这一局部改动也支撑了 Kwai 电商推荐场景的部署。

q_en: Does CAPTS have online evidence, and how long was the A/B?
q_zh: CAPTS 有线上证据吗，A/B 做了多久？
gold_en: Online evidence: Online numbers. A/B duration: not reported. A/B traffic: not reported.
gold_zh: 线上证据：有线上数据。A/B 时长：未报告。A/B 流量：未报告。

q_en: What should I keep in mind when reading the results of CAPTS?
q_zh: 读 CAPTS 的结果时要注意什么？
gold_en: CAPTS is a trigger-selection module in front of existing retrievers, so it is narrower than a full retrieval system; the full pipeline is shown only at the level of Figure 4. The A/B duration, traffic share and number of users are not given in the paper.
gold_zh: CAPTS 是放在现有召回器之前的触发 item 选择模块，范围比完整的召回系统窄；完整流水线只在图 4 的层面上展示。 论文没有给出 A/B 的时长、流量占比和用户数。

q_en: What serving latency, QPS, cost or hardware does CAPTS report?
q_zh: CAPTS 报告了怎样的服务延迟、QPS、成本和硬件？
gold_en: Serving latency: not reported. Serving QPS: not reported. Inference cost: Online scoring covers 10^2 to 10^3 recent candidates and a nearline cache covers 10^3 to 10^4 long-term candidates; the paper says only lightweight scoring, routing and cache lookup are added. Hardware: not reported.
gold_zh: 服务延迟：未报告。 服务 QPS：未报告。 推理成本：在线对 10^2 到 10^3 个近期候选打分，近线缓存覆盖 10^3 到 10^4 个长期候选；论文称只增加了轻量的打分、路由和缓存查询。 硬件：未报告。

q_en: How is CAPTS trained?
q_zh: CAPTS 是怎么训练的？
gold_en: Training mode: Offline training on replayed logs, with periodic weight synchronization to serving. Objectives: Weighted binary cross-entropy on the per-channel value label; Intensity-aware calibration loss; Diversity loss on the uniqueness head, with weights lambda and mu.
gold_zh: 训练方式：在重放日志上离线训练，并定期把权重同步到线上服务。 训练目标：针对每个通道价值标签的加权二元交叉熵；感知强度的校准损失；独特性头上的多样性损失，权重为 lambda 和 mu。

q_en: What is CQ-SID, in one sentence?
q_zh: CQ-SID 一句话是什么？
gold_en: Taobao's CQ-SID turns semantic IDs into category-constrained cluster identifiers and aligns recall with ranking via EG-GRPO; two-week TmallAPP A/B: GMV +1.15%, UCTCVR +0.40%.
gold_zh: 淘宝 CQ-SID 把语义 ID 做成带类目约束的聚类标识并用 EG-GRPO 对齐召回与排序；天猫 App 两周 A/B：GMV +1.15%，UCTCVR +0.40%。

q_en: Who built CQ-SID and where does it run?
q_zh: CQ-SID 是谁做的，用在哪里？
gold_en: CQ-SID comes from Alibaba Taobao & Tmall Group, 2026. Deployed in: TmallAPP search recall stage, generative recall supplement channel among multi-channel retrieval.
gold_zh: CQ-SID 来自 阿里巴巴淘天集团，2026 年。上线位置：天猫 App 搜索召回阶段，多路召回中的生成式补充通道。

q_en: What is the core idea of CQ-SID?
q_zh: CQ-SID 的核心思路是什么？
gold_en: Treat semantic IDs as hierarchical cluster identifiers shaped by category constraints and query-item contrastive learning, then align recall with downstream ranking through expert-guided reinforcement learning.
gold_zh: 把语义 ID 当作层级聚类标识，用类目约束与 query-item 对比学习塑形，再以专家引导强化学习把召回与下游排序对齐。

q_en: Does CQ-SID have online evidence, and how long was the A/B?
q_zh: CQ-SID 有线上证据吗，A/B 做了多久？
gold_en: Online evidence: Online numbers. A/B duration: Two weeks. A/B traffic: not reported.
gold_zh: 线上证据：有线上数据。A/B 时长：两周。A/B 流量：未报告。

q_en: What should I keep in mind when reading the results of CQ-SID?
q_zh: 读 CQ-SID 的结果时要注意什么？
gold_en: Sec 4.2.2 states the offline top-1K truncation differs from the actual online recall process, which employs coarse-ranking truncation. Sec 4.4 explains the small RL gains: SFT already leaves narrow headroom for refinement, hitrate is a binary metric, and EG-GRPO must navigate a trade-off between click and exposure.
gold_zh: 4.2.2 节说明离线 top-1K 截断与线上实际采用粗排截断的召回流程不同。 4.4 节解释 RL 增益较小：SFT 后已无多少提升空间，命中率是二元指标，EG-GRPO 还需在点击与曝光之间权衡。

q_en: Which stages of the pipeline does CQ-SID cover?
q_zh: CQ-SID 覆盖链路的哪些阶段？
gold_en: Retrieval: Qwen2.5-0.5B autoregressive generative retriever decoding semantic cluster IDs with beam search.
gold_zh: 召回：Qwen2.5-0.5B 自回归生成式检索器，beam search 解码语义聚类 ID。

q_en: What scale does CQ-SID report?
q_zh: CQ-SID 报告了哪些规模信息？
gold_en: Item pool: approximately 21 million items filtered from a corpus of hundreds of millions, updated daily. Training data: CQ-SID quantizer 37.5M samples; LLM stages 21.0M Item2SID, 90.3M Query2SID, 73.7M personalized UQ2SID. Serving: over 200 QPS across 8 GPUs, 99.9% availability, approximately 40 ms average end-to-end latency. Channel contribution: 50.25% of all exposures, 58.96% of all clicks, 72.63% of all purchases.
gold_zh: 物品池：从数亿语料过滤出约 2100 万物品，每日更新。 训练数据：CQ-SID 量化器 37.5M 样本；LLM 阶段 Item2SID 21.0M、Query2SID 90.3M、个性化 UQ2SID 73.7M。 线上服务：8 块 GPU 承载超过 200 QPS，可用性 99.9%，平均端到端延迟约 40 毫秒。 通道贡献：占全部曝光 50.25%、全部点击 58.96%、全部购买 72.63%。

q_en: What serving latency, QPS, cost or hardware does CQ-SID report?
q_zh: CQ-SID 报告了怎样的服务延迟、QPS、成本和硬件？
gold_en: Serving latency: Approximately 40 ms average end-to-end latency. Serving QPS: Over 200 QPS. Inference cost: Beam search with dynamic beam sizes in [20, 50, 100]; offline, cluster SIDs cut beam search size by more than half at comparable recall. Hardware: 8 GPUs for online serving.
gold_zh: 服务延迟：平均端到端延迟约 40 毫秒。 服务 QPS：超过 200 QPS。 推理成本：beam search 配 [20, 50, 100] 动态 beam；离线同等召回下聚类 SID 把 beam search 规模削减一半以上。 硬件：8 块 GPU 用于线上服务。

q_en: What is DPGR, in one sentence?
q_zh: DPGR 一句话是什么？
gold_en: Meituan's DPGR is an HSTU-based generative retriever over Dianping content and POI actions; 7-day 15% A/B vs the two-tower: POI collects +5.209%, content views +1.486%.
gold_zh: 美团 DPGR 是基于 HSTU 的生成式召回模型，覆盖大众点评内容和 POI 行为；对比双塔做 7 天 15% A/B：POI 收藏 +5.209%，内容浏览 +1.486%。

q_en: Who built DPGR and where does it run?
q_zh: DPGR 是谁做的，用在哪里？
gold_en: DPGR comes from Meituan, 2026. Deployed in: Dianping homepage feed and immersive video stream, retrieval stage, tested on 15% of traffic.
gold_zh: DPGR 来自 美团，2026 年。上线位置：大众点评首页信息流和沉浸式视频流，召回阶段，在 15% 流量上测试。

q_en: What is the core idea of DPGR?
q_zh: DPGR 的核心思路是什么？
gold_en: An HSTU sequence model predicts discrete intent codes, and each code issues its own ANN query.
gold_zh: HSTU 序列模型预测离散意图码，每个意图码各自发起一次 ANN 查询。

q_en: What results does DPGR report?
q_zh: DPGR 报告了哪些结果？
gold_en: Online A/B, 7 days on a 15% random bucket against the production discriminative two-tower retriever, cumulative over three rollout stages, all p < 0.05: content views +1.486%, content watch time +1.015%, POI clicks +0.527%, POI collects +5.209%. Stage 1 with the plain HSTU backbone gave +0.493% content views and +3.226% POI collects; stage 2 with state conditioning gave +1.103% and +3.314%. Offline on the internal Dianping set, Recall@200 is 0.6594 for DPGR with three intents, 0.4777 for one intent, 0.3517 for TBGRecall, 0.3206 for HSTU and 0.0415 for DSSM. On public KuaiRand-Pure, Recall@100 is 0.3265 for DPGR against 0.3184 for HSTU.
gold_zh: 线上 A/B：在 15% 随机分桶上对比线上判别式双塔召回，持续 7 天，三个上线阶段累计，全部 p < 0.05：内容浏览 +1.486%，内容观看时长 +1.015%，POI 点击 +0.527%，POI 收藏 +5.209%。第 1 阶段使用普通 HSTU 骨干，内容浏览 +0.493%，POI 收藏 +3.226%；第 2 阶段加入状态条件后，分别为 +1.103% 和 +3.314%。大众点评内部数据集上的离线结果：Recall@200，三意图的 DPGR 为 0.6594，单意图为 0.4777，TBGRecall 为 0.3517，HSTU 为 0.3206，DSSM 为 0.0415。公开数据集 KuaiRand-Pure 上，Recall@100，DPGR 为 0.3265，HSTU 为 0.3184。

q_en: Does DPGR have online evidence, and how long was the A/B?
q_zh: DPGR 有线上证据吗，A/B 做了多久？
gold_en: Online evidence: Online numbers. A/B duration: 7 days. A/B traffic: 15% random traffic bucket.
gold_zh: 线上证据：有线上数据。A/B 时长：7 天。A/B 流量：15% 随机流量分桶。

q_en: What should I keep in mind when reading the results of DPGR?
q_zh: 读 DPGR 的结果时要注意什么？
gold_en: The online gains are cumulative over three rollout stages against a two-tower control, so they mix the generative backbone, state conditioning and multi-intent generation. The offline evidence is mainly an internal dataset; the public KuaiRand-Pure set lacks content, POI and spatiotemporal signals.
gold_zh: 线上收益是对比双塔对照组、三个上线阶段累计的结果，因此混合了生成式骨干、状态条件和多意图生成的贡献。 离线证据主要来自内部数据集；公开的 KuaiRand-Pure 数据集缺少内容、POI 和时空信号。

q_en: What inputs does DPGR use?
q_zh: DPGR 用了哪些输入？
gold_en: IDs and tokenization: Discrete intent codes learned by quantizing dual-domain behaviors, codebook size 256. Input signals: Content interactions on notes, videos and reviews; POI interactions such as collects and check-ins; Domain type and action type per interaction; Spatiotemporal context of scene, time slot, location and travel state.
gold_zh: ID 与 token 化：通过量化双域行为学到的离散意图码，码本大小 256。 输入特征：对笔记、视频和点评的内容交互；POI 交互，如收藏和打卡；每个交互的域类型和行为类型；由场景、时段、位置和出行状态构成的时空上下文。

q_en: What does the source of DPGR not report?
q_zh: DPGR 的原文有哪些没有报告？
gold_en: The source does not report: GPU count; traffic share beyond the 15% bucket per experiment; whether the A/B led to full launch.
gold_zh: 原文没有报告：GPU 数量；每次实验在 15% 分桶之外的流量占比；A/B 之后是否全量上线。

q_en: What is DTE, in one sentence?
q_zh: DTE 一句话是什么？
gold_en: DTE splits time in a generative ranker into user-adaptive rhythms and a dense-order gate; a three-week Shangou A/B shows CTR +1.8% and RPM +3.0% with +0.3% latency.
gold_zh: DTE 把生成式排序器里的时间拆成用户自适应节律和密集顺序门控；三周闪购 A/B 显示 CTR +1.8%、RPM +3.0%，延迟 +0.3%。

q_en: Who built DTE and where does it run?
q_zh: DTE 是谁做的，用在哪里？
gold_en: DTE comes from Ele.me / Taobao Shangou, 2026. Deployed in: Shangou advertisement ranking in the Taobao App, full traffic since January 2026.
gold_zh: DTE 来自 饿了么 / 淘宝闪购，2026 年。上线位置：淘宝 App 闪购广告排序，自 2026 年一月起全量流量。

q_en: What is the core idea of DTE?
q_zh: DTE 的核心思路是什么？
gold_en: Encode user-adaptive temporal rhythms into item embeddings and gate a relative-order bias by time gap, giving a generative ranker both signals for 238 extra parameters.
gold_zh: 把用户自适应的时间节律编码进物品嵌入，并按时间间隔门控相对顺序偏置，让生成式排序器以 238 个额外参数同时获得两类信号。

q_en: What results does DTE report?
q_zh: DTE 报告了哪些结果？
gold_en: Offline on the industrial Shangou dataset DTE reaches GAUC 0.7098 and Logloss 0.2578, against 0.6982 and 0.2589 for BST+ALiBi, which Table 2 labels the production baseline, and 0.6978 for RAB, Table 2; on KuaiRand it reaches GAUC 0.9243 and Logloss 0.2972 against 0.9113 for RAB. Ablation on the industrial dataset, Table 3: removing the macro module drops GAUC to 0.6852, the micro module to 0.7006, recency to 0.6991, periodicity to 0.6975, the burst term to 0.7017 and the soft gate to 0.6987. Overhead, Table 4: DTE adds 238 parameters, 0.47 KB in FP16, with offline inference latency 3.02 ms, against 256 parameters and 3.09 ms for RAB, 9600 parameters and 3.18 ms for BST, and 327680 parameters and 3.76 ms for TiSASRec. A three-week online A/B with 20% treatment and 20% control user buckets reports CTR +1.8% and RPM +3.0% over the production baseline, significant at p < 0.01 with two-sided tests, while average serving latency rose +0.3% from 15.4 ms to 15.5 ms. DTE was then rolled out to 100% of the Shangou advertisement recommendation traffic in the Taobao App in January 2026, and no systematic regression was observed after the rollout.
gold_zh: 工业闪购数据集离线结果，DTE 达到 GAUC 0.7098、Logloss 0.2578，表 2 标为生产基线的 BST+ALiBi 为 0.6982 和 0.2589，RAB 为 0.6978，见表 2；KuaiRand 上 DTE 达到 GAUC 0.9243、Logloss 0.2972，RAB 为 0.9113。工业数据集消融，表 3：去掉宏观模块 GAUC 降到 0.6852，去掉微观模块到 0.7006，去掉近因到 0.6991，去掉周期到 0.6975，去掉突发项到 0.7017，去掉软门控到 0.6987。开销，表 4：DTE 增加 238 个参数、FP16 下 0.47 KB，离线推理延迟 3.02 ms；RAB 为 256 个参数、3.09 ms，BST 为 9600 个参数、3.18 ms，TiSASRec 为 327680 个参数、3.76 ms。20% 实验桶加 20% 对照桶的三周线上 A/B 报告 CTR +1.8%、RPM +3.0%，优于生产基线，双侧检验 p < 0.01 显著，平均服务延迟 +0.3%，从 15.4 ms 升到 15.5 ms。随后 DTE 于 2026 年一月在淘宝 App 闪购广告推荐流量上 100% 上线，上线后未观察到系统性回退。

q_en: Does DTE have online evidence, and how long was the A/B?
q_zh: DTE 有线上证据吗，A/B 做了多久？
gold_en: Online evidence: Online numbers. A/B duration: Three weeks, covering multiple complete weekly cycles. A/B traffic: User-level randomization with a 20% treatment bucket and a 20% control bucket under the same serving pipeline.
gold_zh: 线上证据：有线上数据。A/B 时长：三周，覆盖多个完整周周期。A/B 流量：用户级随机化，同一服务管线下 20% 实验桶加 20% 对照桶。

q_en: What should I keep in mind when reading the results of DTE?
q_zh: 读 DTE 的结果时要注意什么？
gold_en: Table 2 labels BST+ALiBi the production baseline offline; the online A/B baseline is described only as the production baseline, and the paper does not say the two are identical. Efficiency figures are offline inference latency under the paper setup; serving cost appears only as the +0.3% average latency change, and serving QPS and hardware are not reported.
gold_zh: 离线表 2 把 BST+ALiBi 标为生产基线；线上 A/B 只说对照是生产基线，论文没说两者是同一个。 效率数字是论文设置下的离线推理延迟；服务成本只以 +0.3% 平均延迟变化呈现，未报告服务 QPS 和硬件。

q_en: What inputs does DTE use?
q_zh: DTE 用了哪些输入？
gold_en: IDs and tokenization: Plain item ID embeddings; no semantic IDs and no item tokenizer. Input signals: Interaction timestamps: time gap to the current prediction, hour of day and weekday, as temporal primitives; Target-side traffic statistics per time segment, previous-day value and 30-day historical average, for the burst term; Average-pooled user history embedding, the input of the gating MLP that personalizes the temporal mixture.
gold_zh: ID 与 token 化：普通物品 ID 嵌入；无 Semantic ID，也无物品 tokenizer。 输入特征：交互时间戳：距当前预测的时间间隔、小时内时刻和星期几，作为时间基元；按时间段的目标侧流量统计：前一日取值和 30 天历史均值，用于突发项；用户历史平均池化嵌入，是门控 MLP 的输入，用于个性化时间混合权重。

q_en: What does the source of DTE not report?
q_zh: DTE 的原文有哪些没有报告？
gold_en: The source does not report: Serving QPS; Training compute and hardware; Exact A/B dates and confidence intervals; Whether the online A/B baseline is the same BST+ALiBi encoding labeled production baseline in Table 2; Serving hardware.
gold_zh: 原文没有报告：服务 QPS；训练算力与硬件；A/B 起止日期与置信区间；线上 A/B 对照是否就是表 2 中标为生产基线的 BST+ALiBi；服务硬件。

q_en: What is DeGRe, in one sentence?
q_zh: DeGRe 一句话是什么？
gold_en: Taobao Shangou's DeGRe distills offline lookahead search into a greedy generative re-ranker; 8-day 2% A/B on Flash Shopping vs the base strategy: GMV +3.75%, orders +2.14%.
gold_zh: 淘宝闪购 DeGRe 把离线前瞻搜索蒸馏进贪心式生成式重排模型；闪购上对比基础策略做 8 天 2% A/B：GMV +3.75%，订单 +2.14%。

q_en: Who built DeGRe and where does it run?
q_zh: DeGRe 是谁做的，用在哪里？
gold_en: DeGRe comes from Alibaba Taobao Shangou, 2026. Deployed in: Taobao Flash Shopping homepage re-ranking, tested on 2% of traffic.
gold_zh: DeGRe 来自 阿里巴巴淘宝闪购，2026 年。上线位置：淘宝闪购首页重排，在 2% 流量上测试。

q_en: What is the core idea of DeGRe?
q_zh: DeGRe 的核心思路是什么？
gold_en: Offline lookahead search is distilled into a small generator that re-ranks in one greedy pass.
gold_zh: 把离线前瞻搜索蒸馏进小型生成器，一次贪心遍历完成重排。

q_en: What results does DeGRe report?
q_zh: DeGRe 报告了哪些结果？
gold_en: Online 8-day A/B on 2% of Taobao Flash Shopping homepage traffic against the base multi-objective point-wise strategy: CTR +2.85%, orders +2.14%, GMV +3.75%, with PRM at +0.73%, +1.14% and +0.76%. Added latency is 14.8 ms for DeGRe and 6.2 ms for PRM. On Alipay traffic, GMV rises 4.14% and orders 3.39%. For new users GMV rises 2.72% and for existing users 3.73%. Offline generator HR@1% with beam size 8 is 88.72% on Flash Shopping, 71.06% on Taobao Ad and 89.10% on ML-1M, absolute gains of 53.19%, 28.95% and 29.90% over the best baseline.
gold_zh: 在淘宝闪购首页 2% 流量上做 8 天线上 A/B，对比多目标 point-wise 基础策略：CTR +2.85%，订单 +2.14%，GMV +3.75%，PRM 分别为 +0.73%、+1.14% 和 +0.76%。增加的延迟：DeGRe 为 14.8 ms，PRM 为 6.2 ms。在支付宝流量上，GMV 提升 4.14%，订单提升 3.39%。新用户 GMV 提升 2.72%，老用户提升 3.73%。离线生成器在 beam size 为 8 时的 HR@1%：闪购为 88.72%，Taobao Ad 为 71.06%，ML-1M 为 89.10%，相比最强基线的绝对提升分别为 53.19%、28.95% 和 29.90%。

q_en: Does DeGRe have online evidence, and how long was the A/B?
q_zh: DeGRe 有线上证据吗，A/B 做了多久？
gold_en: Online evidence: Online numbers. A/B duration: 8 days. A/B traffic: 2% of live traffic.
gold_zh: 线上证据：有线上数据。A/B 时长：8 天。A/B 流量：2% 线上流量。

q_en: What should I keep in mind when reading the results of DeGRe?
q_zh: 读 DeGRe 的结果时要注意什么？
gold_en: The online control is a base point-wise strategy, and the only generative or list-wise online baseline is PRM, a discriminative reranker; no other generative reranker was tested online. Offline hit rate is measured by a learned external evaluator on sampled permutations, so it is a model-based proxy, not logged user behavior.
gold_zh: 线上对照组是基础 point-wise 策略，而线上唯一的生成式或 list-wise 基线是判别式重排模型 PRM；没有在线上测试其他生成式重排模型。 离线命中率由一个学习得到的外部评估器在采样排列上测得，因此是基于模型的代理指标，不是真实的用户行为日志。

q_en: What serving latency, QPS, cost or hardware does DeGRe report?
q_zh: DeGRe 报告了怎样的服务延迟、QPS、成本和硬件？
gold_en: Serving latency: Mean added latency of 14.8 ms, against 6.2 ms for the PRM baseline. Serving QPS: not reported. Inference cost: not reported. Hardware: Models implemented on NVIDIA A100 80GB GPUs; serving hardware not reported.
gold_zh: 服务延迟：平均增加延迟 14.8 ms，PRM 基线为 6.2 ms。 服务 QPS：未报告。 推理成本：未报告。 硬件：模型在 NVIDIA A100 80GB GPU 上实现；在线服务硬件未报告。

q_en: How is DeGRe trained?
q_zh: DeGRe 是怎么训练的？
gold_en: Training mode: Offline training with leave-one-out split on the last user session. Objectives: Cumulative regression for the Lookahead Evaluator; Hard-label imitation of mined sequences plus soft-label distillation weighted 0.01.
gold_zh: 训练方式：离线训练，以用户最后一次会话做 leave-one-out 划分。 训练目标：Lookahead Evaluator 的累计回归；对挖掘序列的硬标签模仿，加上权重为 0.01 的软标签蒸馏。

q_en: What is FLUID, in one sentence?
q_zh: FLUID 一句话是什么？
gold_en: ByteDance's FLUID drops the item ID from a production livestreaming ranker, using multimodal semantic codes instead; A/B gives Quality Watch Duration +0.55% and Cold-Start Room Views +2.05%.
gold_zh: 字节的 FLUID 把生产直播排序模型里的 item ID 去掉，换成多模态语义编码；A/B 下优质观看时长 +0.55%，冷启动直播间曝光 +2.05%。

q_en: Who built FLUID and where does it run?
q_zh: FLUID 是谁做的，用在哪里？
gold_en: FLUID comes from ByteDance, 2026. Deployed in: ByteDance livestreaming ranking, over one billion combined users.
gold_zh: FLUID 来自 字节跳动，2026 年。上线位置：字节跳动直播排序，合计用户超过 10 亿。

q_en: What is the core idea of FLUID?
q_zh: FLUID 的核心思路是什么？
gold_en: Retire the candidate item ID in a livestreaming ranker and let discrete multimodal LUCID codes, added by staged warmup, play its role.
gold_zh: 去掉直播排序模型里候选侧的 item ID，用分阶段预热加入的离散多模态 LUCID 编码来承担它的角色。

q_en: What results does FLUID report?
q_zh: FLUID 报告了哪些结果？
gold_en: Online A/B against the production baseline, arms +Slice, -ID and FLUID. FLUID: Quality Watch Duration +0.55%, Quality Watch Session +0.51%, Cold-Start Room Views +2.05%, Niche Room Views +2.87%, Unique Watched Tags +1.63%, Stay Duration +0.07%, Active Hours +0.05%. +Slice gives +0.43% Quality Watch Duration and +1.15% Cold-Start Room Views with retention not significant; removing the item ID alone gives -0.02% Quality Watch Duration, +1.58% Cold-Start Room Views and -0.05% Stay Duration. Offline CTR AUC is 0.7784 for the baseline, 0.7801 with slice LUCID, 0.7748 without item ID and 0.7802 for FLUID, with logloss 0.1264, 0.1263, 0.1273 and 0.1262. Prefix n-gram embedding gives AUC 0.7802 against 0.7793 for level-wise decoding, and independent slice and room tables 0.7802 against 0.7798 for a shared table. Early fusion variants change AUC by -0.13% to +0.01%, and naive joint training +0.00%. The staged warmup gives +0.22%, +0.11% and +0.23% AUC at stages one to three. On the encoder, Live Q2I R@10 rises from 43.96 for CLIP-B/32 plus Albert-V2 to 47.44 with Qwen3-Embedding and SigLIP2.
gold_zh: 对比线上基线的 A/B，三个实验组为 +Slice、-ID 和 FLUID。FLUID：优质观看时长 +0.55%，优质观看场次 +0.51%，冷启动直播间曝光 +2.05%，小众直播间曝光 +2.87%，去重观看标签数 +1.63%，停留时长 +0.07%，活跃时长 +0.05%。+Slice 的优质观看时长 +0.43%，冷启动直播间曝光 +1.15%，留存不显著；只去掉 item ID 时，优质观看时长 -0.02%，冷启动直播间曝光 +1.58%，停留时长 -0.05%。离线 CTR AUC：基线 0.7784，加切片 LUCID 为 0.7801，去掉 item ID 为 0.7748，FLUID 为 0.7802，对应的 logloss 为 0.1264、0.1263、0.1273 和 0.1262。前缀 n-gram embedding 的 AUC 为 0.7802，逐层解码为 0.7793；独立的切片表和直播间表为 0.7802，共享表为 0.7798。早融合各种变体使 AUC 变化 -0.13% 到 +0.01%，直接联合训练为 +0.00%。分阶段预热在第一到第三阶段的 AUC 分别为 +0.22%、+0.11% 和 +0.23%。编码器方面，Live Q2I R@10 从 CLIP-B/32 加 Albert-V2 的 43.96 提升到使用 Qwen3-Embedding 和 SigLIP2 后的 47.44。

q_en: Does FLUID have online evidence, and how long was the A/B?
q_zh: FLUID 有线上证据吗，A/B 做了多久？
gold_en: Online evidence: Online numbers. A/B duration: not reported. A/B traffic: not reported.
gold_zh: 线上证据：有线上数据。A/B 时长：未报告。A/B 流量：未报告。

q_en: What should I keep in mind when reading the results of FLUID?
q_zh: 读 FLUID 的结果时要注意什么？
gold_en: The A/B duration, traffic share and platform split are not stated, and the paper reports only relative changes against the production baseline; the retention gains are tiny, Active Hours +0.05% and Stay Duration +0.07%. Table 4 marks changes that are not significant at p < 0.05 as n.s., but gives no confidence intervals, no repeated runs and no per-platform split.
gold_zh: 论文没有写 A/B 时长、流量占比和各平台的拆分，只报告相对线上基线的变化；留存方面的收益很小，活跃时长 +0.05%，停留时长 +0.07%。 Table 4 把在 p < 0.05 下不显著的变化标为 n.s.，但没有给置信区间、重复实验和分平台的结果。

q_en: Is there code for FLUID?
q_zh: FLUID 有代码吗？
gold_en: Code status: No code found.
gold_zh: 代码状态：未发现公开代码。

q_en: What inputs does FLUID use?
q_zh: FLUID 用了哪些输入？
gold_en: IDs and tokenization: LUCID: 4-level RQ-KMeans code with 64 clusters per level, embedded by a prefix n-gram scheme. Input signals: Slice-level LUCID of the current 2-minute content segment; Room-level LUCID from majority voting over the slices so far; Video frames, titles, OCR, ASR transcripts, author bios, audience comments and sticker tags as encoder input; User features and user history tokens in the Zenith++ ranker.
gold_zh: ID 与 token 化：LUCID：4 层 RQ-KMeans 编码，每层 64 个聚类，用前缀 n-gram 方式做 embedding。 输入特征：当前 2 分钟内容片段的切片级 LUCID；直播间级 LUCID，由已有切片的多数投票得到；作为编码器输入的视频帧、标题、OCR、ASR 转写、作者简介、观众评论和贴纸标签；Zenith++ 排序模型中的用户特征和用户历史 token。

q_en: What is Feed SR, in one sentence?
q_zh: Feed SR 一句话是什么？
gold_en: LinkedIn's Feed SR replaces the DCNv2 ranker with a Transformer over a year of post and action history for 1.2 billion members; time spent +2.10%, likes, comments and shares +3.52%.
gold_zh: LinkedIn 的 Feed SR 用处理一年帖子与行为历史的 Transformer 取代 DCNv2 排序模型，服务 12 亿会员；停留时间 +2.10%，点赞、评论和分享 +3.52%。

q_en: Who built Feed SR and where does it run?
q_zh: Feed SR 是谁做的，用在哪里？
gold_en: Feed SR comes from LinkedIn, 2026. Deployed in: LinkedIn Feed ranking for 1.2 billion members, the majority of Feed traffic.
gold_zh: Feed SR 来自 LinkedIn，2026 年。上线位置：LinkedIn Feed 排序，12 亿会员，占 Feed 流量的大部分。

q_en: What is the core idea of Feed SR?
q_zh: Feed SR 的核心思路是什么？
gold_en: Replace the DCNv2 Feed ranker with a decoder-only Transformer over a year of interleaved posts and actions, and make it serve with shared-context batching, custom kernels and a split CPU and GPU stack.
gold_zh: 用处理一年帖子与行为交错历史的仅解码器 Transformer 取代 DCNv2 的 Feed 排序模型，并通过共享上下文批处理、自定义 kernel 和 CPU 与 GPU 拆分的服务栈让它能上线。

q_en: What results does Feed SR report?
q_zh: Feed SR 报告了哪些结果？
gold_en: Online, Feed SR was compared in controlled A/B tests with the previous production ranker, and the paper reports Overall time spent +2.10% and likes, comments and shares +3.52%. By segment, DAU gains are +2.38% and +4.07%, WAU +1.84% and +3.40%, MAU +0.82% and +1.86%, and new members are not statistically significant. These online results exclude incremental training. Feed SR has served the majority of Feed traffic for over three months. Relative energy per item against the previous model is 0.2 times in training and 0.7 times in inference. Training efficiency work reduced GPU hours by 22% for the metrics kernel, 15% for optimizer fusing, 50% for data loading and 16% for parallel evaluation. Scaling shows Long Dwell AUC improving by about 0.0093 per 10 times training FLOPs over 10^17 to 10^19 FLOPs. In the ablations, replacing the layers with HSTU lowers Long Dwell AUC by 0.23% and Contributions AUC by 0.28%, a Linear head lowers Long Dwell AUC by 1.20%, and no position embedding lowers it by 0.91%.
gold_zh: 线上，Feed SR 与此前的线上排序模型做对照 A/B 测试，论文报告整体停留时间 +2.10%，点赞、评论和分享 +3.52%。分人群看，DAU 提升为 +2.38% 和 +4.07%，WAU 为 +1.84% 和 +3.40%，MAU 为 +0.82% 和 +1.86%，新会员没有统计显著性。这些线上结果不含增量训练。Feed SR 已服务 Feed 流量的大部分超过三个月。相对此前模型的每物品能耗，训练是 0.2 倍，推理是 0.7 倍。训练效率方面的工作，使指标 kernel 的 GPU 小时减少 22%，optimizer 融合减少 15%，数据加载减少 50%，并行评估减少 16%。scaling 显示在 10^17 到 10^19 FLOPs 范围内，训练 FLOPs 每增加 10 倍，Long Dwell AUC 约提升 0.0093。消融中，把层换成 HSTU 使 Long Dwell AUC 降低 0.23%，Contributions AUC 降低 0.28%，Linear 头使 Long Dwell AUC 降低 1.20%，去掉位置 embedding 使其降低 0.91%。

q_en: Does Feed SR have online evidence, and how long was the A/B?
q_zh: Feed SR 有线上证据吗，A/B 做了多久？
gold_en: Online evidence: Online numbers. A/B duration: not reported. A/B traffic: not reported.
gold_zh: 线上证据：有线上数据。A/B 时长：未报告。A/B 流量：未报告。

q_en: What should I keep in mind when reading the results of Feed SR?
q_zh: 读 Feed SR 的结果时要注意什么？
gold_en: The paper gives no A/B traffic share, duration, user count or confidence intervals; the lifts are relative changes in time spent and in likes, comments and shares. Serving cost is reported as relative speedups and relative energy per item; absolute latency, GPU type and fleet size for serving are not given.
gold_zh: 论文没有给出 A/B 流量占比、时长、用户数或置信区间；提升是停留时间以及点赞、评论和分享的相对变化。 服务成本以相对加速比和每物品相对能耗给出；服务用的绝对延迟、GPU 型号和集群规模都没有给出。

q_en: What inputs does Feed SR use?
q_zh: Feed SR 用了哪些输入？
gold_en: IDs and tokenization: Per-post feature embeddings and an action embedding per post, no semantic IDs. Input signals: Member history of up to 1000 impressed posts from one year of data, with the member action on each post; Post features and ID embeddings; Late-fused context features, mainly item popularity and viewer-author affinity; Member profile embeddings from a fine-tuned Qwen3 0.6 billion parameter model, refreshed daily.
gold_zh: ID 与 token 化：每个帖子的特征 embedding 加每个帖子的行为 embedding，不使用 Semantic ID。 输入特征：会员一年数据中最多 1000 条曝光帖子的历史，以及会员对每条帖子的行为；帖子特征和 ID embedding；后期融合的上下文特征，主要是物品热度和浏览者与作者的亲和度；会员画像 embedding，来自微调过的 Qwen3 6 亿参数模型，每天刷新。

q_en: What does the source of Feed SR not report?
q_zh: Feed SR 的原文有哪些没有报告？
gold_en: The source does not report: A/B traffic share and duration; Absolute latency and serving hardware; Training compute for the production model; Code release.
gold_zh: 原文没有报告：A/B 流量占比和时长；绝对延迟和服务硬件；线上模型的训练算力；代码发布。

q_en: What is GCRank, in one sentence?
q_zh: GCRank 一句话是什么？
gold_en: JD's GCRank feeds LLM and flow-matching generated context into takeout ad ranking; 7-day 20% A/B vs the production DLRM: CTR +5.07%, CVR +4.71%, RPM +6.42%, then full traffic.
gold_zh: 京东 GCRank 把大模型和 flow matching 生成的上下文输入外卖广告排序；对比线上 DLRM 做 7 天 20% A/B：CTR +5.07%，CVR +4.71%，RPM +6.42%，随后全量上线。

q_en: Who built GCRank and where does it run?
q_zh: GCRank 是谁做的，用在哪里？
gold_en: GCRank comes from JD.com, 2026. Deployed in: JD takeout food delivery ad ranking, tested on 20% of traffic then rolled out to all traffic.
gold_zh: GCRank 来自 京东，2026 年。上线位置：京东外卖广告排序，先在 20% 流量上测试，再推到全量流量。

q_en: What is the core idea of GCRank?
q_zh: GCRank 的核心思路是什么？
gold_en: LLMs and flow matching generate four kinds of context that a takeout ad ranker fuses through LoRA-style adapters.
gold_zh: 大模型和 flow matching 生成四类上下文，外卖广告排序模型通过 LoRA 风格的 adapter 融合它们。

q_en: What results does GCRank report?
q_zh: GCRank 报告了哪些结果？
gold_en: Online 7-day A/B with a 20% traffic allocation against the production DLRM, all p < 0.0001: CTR +5.07%, CVR +4.71%, RPM +6.42%, with TP99 latency up about 2 ms; daily gains stay stable across the 7 days, and the model was then rolled out to all platform traffic. Offline AUC on the industrial set is 0.7679 for CTR and 0.7053 for CVR for GCRank against 0.7513 and 0.6619 for the production DLRM and 0.7545 and 0.6659 for HSTU.
gold_zh: 线上 7 天 A/B，分配 20% 流量，对比线上 DLRM，全部 p < 0.0001：CTR +5.07%，CVR +4.71%，RPM +6.42%，TP99 延迟增加约 2 ms；7 天内每日收益保持稳定，随后模型推到平台全量流量。工业数据集上的离线 AUC：GCRank 的 CTR 为 0.7679，CVR 为 0.7053；线上 DLRM 分别为 0.7513 和 0.6619；HSTU 分别为 0.7545 和 0.6659。

q_en: Does GCRank have online evidence, and how long was the A/B?
q_zh: GCRank 有线上证据吗，A/B 做了多久？
gold_en: Online evidence: Online numbers. A/B duration: 7 days. A/B traffic: 20% of traffic.
gold_zh: 线上证据：有线上数据。A/B 时长：7 天。A/B 流量：20% 流量。

q_en: What should I keep in mind when reading the results of GCRank?
q_zh: 读 GCRank 的结果时要注意什么？
gold_en: The paper states that reported results were transformed to protect proprietary business information, so absolute values may not match raw logs. The offline dataset is proprietary and no public dataset is used.
gold_zh: 论文说明，为保护商业机密，报告的结果经过变换，因此绝对数值可能与原始日志不一致。 离线数据集是私有的，没有使用公开数据集。

q_en: What inputs does GCRank use?
q_zh: GCRank 用了哪些输入？
gold_en: IDs and tokenization: No semantic IDs; text and context prompts are encoded by LLMs into embeddings. Input signals: User behavior sequences of the past 60 days, up to 300 interactions; Time, location, POI and AOI context; Store and area text attributes, such as taste and price level; Ad features.
gold_zh: ID 与 token 化：不使用 Semantic ID；文本和上下文 prompt 由大模型编码成 embedding。 输入特征：过去 60 天的用户行为序列，最多 300 次交互；时间、位置、POI 和 AOI 上下文；店铺和区域的文本属性，如口味和价格档位；广告特征。

q_en: What does the source of GCRank not report?
q_zh: GCRank 的原文有哪些没有报告？
gold_en: The source does not report: LLM serving hardware; knowledge base cache hit rate; model parameter count; user and request volume.
gold_zh: 原文没有报告：大模型在线服务硬件；知识库缓存命中率；模型参数量；用户和请求量。

q_en: What is GEAR, in one sentence?
q_zh: GEAR 一句话是什么？
gold_en: ByteDance generative ad retrieval with BasisRQ tokenizer and a joint reranking head on Douyin Ads; global A/B on 5% traffic per group for 7 days: ADSS +0.563%, ADVV +0.658%.
gold_zh: 字节跳动在抖音广告中上线生成式广告召回，包含 BasisRQ 分词器和联合重排头；全局 A/B 每组 5% 流量、7 天：ADSS +0.563%，ADVV +0.658%。

q_en: Who built GEAR and where does it run?
q_zh: GEAR 是谁做的，用在哪里？
gold_en: GEAR comes from ByteDance, 2026. Deployed in: Douyin Ads retrieval, as an extra generative channel.
gold_zh: GEAR 来自 字节跳动，2026 年。上线位置：抖音广告召回，作为额外的生成式通道。

q_en: What is the core idea of GEAR?
q_zh: GEAR 的核心思路是什么？
gold_en: Quantize item embeddings into token sequences and decode them as an extra retrieval channel.
gold_zh: 把 item embedding 量化成 token 序列，并作为额外的召回通道解码。

q_en: What results does GEAR report?
q_zh: GEAR 报告了哪些结果？
gold_en: Online A/B on Douyin Ads, 7 days, 5% of traffic per treatment group, GEAR as an extra retrieval path vs the production system without it: ADSS +0.563%, ADVV +0.658%; cold-start activation rate of new advertisers +1.46%. Subset ablation (ADSS/ADVV): GEAR +0.446/+0.498, w/o prefix-aware BasisRQ +0.288/+0.219, w/o rerank +0.358/+0.341, w/o secpm reweight +0.395/+0.354. Tokenizer analysis per Table 2: prefix-aware BasisRQ (2048, 512, 128) utilization 8.83%, collision rate 52.3%, MSE 1.82e-3; vanilla RQ with EMA 4.22%, 84.2%, 2.32e-3.
gold_zh: 抖音广告线上 A/B，7 天，每个实验组 5% 流量，GEAR 作为额外召回路径，对比没有它的线上系统：ADSS +0.563%，ADVV +0.658%；新广告主冷启动激活率 +1.46%。子集消融，指标为 ADSS 和 ADVV：GEAR +0.446/+0.498，去掉前缀感知 BasisRQ 为 +0.288/+0.219，去掉重排为 +0.358/+0.341，去掉 secpm 重加权为 +0.395/+0.354。分词器分析见表 2：前缀感知 BasisRQ，码本大小 2048、512、128，利用率 8.83%，碰撞率 52.3%，MSE 1.82e-3；带 EMA 的普通 RQ 分别为 4.22%、84.2%、2.32e-3。

q_en: Does GEAR have online evidence, and how long was the A/B?
q_zh: GEAR 有线上证据吗，A/B 做了多久？
gold_en: Online evidence: Online numbers. A/B duration: 7 days. A/B traffic: 5% of total traffic per treatment group.
gold_zh: 线上证据：有线上数据。A/B 时长：7 天。A/B 流量：每个实验组占总流量的 5%。

q_en: What should I keep in mind when reading the results of GEAR?
q_zh: 读 GEAR 的结果时要注意什么？
gold_en: arXiv preprint (v1); no peer-reviewed venue found, so there is no published version to check. The paper reports revenue-style metrics (ADSS, ADVV) as relative gains only; no absolute values, confidence intervals or per-segment results.
gold_zh: arXiv 预印本 v1；没有找到经同行评审的发表会议，因此没有可核对的正式发表版。 论文只以相对提升报告收入类指标 ADSS 和 ADVV；没有绝对值、置信区间或分人群结果。

q_en: What scale does GEAR report?
q_zh: GEAR 报告了哪些规模信息？
gold_en: Daily active users served: hundreds of millions. Tokenizer codebook: 2048 x 512 x 128.
gold_zh: 服务的日活用户：数亿。 分词器码本：2048 x 512 x 128。

q_en: What serving latency, QPS, cost or hardware does GEAR report?
q_zh: GEAR 报告了怎样的服务延迟、QPS、成本和硬件？
gold_en: Serving latency: not reported. Serving QPS: not reported. Inference cost: not reported. Hardware: not reported.
gold_zh: 服务延迟：未报告。 服务 QPS：未报告。 推理成本：未报告。 硬件：未报告。

q_en: What is GPlan, in one sentence?
q_zh: GPlan 一句话是什么？
gold_en: GPlan distills LLM planning into a 1.7B model with latent CoT tokens and counterfactual DPO; the Amap A/B lifted UV-CTR +0.87% overall and +1.04% cross-city.
gold_zh: GPlan 把 LLM 规划蒸馏进 1.7B 小模型，用隐式 CoT token 加反事实 DPO；高德 A/B 总体 UV-CTR +0.87%、跨城 +1.04%。

q_en: Who built GPlan and where does it run?
q_zh: GPlan 是谁做的，用在哪里？
gold_en: GPlan comes from Alibaba Amap, 2026. Deployed in: Amap homepage agent, A/B on 5% plus 5% traffic slices.
gold_zh: GPlan 来自 阿里巴巴高德，2026 年。上线位置：高德首页智能体，A/B 覆盖 5% 加 5% 两个流量切片。

q_en: What is the core idea of GPlan?
q_zh: GPlan 的核心思路是什么？
gold_en: Distill LLM trip planning into a small model with latent reasoning tokens, then teach it to change the plan when time or location changes.
gold_zh: 把 LLM 行程规划蒸馏进带隐式推理 token 的小模型，再教它在时间或位置变化时改变计划。

q_en: What results does GPlan report?
q_zh: GPlan 报告了哪些结果？
gold_en: Online A/B, Sec 5.5, 14 consecutive days on the Amap homepage against the incumbent CTR-based ranking model, serving GPlan-1.7B: the general slice on 5% of traffic at about 600 QPS lifted UV-CTR +0.87%, and the cross-city slice on another 5% lifted +1.04%. Offline, Table 1, on 1,000 test sequences: GPlan-4B reaches Acc@1 62.7 and NDCG@3 0.7759, GPlan-1.7B reaches 60.5 and 0.7450, against SASRec 36.1 and 0.5865, BERT4Rec 37.4 and 0.5973, ReaRec 42.9 and 0.6442, P5 43.5 and 0.6581, TIGER 44.2 and 0.6647, an 18.5 percentage-point Acc@1 margin for GPlan-4B over TIGER. Ablations on GPlan-4B, Table 2: Direct-SFT Acc@1 61.2, CoT-SFT 62.3, PICD 62.6, PICD plus SC-DPO 62.7 with NDCG@3 0.7759 and NES 0.6365; LLM-judge scores: Flow 3.58, Logic 3.59, ST 3.75 and Overall 3.64 for the full model, against 3.37, 3.43, 3.49 and 3.43 for Direct-SFT. Table 3: CALR keeps Latent-Valid at 1.0 with Acc@1 62.6 while Cosine-LR drops Latent-Valid to 0.0; Table 4: vanilla DPO lowers all axes, Acc@1 62.1, ST 3.60, while SC-DPO raises ST to 3.75 without hurting Overall. Inference, Table 5: 299 ms Direct-SFT, 1.06 s CoT-SFT, 366 ms PICD at 1.7B; 437 ms, 1.85 s, 503 ms at 4B.
gold_zh: 线上 A/B 见 5.5 节，高德首页连续 14 天，基线为在线 CTR 排序模型，服务模型为 GPlan-1.7B：约占 600 QPS 的 5% 流量总体切片 UV-CTR +0.87%，另一 5% 跨城切片 +1.04%。离线见表 1，1000 条测试序列：GPlan-4B 达 Acc@1 62.7、NDCG@3 0.7759，GPlan-1.7B 达 60.5 和 0.7450，对比 SASRec 36.1 和 0.5865、BERT4Rec 37.4 和 0.5973、ReaRec 42.9 和 0.6442、P5 43.5 和 0.6581、TIGER 44.2 和 0.6647，GPlan-4B 领先 TIGER 18.5 个百分点。GPlan-4B 消融见表 2：Direct-SFT Acc@1 61.2、CoT-SFT 62.3、PICD 62.6、PICD 加 SC-DPO 62.7，NDCG@3 0.7759、NES 0.6365；LLM 评审分：Flow 3.58、Logic 3.59、ST 3.75、Overall 3.64，对比 Direct-SFT 的 3.37、3.43、3.49、3.43。表 3：CALR 保持 Latent-Valid 为 1.0 且 Acc@1 62.6，Cosine-LR 降到 0.0；表 4：朴素 DPO 全面下降，Acc@1 62.1、ST 3.60，SC-DPO 把 ST 提到 3.75 且不伤 Overall。推理见表 5：1.7B 下 Direct-SFT 299 毫秒、CoT-SFT 1.06 秒、PICD 366 毫秒；4B 下 437 毫秒、1.85 秒、503 毫秒。

q_en: Does GPlan have online evidence, and how long was the A/B?
q_zh: GPlan 有线上证据吗，A/B 做了多久？
gold_en: Online evidence: Online numbers. A/B duration: 14 consecutive days. A/B traffic: 5% of homepage traffic at about 600 QPS for the general slice, plus a separate 5% cross-city slice.
gold_zh: 线上证据：有线上数据。A/B 时长：连续 14 天。A/B 流量：约 600 QPS 的 5% 首页流量为总体切片，另加独立的 5% 跨城切片。

q_en: What should I keep in mind when reading the results of GPlan?
q_zh: 读 GPlan 的结果时要注意什么？
gold_en: Most training and offline evaluation targets are teacher-generated from Qwen3-235B-A22B rather than human-written, as the paper states in its label-provenance note; the offline metrics measure agreement with these curated targets. The LLM judge is GPT-4o and is applied only within the GPlan family because baselines emit ID-only sequences without parameter slots; the paper notes a residual risk that the judge may reward superficial context mentions.
gold_zh: 论文标签来源说明指出，多数训练与离线评估目标由 Qwen3-235B-A22B 教师生成而非人工撰写；离线指标衡量与这些策划目标的一致性。 LLM 评审为 GPT-4o，且只在 GPlan 家族内进行，因为基线只输出 ID 序列而无参数槽；论文说明评审可能奖励表面化的上下文提及这一残余风险。

q_en: How is GPlan trained?
q_zh: GPlan 是怎么训练的？
gold_en: Training mode: Three phases: HITL data synthesis, PICD supervised distillation, SC-DPO post-training. Objectives: Section-normalized cross-entropy balancing CoT and JSON plan sections; SC-DPO: DPO plus anchor, gap and center terms on bidirectional counterfactual pairs.
gold_zh: 训练方式：三阶段：人机协同数据合成、PICD 监督蒸馏、SC-DPO 后训练。 训练目标：按 CoT 与 JSON 计划分段归一的交叉熵；SC-DPO：在双向反事实对上的 DPO 加锚定、间隔和中心项。

q_en: Is there code for GPlan?
q_zh: GPlan 有代码吗？
gold_en: Code status: Full official code.
gold_zh: 代码状态：完整官方代码。

q_en: What is GenPage, in one sentence?
q_zh: GenPage 一句话是什么？
gold_en: Netflix replaces the multi-stage homepage stack with one decoder-only Transformer that generates the whole page; A/B vs production: +0.24% core engagement at p<0.001 and 20% lower serving latency.
gold_zh: Netflix 用一个 decoder-only Transformer 取代多阶段首页链路，直接生成整个页面；对比线上系统的 A/B：核心互动指标 +0.24%，p<0.001，在线服务延迟降低 20%。

q_en: Who built GenPage and where does it run?
q_zh: GenPage 是谁做的，用在哪里？
gold_en: GenPage comes from Netflix, 2026. Deployed in: Netflix homepage, the WBC variant tested online, full launch not stated.
gold_zh: GenPage 来自 Netflix，2026 年。上线位置：Netflix 首页，WBC 变体已做线上测试，未说明是否全量上线。

q_en: What is the core idea of GenPage?
q_zh: GenPage 的核心思路是什么？
gold_en: Generate the whole multi-row homepage autoregressively, with each row and entity as one token.
gold_zh: 自回归地生成整个多 row 首页，每个 row 和 entity 各占一个 token。

q_en: What results does GenPage report?
q_zh: GenPage 报告了哪些结果？
gold_en: Online A/B vs mature multi-stage production homepage recommender (14 days, five WBC variants, all significant with p < 0.001): best variant +0.24% on the core engagement metric used for launch decisions (95% CI [0.17%, 0.30%]); end-to-end serving latency -20%. Offline per Table 1 pretraining vs none for WBC: loss 0.321 vs 0.333, Row AUC 0.884 vs 0.879, Entity AUC 0.920 vs 0.910. Scaling 120M to 900M reduces WBC loss by about 1.3%, while cumulative context enrichment reduces it by about 6.9%. RL post-training raises page reward and homepage diversity offline.
gold_zh: 线上 A/B，对比成熟的多阶段线上首页推荐系统，14 天，五个 WBC 变体，全部显著，p < 0.001：最佳变体在用于上线决策的核心互动指标上 +0.24%，95% 置信区间 [0.17%, 0.30%]；端到端在线服务延迟 -20%。离线结果见表 1，WBC 有预训练对比无预训练：loss 为 0.321 对 0.333，Row AUC 为 0.884 对 0.879，Entity AUC 为 0.920 对 0.910。模型规模从 120M 扩到 900M，WBC loss 约降低 1.3%，而累积加入上下文信息可降低约 6.9%。RL 后训练在离线提升了页面奖励和首页多样性。

q_en: Does GenPage have online evidence, and how long was the A/B?
q_zh: GenPage 有线上证据吗，A/B 做了多久？
gold_en: Online evidence: Online numbers. A/B duration: 14 days. A/B traffic: not reported.
gold_zh: 线上证据：有线上数据。A/B 时长：14 天。A/B 流量：未报告。

q_en: What should I keep in mind when reading the results of GenPage?
q_zh: 读 GenPage 的结果时要注意什么？
gold_en: Only the WBC variant is online; the RL variant has not shipped and its offline evaluation is circular, since the reward model is also the training signal. The A/B test decoded over the existing production row and entity candidate sets, so candidate generation was not replaced.
gold_zh: 只有 WBC 变体上线；RL 变体尚未发布，它的离线评估是循环论证，因为奖励模型同时也是训练信号。 A/B 测试是在现有线上的 row 和 entity 候选集上解码的，因此候选生成并没有被取代。

q_en: What does the source of GenPage not report?
q_zh: GenPage 的原文有哪些没有报告？
gold_en: The source does not report: name and absolute value of the core engagement metric; exact model depth and width; training data volume; whether the system has fully launched.
gold_zh: 原文没有报告：核心互动指标的名称和绝对值；模型确切的深度和宽度；训练数据量；系统是否已全量上线。

q_en: Which stages of the pipeline does GenPage cover?
q_zh: GenPage 覆盖链路的哪些阶段？
gold_en: Single-stage: Decoder-only Transformer with untied input and output embeddings; about 200M parameters in the online test; sweeps from about 120M to 900M offline.
gold_zh: 单阶段：输入和输出 embedding 不共享的 decoder-only Transformer；线上测试约 200M 参数；离线在约 120M 到 900M 之间扫描。

q_en: What is GloRank, in one sentence?
q_zh: GloRank 一句话是什么？
gold_en: GloRank reranks by generating global Semantic IDs with constrained decoding and GRPO post-training; a 14-day A/B beats the deployed GoalRank with Comment +0.462% and Watch Time +0.095%.
gold_zh: GloRank 用受限解码生成全局 Semantic ID 做重排，再用 GRPO 后训练；14 天 A/B 胜过已上线的 GoalRank，评论 +0.462%、观看时长 +0.095%。

q_en: Who built GloRank and where does it run?
q_zh: GloRank 是谁做的，用在哪里？
gold_en: GloRank comes from Kuaishou, 2026. Deployed in: List-wise reranking on a leading content platform, live A/B traffic.
gold_zh: GloRank 来自 快手，2026 年。上线位置：领先内容平台的 list-wise 重排，线上 A/B 流量。

q_en: What is the core idea of GloRank?
q_zh: GloRank 的核心思路是什么？
gold_en: Generate global Semantic IDs instead of picking local indices, so each output neuron always means the same item, and align the generator with list-wise rewards.
gold_zh: 生成全局 Semantic ID 而不是选局部下标，让每个输出神经元始终对应同一物品，再用列表收益对齐生成器。

q_en: What results does GloRank report?
q_zh: GloRank 报告了哪些结果？
gold_en: Offline, generating a list of length 6 from 50 candidates, Table 2: on the industrial e-commerce dataset GloRank reaches Precision 62.56, NDCG 90.15, MAP 84.84 and F1 74.32, with relative improvements over the best baseline of 3.99%, 2.35%, 3.39% and 3.97%; on Amazon Books 83.75, 90.08, 85.10 and 86.97, improving 4.23%, 6.13%, 9.23% and 4.23%; on MovieLens-1M 75.79, 87.56, 81.19 and 82.57, improving 3.03%, 4.95%, 6.60% and 3.02%. Ablation, Table 3: without pre-training, NDCG collapses to 24.13 on Amazon Books; without post-training, MAP falls to 83.68 on Amazon Books, while on MovieLens-1M post-training adds 2.34% MAP from 78.85 to 81.19 and 1.62% NDCG from 85.94 to 87.56. A local action space variant degrades sharply, and under a cold start on Amazon Books with 5% of items removed from training, GoalRank MAP drops by over 88.4% while GloRank loses only 4.9%. Online, Table 4: over 14 days on 7.8% of live traffic with an equal-size GoalRank control on a content platform serving over 400 million DAU, Watch Time +0.095%, Effective View +0.111%, Like +0.286%, Comment +0.462% and Forward +0.447%, all significant at p < 0.05 by t-test, with Active Devices +0.030% in the text.
gold_zh: 离线任务为从 50 个候选生成长度 6 的列表，表 2：工业电商数据集上 GloRank 达到 Precision 62.56、NDCG 90.15、MAP 84.84、F1 74.32，相对最优基线提升 3.99%、2.35%、3.39%、3.97%；Amazon Books 上为 83.75、90.08、85.10、86.97，提升 4.23%、6.13%、9.23%、4.23%；MovieLens-1M 上为 75.79、87.56、81.19、82.57，提升 3.03%、4.95%、6.60%、3.02%。消融见表 3：去掉预训练，Amazon Books 的 NDCG 崩到 24.13；去掉后训练，Amazon Books 的 MAP 降到 83.68，而 MovieLens-1M 上后训练带来 MAP 从 78.85 到 81.19 的 2.34% 提升和 NDCG 从 85.94 到 87.56 的 1.62% 提升。局部动作空间变体明显退化；在 Amazon Books 上从训练集移除 5% 物品的冷启动设定下，GoalRank 的 MAP 下降超过 88.4%，GloRank 只降 4.9%。线上见表 4：在日活超过 4 亿的内容平台上，以 7.8% 线上流量与等规模 GoalRank 对照组跑了 14 天，观看时长 +0.095%、有效观看 +0.111%、点赞 +0.286%、评论 +0.462%、转发 +0.447%，全部经 t 检验 p < 0.05 显著，正文另报告活跃设备 +0.030%。

q_en: Does GloRank have online evidence, and how long was the A/B?
q_zh: GloRank 有线上证据吗，A/B 做了多久？
gold_en: Online evidence: Online numbers. A/B duration: 14 days to cover weekly fluctuations. A/B traffic: 7.8% of total live traffic, with an equal-size control group.
gold_zh: 线上证据：有线上数据。A/B 时长：14 天，覆盖周内波动。A/B 流量：7.8% 线上流量，等规模对照组。

q_en: What should I keep in mind when reading the results of GloRank?
q_zh: 读 GloRank 的结果时要注意什么？
gold_en: The A/B platform is described only as a leading content platform; Kuaishou comes from the author affiliation, and no rollout beyond the A/B is stated. The arXiv v1 text read is a preprint in a placeholder ACM template; the final CIKM 2026 text was not read.
gold_zh: A/B 平台只被描述为领先内容平台；快手身份来自作者署名，未说明 A/B 之外的全量状态。 所读 arXiv v1 是占位 ACM 模板的预印本；未读到 CIKM 2026 最终文本。

q_en: Is there code for GloRank?
q_zh: GloRank 有代码吗？
gold_en: Code status: Third-party code only.
gold_zh: 代码状态：仅有第三方代码。

q_en: What inputs does GloRank use?
q_zh: GloRank 用了哪些输入？
gold_en: IDs and tokenization: RQ-based Semantic IDs, depth 4, codebook size 256. Input signals: Item textual attributes, for Amazon title, categories, description, price and brand; for MovieLens title and genres; User interaction history serialized as Semantic IDs; The candidate slate serialized as Semantic IDs; List-wise reward signals for GRPO post-training.
gold_zh: ID 与 token 化：RQ Semantic ID，深度 4，码本大小 256。 输入特征：物品文本属性，Amazon 用标题、类目、描述、价格和品牌，MovieLens 用标题和题材；序列化为 Semantic ID 的用户交互历史；序列化为 Semantic ID 的候选列表；GRPO 后训练用的列表收益信号。

q_en: What is Gwhere, in one sentence?
q_zh: Gwhere 一句话是什么？
gold_en: Amap's Gwhere has a Qwen LLM generate next-POI semantic IDs for the app homepage; one-month A/B vs the production cascade: P-CTR +5.83%, U-CTR +6.20%, negative feedback -11.11%. SID code released.
gold_zh: 高德 Gwhere 让 Qwen 大模型为 App 首页生成下一个 POI 的 Semantic ID；对比线上级联做一个月 A/B：P-CTR +5.83%，U-CTR +6.20%，负反馈 -11.11%。SID 代码已开源。

q_en: Who built Gwhere and where does it run?
q_zh: Gwhere 是谁做的，用在哪里？
gold_en: Gwhere comes from Alibaba Amap, 2026. Deployed in: Amap app homepage Guess Where You Go card, in place of a four-stage cascade.
gold_zh: Gwhere 来自 阿里巴巴高德，2026 年。上线位置：高德 App 首页「猜你想去」卡片，取代四阶段级联。

q_en: What is the core idea of Gwhere?
q_zh: Gwhere 的核心思路是什么？
gold_en: An LLM generates next-POI semantic IDs from a contrastively learned multimodal tokenizer, aligned to exposure feedback.
gold_zh: 大模型根据对比学习得到的多模态分词器生成下一个 POI 的 Semantic ID，并按曝光反馈对齐。

q_en: What results does Gwhere report?
q_zh: Gwhere 报告了哪些结果？
gold_en: Offline Acc@1 on the Amap dataset is 0.2820 for the deployed 0.5B variant and 0.3071 for the 7B variant against 0.2675 for the production cascade, a 14.8% relative gain for the 7B model. On public Foursquare and Gowalla data the 7B model improves over GNPR-SID by 11.3%, 8.1% and 13.2%. Ablation of the semantic IDs drops Acc@1 by 16.01%, and SFT plus the new alignment reaches 0.2820 against 0.2759 for SFT plus GRPO and 0.2634 for SFT plus DPO. In a one-month A/B on the Amap homepage card against the production cascade, P-CTR rises 5.83%, U-CTR 6.20%, active rate 9.67% and negative feedback rate falls 11.11%. Without the alignment objective the negative feedback rate falls only 5.85%.
gold_zh: 高德数据集上的离线 Acc@1：已部署的 0.5B 变体为 0.2820，7B 变体为 0.3071，线上级联为 0.2675，7B 模型相对提升 14.8%。在公开的 Foursquare 和 Gowalla 数据上，7B 模型相比 GNPR-SID 分别提升 11.3%、8.1% 和 13.2%。去掉 Semantic ID 的消融使 Acc@1 下降 16.01%；SFT 加新的对齐方法达到 0.2820，SFT 加 GRPO 为 0.2759，SFT 加 DPO 为 0.2634。在高德首页卡片上对比线上级联做一个月 A/B，P-CTR 提升 5.83%，U-CTR 提升 6.20%，活跃率提升 9.67%，负反馈率下降 11.11%。没有对齐目标时，负反馈率只下降 5.85%。

q_en: Does Gwhere have online evidence, and how long was the A/B?
q_zh: Gwhere 有线上证据吗，A/B 做了多久？
gold_en: Online evidence: Online numbers. A/B duration: One month, after a one-week short-term test. A/B traffic: not reported.
gold_zh: 线上证据：有线上数据。A/B 时长：一个月，此前有一周的短期测试。A/B 流量：未报告。

q_en: What should I keep in mind when reading the results of Gwhere?
q_zh: 读 Gwhere 的结果时要注意什么？
gold_en: The arXiv v1 PDF used here still shows placeholder ACM metadata, so it is not confirmed as the camera-ready text; the DOI is registered. The paper does not state the A/B traffic share or user counts beyond serving millions of active users.
gold_zh: 这里使用的 arXiv v1 PDF 仍带有占位的 ACM 元数据，因此无法确认它就是定稿版文本；DOI 已注册。 除了服务数百万活跃用户之外，论文没有说明 A/B 的流量占比和用户数。

q_en: Which stages of the pipeline does Gwhere cover?
q_zh: Gwhere 覆盖链路的哪些阶段？
gold_en: Single-stage: Qwen2.5 LLM generating POI semantic IDs, replacing the recall, coarse-rank, fine-rank and cognitive re-rank cascade.
gold_zh: 单阶段：Qwen2.5 大模型生成 POI 的 Semantic ID，取代召回、粗排、精排和认知重排的级联。

q_en: What scale does Gwhere report?
q_zh: Gwhere 报告了哪些规模信息？
gold_en: Amap offline dataset: 10 million users, 83.1 million POIs, 380 million interactions. Deployed model: 0.5B parameters. Online A/B: One month.
gold_zh: 高德离线数据集：一千万用户，8310 万个 POI，3.8 亿条交互。 已部署模型：0.5B 参数。 线上 A/B：一个月。

q_en: What is HPGR, in one sentence?
q_zh: HPGR 一句话是什么？
gold_en: Huawei's HPGR adds session pre-training and preference-guided sparse attention to an HSTU ranker; 7-day 50% A/B on AppGallery vs the production DLRM: eCPM +1.99%.
gold_zh: 华为 HPGR 在 HSTU 排序模型上加入会话预训练和偏好引导的稀疏注意力；AppGallery 上对比线上 DLRM 做 7 天 50% A/B：eCPM +1.99%。

q_en: Who built HPGR and where does it run?
q_zh: HPGR 是谁做的，用在哪里？
gold_en: HPGR comes from Huawei, 2026. Deployed in: AppGallery app recommendation ranking, tested on half of traffic.
gold_zh: HPGR 来自 华为，2026 年。上线位置：AppGallery 应用推荐排序，在一半流量上测试。

q_en: What is the core idea of HPGR?
q_zh: HPGR 的核心思路是什么？
gold_en: An HSTU ranker is pre-trained on user sessions and then restricted by a sparse attention mask to the most relevant history.
gold_zh: HSTU 排序模型先在用户会话上预训练，再通过稀疏注意力掩码，把注意力限制在最相关的历史上。

q_en: What results does HPGR report?
q_zh: HPGR 报告了哪些结果？
gold_en: Online 7-day A/B on AppGallery with traffic split evenly against the production DLRM: eCPM +1.99%, reported as statistically significant. Offline AUC on a 2.5% user sample is 0.8377 for HPGR against 0.8253 for MTGR, 0.8220 for HSTU and 0.8194 for SASRec, a gain of 0.0124 absolute and 1.50% relative over MTGR. On the full test set, HPGR reaches AUC 0.89288, 0.01139 above MTGR, and the production DLRM scores 0.8880 against 0.8929 for HPGR. Pre-training alone gives 0.8327, adding the session module gives 0.8374 and the sparse attention module gives 0.8348.
gold_zh: AppGallery 上做 7 天线上 A/B，流量平均分配，对比线上 DLRM：eCPM +1.99%，论文称统计显著。2.5% 用户样本上的离线 AUC：HPGR 为 0.8377，MTGR 为 0.8253，HSTU 为 0.8220，SASRec 为 0.8194，相比 MTGR 绝对提升 0.0124，相对提升 1.50%。在完整测试集上，HPGR 的 AUC 为 0.89288，比 MTGR 高 0.01139，线上 DLRM 为 0.8880，HPGR 为 0.8929。仅预训练为 0.8327，加入会话模块为 0.8374，加入稀疏注意力模块为 0.8348。

q_en: Does HPGR have online evidence, and how long was the A/B?
q_zh: HPGR 有线上证据吗，A/B 做了多久？
gold_en: Online evidence: Online numbers. A/B duration: 7 days. A/B traffic: Half of traffic, split evenly between control and treatment.
gold_zh: 线上证据：有线上数据。A/B 时长：7 天。A/B 流量：一半流量，在对照组和实验组之间平均分配。

q_en: What should I keep in mind when reading the results of HPGR?
q_zh: 读 HPGR 的结果时要注意什么？
gold_en: The online evidence is a single eCPM figure with no confidence interval or per-metric breakdown. Main offline results use a 2.5% user sample of a proprietary dataset, with a full-set check for the top models only.
gold_zh: 线上证据只有一个 eCPM 数字，没有置信区间，也没有分指标的拆解。 主要的离线结果使用私有数据集的 2.5% 用户样本，只对排名靠前的模型做了完整数据集的检查。

q_en: Which stages of the pipeline does HPGR cover?
q_zh: HPGR 覆盖链路的哪些阶段？
gold_en: Ranking: HSTU encoder with session encoders and sparse attention mask.
gold_zh: 精排：带会话编码器和稀疏注意力掩码的 HSTU 编码器。

q_en: What scale does HPGR report?
q_zh: HPGR 报告了哪些规模信息？
gold_en: Offline dataset users: About 45.8 million. Offline dataset items: About 200,000. Interactions: About 285 million train and 7.38 million test. Online A/B: 7 days, traffic split evenly.
gold_zh: 离线数据集用户数：约 4580 万。 离线数据集 item 数：约 200,000。 交互数：约 2.85 亿条训练，738 万条测试。 线上 A/B：7 天，流量平均分配。

q_en: What is HiSAC, in one sentence?
q_zh: HiSAC 一句话是什么？
gold_en: HiSAC compresses histories of up to 10,000 interactions into personalized semantic-ID interest agents; on Taobao's homepage feed it lifted CTR 1.65% and cut serving latency by over 40%.
gold_zh: HiSAC 把最长 10,000 条交互的用户历史压缩成个性化语义 ID 兴趣代理；在淘宝首页信息流上 CTR 提升 1.65%，服务延迟降低 40% 以上。

q_en: Who built HiSAC and where does it run?
q_zh: HiSAC 是谁做的，用在哪里？
gold_en: HiSAC comes from Alibaba, 2026. Deployed in: Ranking-stage sequence modeling on Taobao homepage "Guess What You Like".
gold_zh: HiSAC 来自 阿里巴巴，2026 年。上线位置：淘宝首页「猜你喜欢」的排序阶段序列建模。

q_en: What is the core idea of HiSAC?
q_zh: HiSAC 的核心思路是什么？
gold_en: Sparsely activated personalized interest agents over a hierarchical semantic codebook compress ultra-long behavior sequences for the ranking stage.
gold_zh: 在层级语义码本上做稀疏激活的个性化兴趣代理，为排序阶段压缩超长行为序列。

q_en: Does HiSAC have online evidence, and how long was the A/B?
q_zh: HiSAC 有线上证据吗，A/B 做了多久？
gold_en: Online evidence: Online numbers. A/B duration: Two weeks. A/B traffic: not reported.
gold_zh: 线上证据：有线上数据。A/B 时长：两周。A/B 流量：未报告。

q_en: What should I keep in mind when reading the results of HiSAC?
q_zh: 读 HiSAC 的结果时要注意什么？
gold_en: The online baseline is described only as the strongest prior compression method in production; the paper does not name it. The paper reports no traffic share, bucket counts or user counts for the two-week A/B test.
gold_zh: 线上基线只被描述为线上最强前代压缩方法，论文未给名字。 论文未报告两周 A/B 的流量占比、分桶数或用户数。

q_en: How is HiSAC trained?
q_zh: HiSAC 是怎么训练的？
gold_en: Training mode: Offline training; SIDs and agents are constructed offline daily with only newly added items processed. Objectives: Symmetric InfoNCE contrastive training of the multimodal encoder; RQ-VAE reconstruction with commitment loss and EMA codebook updates; CTR prediction for the trainable ranking embeddings used as aggregation content.
gold_zh: 训练方式：离线训练；SID 与代理离线每日构造，仅处理新增物品。 训练目标：多模态编码器的对称 InfoNCE 对比训练；RQ-VAE 重建加承诺损失与 EMA 码本更新；可训练排序嵌入的 CTR 预估，用作聚合内容。

q_en: Is there code for HiSAC?
q_zh: HiSAC 有代码吗？
gold_en: Code status: No code found.
gold_zh: 代码状态：未发现公开代码。

q_en: What inputs does HiSAC use?
q_zh: HiSAC 用了哪些输入？
gold_en: IDs and tokenization: Multi-level hierarchical semantic IDs from Residual Quantized VAE over frozen multimodal embeddings. Input signals: Item metadata text and product image through a frozen multimodal encoder; User behavior sequence of up to 10,000 interactions; Category and brand item-side features concatenated to the trainable ranking embedding; Time-decay feature; Vote counts over the semantic tree as agent weights.
gold_zh: ID 与 token 化：用残差量化 VAE 在冻结多模态嵌入上生成多层层级语义 ID。 输入特征：经冻结多模态编码器的物品元数据文本与商品图；最长 10,000 条交互的用户行为序列；拼进可训练排序嵌入的类目与品牌侧特征；时间衰减特征；语义树上的投票票数作为代理权重。

q_en: What is Kunlun, in one sentence?
q_zh: Kunlun 一句话是什么？
gold_en: Efficiency-first joint sequence plus feature-interaction ads ranker at Meta: MFU 17% to 37% on B200, 2x scaling efficiency over InterFormer; deployed with +1.2% topline.
gold_zh: Meta 以效率优先的序列加特征交互联合广告排序模型：B200 上 MFU 从 17% 提升到 37%，扩展效率是 InterFormer 的 2x；已上线，topline 提升 +1.2%。

q_en: Who built Kunlun and where does it run?
q_zh: Kunlun 是谁做的，用在哪里？
gold_en: Kunlun comes from Meta, 2026. Deployed in: Major Meta Ads models for CTR and conversion prediction.
gold_zh: Kunlun 来自 Meta，2026 年。上线位置：Meta 主要的广告模型，用于 CTR 和转化预估。

q_en: What is the core idea of Kunlun?
q_zh: Kunlun 的核心思路是什么？
gold_en: One stack of Transformer and interaction blocks handles sequence and non-sequence features.
gold_zh: 同一组 Transformer 和交互模块同时处理序列特征和非序列特征。

q_en: What results does Kunlun report?
q_zh: Kunlun 报告了哪些结果？
gold_en: Paper claims: MFU 17% to 37% on NVIDIA B200; 2x scaling efficiency over state-of-the-art (scaling coefficient about 2x InterFormer). NE gain over Wukong at 6/60/180 GFLOPs: Kunlun 0.31%/0.66%/0.79% vs InterFormer 0.31%/0.36%/0.50% (Figure 3; Kunlun uses 154.9 vs 172.3 GFLOPs at the 180 scale). Ablations per Table 1: w/o GDPA MFU 34.0%, QPS -8%, NE +0.04%; Computation Skip -43.1% FLOPs and +35% QPS at NE-neutral; sliding window +31.1% QPS and -29.5% FLOPs; event personalization +13% QPS and -11% FLOPs. Production: deployed across major Meta Ads models with a 1.2% improvement in topline metrics.
gold_zh: 论文声称：NVIDIA B200 上 MFU 为 17% 到 37%；扩展效率是当前最优方法的 2x，扩展系数约为 InterFormer 的 2x。相对 Wukong 的 NE 提升，在 6、60、180 GFLOPs 下：Kunlun 为 0.31%、0.66%、0.79%，InterFormer 为 0.31%、0.36%、0.50%，见图 3；在 180 这一档，Kunlun 用 154.9 GFLOPs，InterFormer 用 172.3。消融见表 1：去掉 GDPA 后 MFU 为 34.0%，QPS -8%，NE +0.04%；Computation Skip 在 NE 不变时 FLOPs -43.1%，QPS +35%；滑动窗口 QPS +31.1%，FLOPs -29.5%；事件个性化 QPS +13%，FLOPs -11%。线上：已部署在 Meta 主要的广告模型中，topline 指标提升 1.2%。

q_en: Does Kunlun have online evidence, and how long was the A/B?
q_zh: Kunlun 有线上证据吗，A/B 做了多久？
gold_en: Online evidence: Online numbers. A/B duration: not reported. A/B traffic: not reported.
gold_zh: 线上证据：有线上数据。A/B 时长：未报告。A/B 流量：未报告。

q_en: What should I keep in mind when reading the results of Kunlun?
q_zh: 读 Kunlun 的结果时要注意什么？
gold_en: The deployment claim is one sentence in the abstract, contribution list and Section 5.4: "1.2% improvement in topline metrics". The paper gives no A/B design, traffic share, surface breakdown or duration. All scaling and ablation numbers come from offline training on internal datasets; absolute NE values are not shown and NEs are not comparable across compute scales.
gold_zh: 部署的说法只有一句，出现在摘要、贡献列表和第 5.4 节中：「topline 指标提升 1.2%」。论文没有给出 A/B 设计、流量占比、分场景拆解或时长。 所有扩展和消融数字都来自内部数据集上的离线训练；没有展示绝对的 NE 值，且不同算力档位之间的 NE 不可比。

q_en: Is there code for Kunlun?
q_zh: Kunlun 有代码吗？
gold_en: Code status: Partial official code.
gold_zh: 代码状态：部分官方代码。

q_en: What inputs does Kunlun use?
q_zh: Kunlun 用了哪些输入？
gold_en: IDs and tokenization: ID embeddings. Input signals: Hundreds to thousands of non-sequence dense and sparse features such as user demographics, ad metadata and context; 10+ user-history sequences of length hundreds to thousands, over event types (clicks, conversions, impressions); Timestamp gaps (Rotary Temporal Embeddings, log-scaled).
gold_zh: ID 与 token 化：ID embeddings。 输入特征：数百到数千个非序列稠密和稀疏特征，如用户人口属性、广告元数据和上下文；10 条以上的用户历史序列，长度从数百到数千，覆盖点击、转化和曝光等事件类型；时间戳间隔，使用 Rotary Temporal Embeddings，取对数缩放。

q_en: What is LLaTTE, in one sentence?
q_zh: LLaTTE 一句话是什么？
gold_en: Two-stage ads sequence modeling at Meta: a huge async upstream user model caches embeddings for a light online ranker; about 0.25% NE gain and +4.3% conversions on Feed and Reels.
gold_zh: Meta 的两阶段广告序列建模：一个庞大的异步上游用户模型缓存 embedding，供轻量的在线排序模型使用；Feed 和 Reels 上 NE 约提升 0.25%，转化 +4.3%。

q_en: Who built LLaTTE and where does it run?
q_zh: LLaTTE 是谁做的，用在哪里？
gold_en: LLaTTE comes from Meta, 2026. Deployed in: Meta Ads ranking on Facebook Feed and Reels.
gold_zh: LLaTTE 来自 Meta，2026 年。上线位置：Meta 在 Facebook Feed 和 Reels 上的广告排序。

q_en: What is the core idea of LLaTTE?
q_zh: LLaTTE 的核心思路是什么？
gold_en: A compact transformer sequence module in the online ranker consumes cached embeddings from a large asynchronous upstream user model.
gold_zh: 在线排序模型里的紧凑 Transformer 序列模块，使用大型异步上游用户模型缓存的 embedding。

q_en: What results does LLaTTE report?
q_zh: LLaTTE 报告了哪些结果？
gold_en: Scaling (offline, NE vs production baseline): Deep-Balanced L=8, d=256 gives -0.17% NE; with content embeddings a 4-layer model gains -0.118% vs +0.06% to -0.01% without. Slopes alpha vs log10 FLOPs: sequence length 0.265, depth 0.200, width 0.133, no-content 0.082. Upstream to downstream transfer ratio about 50% (upstream -0.14% gives downstream -0.07%; 53% for a model-heavy variant). Production: across multiple large-scale A/B tests the online LLaTTE plus upstream embeddings gave about 0.25% NE reduction on the flagship ads ranker, a 4.3% conversion uplift on Facebook Feed and Reels, with no measurable P99 change.
gold_zh: 扩展实验，离线，NE 相对线上基线：Deep-Balanced L=8、d=256 时 NE 为 -0.17%；加入内容 embedding 后，4 层模型 NE 为 -0.118%，不加则为 +0.06% 到 -0.01%。斜率 alpha 对 log10 FLOPs：序列长度 0.265，深度 0.200，宽度 0.133，不含内容 0.082。上游到下游的传递比约为 50%，上游 -0.14% 对应下游 -0.07%；偏模型的变体为 53%。线上：在多个大规模 A/B 测试中，在线 LLaTTE 加上游 embedding 让旗舰广告排序模型的 NE 约降低 0.25%，Facebook Feed 和 Reels 的转化提升 4.3%，P99 无可测量的变化。

q_en: Does LLaTTE have online evidence, and how long was the A/B?
q_zh: LLaTTE 有线上证据吗，A/B 做了多久？
gold_en: Online evidence: Online numbers. A/B duration: not reported. A/B traffic: not reported.
gold_zh: 线上证据：有线上数据。A/B 时长：未报告。A/B 流量：未报告。

q_en: What should I keep in mind when reading the results of LLaTTE?
q_zh: 读 LLaTTE 的结果时要注意什么？
gold_en: Scaling-law studies are offline on the upstream model, on a proprietary platform; the paper reports slopes and NE deltas but no absolute NE. The deployed online sequence module is intentionally much smaller than the models in the scaling study.
gold_zh: 扩展律研究是在私有平台上对上游模型做的离线实验；论文报告斜率和 NE 变化量，但没有绝对 NE。 线上部署的序列模块有意比扩展实验中的模型小得多。

q_en: Is there code for LLaTTE?
q_zh: LLaTTE 有代码吗？
gold_en: Code status: No code found.
gold_zh: 代码状态：未发现公开代码。

q_en: What inputs does LLaTTE use?
q_zh: LLaTTE 用了哪些输入？
gold_en: IDs and tokenization: ID embeddings plus dense content embeddings. Input signals: User sequences of 500 to 5000 actions in experiments and about 400 per source online; Ad, user-ad and context features; Dense content embeddings from LLaMA-based and multimodal content-understanding models.
gold_zh: ID 与 token 化：ID embedding 加稠密内容 embedding。 输入特征：实验中的用户序列为 500 到 5000 个行为，线上每个来源约 400 个；广告、用户与广告交叉以及上下文特征；来自基于 LLaMA 和多模态内容理解模型的稠密内容 embedding。

q_en: What is MPZCH, in one sentence?
q_zh: MPZCH 一句话是什么？
gold_en: MPZCH removes embedding-table collisions with linear probing and TTL eviction; at Meta it reached zero collisions for 150M users and +0.83% impressions for new videos.
gold_zh: MPZCH 用线性探测加 TTL 淘汰消除嵌入表冲突；在 Meta 对 1.5 亿用户实现零冲突，新视频曝光 +0.83%。

q_en: Who built MPZCH and where does it run?
q_zh: MPZCH 是谁做的，用在哪里？
gold_en: MPZCH comes from Meta, 2026. Deployed in: Video Late-Stage Ranking and an HSTU video retrieval model at Meta.
gold_zh: MPZCH 来自 Meta，2026 年。上线位置：Meta 的视频后期排序模型与 HSTU 视频检索模型。

q_en: What is the core idea of MPZCH?
q_zh: MPZCH 的核心思路是什么？
gold_en: Track the ID occupying every slot and probe linearly, evicting expired entries with a full state reset, so each user and item keeps its own fresh embedding.
gold_zh: 记录每个槽位的占用 ID 并线性探测，淘汰过期条目时整体重置状态，让每个用户和物品保有自己的新鲜嵌入。

q_en: What results does MPZCH report?
q_zh: MPZCH 报告了哪些结果？
gold_en: Collision study, Table 1, on 150 million unique user IDs: the Sigrid hash baseline keeps a 13.61% collision rate even at 3.33x capacity, while MPZCH reaches a 0.0000% collision rate at 1.33x capacity with probe depth 256, where Sigrid retains 29.65%, and at 2.0x capacity with probe depth 64, where Sigrid retains 21.31%; at probe depth 8 and 1.00x capacity it sits at 12.09% versus Sigrid 36.79%. Kernel benchmark, Table 2: batched HBM or CUDA latency stays at 0.8 to 0.9 ms for probe depths 8 through 512, UVM batched 4.4 ms, CPU or DRAM batched 6.1 to 8.9 ms and non-batched 94.2 to 102.7 ms. User embeddings, Table 3: deploying MPZCH in the production Video Late-Stage Ranking model improved Normalized Entropy in 14 of 17 prediction tasks with 3 neutral, including Video View Duration +0.38%, Video View Percentage 100 +0.12% and Skip +0.12%, gains the paper calls statistically significant given years of prior optimization. Item embeddings, Sec 4.2: in the HSTU-based video retrieval model with 24-hour Post ID and 72-hour Owner ID TTLs, A/B testing yielded 0.83% more impressions for new videos posted within 48 hours; intra-creator embedding similarity rose from 0.66% to 0.91% same day and same-and-next day, +38%, and overall from 0.62% to 0.77%, +25%.
gold_zh: 冲突研究，表 1，1.5 亿唯一用户 ID：Sigrid 哈希基线在 3.33 倍容量下仍有 13.61% 冲突率，MPZCH 在 1.33 倍容量、探测深度 256 时冲突率为 0.0000%，此时 Sigrid 为 29.65%；在 2.0 倍容量、深度 64 时同样 0.0000%，此时 Sigrid 为 21.31%；深度 8 且 1.00 倍容量时为 12.09%，Sigrid 为 36.79%。内核基准见表 2：HBM 即 CUDA 批处理延迟在深度 8 到 512 间保持 0.8 到 0.9 毫秒，UVM 批处理 4.4 毫秒，CPU 即 DRAM 批处理 6.1 到 8.9 毫秒、非批处理 94.2 到 102.7 毫秒。用户嵌入见表 3：在生产视频后期排序模型部署 MPZCH 后，17 个预测任务中 14 个 Normalized Entropy 改善、3 个持平，含视频观看时长 +0.38%、视频观看完成率 100 +0.12%、跳过 +0.12%，论文称鉴于该模型已经多年迭代优化，这些提升具有统计显著性。物品嵌入见 4.2 节：在 Post ID 24 小时、Owner ID 72 小时 TTL 的 HSTU 视频检索模型中，A/B 使 48 小时内发布的新视频曝光提升 0.83%；同一创作者视频嵌入相似度从 0.66% 升至 0.91%，当天与次日均 +38%，总体从 0.62% 升至 0.77% 即 +25%。

q_en: Does MPZCH have online evidence, and how long was the A/B?
q_zh: MPZCH 有线上证据吗，A/B 做了多久？
gold_en: Online evidence: Online numbers. A/B duration: not reported. A/B traffic: not reported.
gold_zh: 线上证据：有线上数据。A/B 时长：未报告。A/B 流量：未报告。

q_en: What should I keep in mind when reading the results of MPZCH?
q_zh: 读 MPZCH 的结果时要注意什么？
gold_en: The A/B traffic share, duration and significance levels are not reported. The paper notes that MPZCH requires table capacity to exceed ID cardinality and a sufficient probe depth, for example 512, to guarantee zero collisions.
gold_zh: 未报告 A/B 流量占比、时长与显著性水平。 论文说明 MPZCH 需要表容量超过 ID 基数并配合足够探测深度如 512 才能保证零冲突。

q_en: What scale does MPZCH report?
q_zh: MPZCH 报告了哪些规模信息？
gold_en: User deployment: Video Late-Stage Ranking model serving about 3 billion monthly active users. User embedding table: 4 billion rows. Collision study: 150 million unique user IDs.
gold_zh: 用户侧部署：服务约 30 亿月活用户的视频后期排序模型。 用户嵌入表：40 亿行。 冲突研究：1.5 亿唯一用户 ID。

q_en: What serving latency, QPS, cost or hardware does MPZCH report?
q_zh: MPZCH 报告了怎样的服务延迟、QPS、成本和硬件？
gold_en: Serving latency: Batched HBM or CUDA kernel 0.8 to 0.9 ms flat across probe depths 8 to 512; probe depth has negligible latency impact. Serving QPS: Training QPS maintained comparable to existing methods through input feature deduplication. Inference cost: Published model drops the metadata tensor and freezes identities read-only; auxiliary tensors add the identities tensor to model size. Hardware: not reported.
gold_zh: 服务延迟：HBM 即 CUDA 批处理内核在深度 8 到 512 下为 0.8 到 0.9 毫秒；探测深度对延迟影响可忽略。 服务 QPS：通过输入特征去重，训练 QPS 与既有方法保持相当。 推理成本：发布模型剔除元数据张量并冻结身份只读；辅助张量为模型增加身份张量的体积。 硬件：未报告。

q_en: What is Mine-Then-Train, in one sentence?
q_zh: Mine-Then-Train 一句话是什么？
gold_en: Mines multimodally interpretable triplets from CTR clicks and fine-tunes the SCL encoder for Taobao display advertising; long-term A/B gives CTR +1.5% and RPM +0.5%.
gold_zh: 从 CTR 点击中挖掘多模态可解释三元组并微调 SCL 编码器服务淘宝展示广告；长期 A/B 给出 CTR +1.5%、RPM +0.5%。

q_en: Who built Mine-Then-Train and where does it run?
q_zh: Mine-Then-Train 是谁做的，用在哪里？
gold_en: Mine-Then-Train comes from Alibaba Taobao & Tmall Group, 2026. Deployed in: Taobao display advertising CTR prediction.
gold_zh: Mine-Then-Train 来自 阿里巴巴淘天集团，2026 年。上线位置：淘宝展示广告 CTR 预测。

q_en: What is the core idea of Mine-Then-Train?
q_zh: Mine-Then-Train 的核心思路是什么？
gold_en: Mine multimodally interpretable click triplets from CTR data first, then fine-tune the multimodal encoder on them so its representations match click preferences.
gold_zh: 先从 CTR 数据挖掘多模态可解释点击三元组，再用它们微调多模态编码器，让表征对齐点击偏好。

q_en: What results does Mine-Then-Train report?
q_zh: Mine-Then-Train 报告了哪些结果？
gold_en: Deployment, Sec 6.3: Native Multimodal Representation entered Taobao's display advertising system in early 2026 and a long-term A/B test showed a 1.5% CTR improvement and a 0.5% RPM improvement, restated in the conclusion. Offline, Sec 6.2 Table 6, relative lifts over the baseline that already includes SCL representations: adding annotation-model scores gives GAUC +0.13% and AUC +0.08%, and the full NMRL method gives GAUC +0.22% and AUC +0.11%. Diagnosis of the rejected end-to-end alternative: Sec 3.2 Figure 2 shows the E2EM encoder drops GAUC below the production SCL encoder; Sec 3.3 Table 1 on the Taobao-MM benchmark gives GAUC 0.6154 for the frozen MUSE baseline, 0.6139 for target-side E2EM, 0.6128 with LEMUR's memory bank and 0.6124 for target-and-sequence E2EM; Sec 3.3 Table 2 shows no optimizer or learning rate choice among SGD, Adam and AdamW at 2e-3 to 2e-5 beats 0.6154. Sec 4.1 Table 3 measures that multimodal similarity alone predicts clicks only slightly above random, MultiModal-Mean GAUC 0.541 and MultiModal-Max GAUC 0.536; Sec 4.2 Table 4 finds E2EM gradient cosine similarities of 0.016 and 0.006 against 0.144 and 0.849 for SCL, and Sec 4.2 reports that adding SCL loss to co-training drops CTR GAUC by 0.17 percentage points and SCL Top-1 accuracy by 5 pt. Mining quality, Sec 5.2: the annotation score alone lifts GAUC by 0.13%, and human voting on triplets with annotation-score margin above 0.15 versus below 0.05 gives Item 1 win rates of 85% versus 42%.
gold_zh: 部署见 6.3 节：原生多模态表征于 2026 年初进入淘宝展示广告系统，长期 A/B 测试显示 CTR 提升 1.5%、RPM 提升 0.5%，结论部分重述。离线见 6.2 节表 6，相对已含 SCL 表征的基线：接入标注模型打分 GAUC +0.13%、AUC +0.08%，完整 NMRL 方法 GAUC +0.22%、AUC +0.11%。对被否决的端到端方案的诊断：3.2 节图 2 显示 E2EM 编码器的 GAUC 掉到生产 SCL 编码器之下；3.3 节表 1 在 Taobao-MM 基准上，冻结 MUSE 基线 GAUC 0.6154，target 侧 E2EM 0.6139，加 LEMUR 的 memory bank 0.6128，target 与序列双侧 E2EM 0.6124；3.3 节表 2 显示 SGD、Adam、AdamW 配 2e-3 到 2e-5 的学习率没有任何组合超过 0.6154。4.1 节表 3 量得多模态相似度单独预测点击只略高于随机，MultiModal-Mean GAUC 0.541、MultiModal-Max GAUC 0.536；4.2 节表 4 发现 E2EM 的梯度余弦相似度为 0.016 和 0.006，而 SCL 为 0.144 和 0.849；4.2 节还报告共训引入 SCL 损失后 CTR GAUC 掉 0.17 个百分点、SCL Top-1 准确率掉 5 个百分点。挖掘质量见 5.2 节：标注打分单独接入即带来 GAUC +0.13%，对标注分差 0.15 以上与 0.05 以下的三元组人工投票，物品 1 胜率分别为 85% 与 42%。

q_en: Does Mine-Then-Train have online evidence, and how long was the A/B?
q_zh: Mine-Then-Train 有线上证据吗，A/B 做了多久？
gold_en: Online evidence: Online numbers. A/B duration: not reported. A/B traffic: not reported.
gold_zh: 线上证据：有线上数据。A/B 时长：未报告。A/B 流量：未报告。

q_en: What should I keep in mind when reading the results of Mine-Then-Train?
q_zh: 读 Mine-Then-Train 的结果时要注意什么？
gold_en: The paper describes the online evaluation only as a long-term A/B test; no traffic share, bucket design or duration is given. The paper's stated limitations of the annotation model are that click-relevance scores can be inaccurate for some item pairs because it is trained directly on CTR data, and that preferences are learned solely through SID embeddings whose learning resembles ID-style memorization without direct access to raw multimodal content, limiting generalization.
gold_zh: 论文对线上评估只说长期 A/B 测试；未给流量占比、分桶设计或持续时长。 论文自己说明标注模型的两点局限：直接在 CTR 数据上训练使部分物品对的点击相关性打分可能不准；偏好只经 SID embedding 学习，机制近似 ID 式记忆、接触不到物品原始多模态内容，泛化受限。

q_en: What does the source of Mine-Then-Train not report?
q_zh: Mine-Then-Train 的原文有哪些没有报告？
gold_en: The source does not report: A/B traffic share, bucket count and test duration; Training compute, GPU counts and fine-tuning duration of the proposed method; Serving latency, QPS and hardware of the display advertising system; Absolute AUC and GAUC values of the NMRL experiments, reported only as relative lifts; Inference cost change of the updated encoder in production.
gold_zh: 原文没有报告：A/B 流量占比、分桶数与测试时长；所提方法的训练算力、GPU 数量与微调时长；展示广告系统的服务延迟、QPS 与硬件；NMRL 实验的绝对 AUC 与 GAUC，论文只给相对提升；更新后编码器在生产中的推理成本变化。

q_en: Which stages of the pipeline does Mine-Then-Train cover?
q_zh: Mine-Then-Train 覆盖链路的哪些阶段？
gold_en: Ranking: ID-based CTR prediction model of Taobao display advertising, MUSE in the E2EM study and the newer production model cited as EST in the NMRL experiments, consuming SCL multimodal representations through SimTier, SA-TA similarity features and linear-layer direct fusion.
gold_zh: 精排：淘宝展示广告基于 ID 的 CTR 预测模型，E2EM 研究用 MUSE，NMRL 实验用引用为 EST 的更新版生产模型，通过 SimTier、SA-TA 相似度特征与线性层直接融合消费 SCL 多模态表征。

q_en: What is MixFormer, in one sentence?
q_zh: MixFormer 一句话是什么？
gold_en: Unified Transformer-style ranker co-scaling dense features and user sequences at Douyin; offline AUC above STCA to RankMixer; UI-decoupled variant cuts FLOPs ~36%; A/B on Douyin and Douyin Lite.
gold_zh: 抖音统一的 Transformer 风格排序模型，同步扩展稠密特征和用户序列；离线 AUC 高于 STCA to RankMixer；用户与 item 解耦的变体让 FLOPs 降低约 36%；已在抖音和抖音极速版做 A/B。

q_en: Who built MixFormer and where does it run?
q_zh: MixFormer 是谁做的，用在哪里？
gold_en: MixFormer comes from ByteDance, 2026. Deployed in: Douyin and Douyin Lite feed ranking, A/B tested.
gold_zh: MixFormer 来自 字节跳动，2026 年。上线位置：抖音和抖音极速版信息流排序，已做 A/B 测试。

q_en: What is the core idea of MixFormer?
q_zh: MixFormer 的核心思路是什么？
gold_en: One backbone mixes feature interaction and sequence modeling in a single parameter space.
gold_zh: 一个骨干在同一个参数空间里混合特征交互和序列建模。

q_en: What results does MixFormer report?
q_zh: MixFormer 报告了哪些结果？
gold_en: Offline (Table 1, relative to TA to DLRM baseline AUC 0.8554 Finish / 0.8124 Skip): MixFormer-medium +1.28% Finish AUC, +1.60% Finish UAUC, +1.60% Skip AUC, +2.46% Skip UAUC with 1,226M dense params and 3,503 GFLOPs/batch; STCA to RankMixer +1.12% / +1.40% / +1.43% / +2.14% with 1,255M and 6,736 GFLOPs; UI-MixFormer-medium has the same accuracy at 2,242 GFLOPs (about 36% fewer FLOPs). Online A/B for two weeks vs the deployed STCA to RankMixer baseline per Table 2: Douyin overall Active Day +0.0415%, Duration +0.2799%, Like +0.1766%, Finish +0.3897%, Comment +0.7035%; Douyin Lite overall Active Day +0.0252%, Duration +0.4105%, Like +0.2125%, Finish +0.2924%, Comment +1.9097%. Paper states all are significant and not yet converged.
gold_zh: 离线见表 1，相对 TA to DLRM 基线，基线的 AUC 为 Finish 0.8554、Skip 0.8124：MixFormer-medium 的 Finish AUC +1.28%，Finish UAUC +1.60%，Skip AUC +1.60%，Skip UAUC +2.46%，稠密参数 1,226M，每个 batch 3,503 GFLOPs；STCA to RankMixer 为 +1.12%、+1.40%、+1.43%、+2.14%，参数 1,255M，6,736 GFLOPs；UI-MixFormer-medium 精度相同，只需 2,242 GFLOPs，FLOPs 约减少 36%。两周线上 A/B，对比线上的 STCA to RankMixer 基线，见表 2：抖音整体活跃天数 +0.0415%，时长 +0.2799%，点赞 +0.1766%，完播 +0.3897%，评论 +0.7035%；抖音极速版整体活跃天数 +0.0252%，时长 +0.4105%，点赞 +0.2125%，完播 +0.2924%，评论 +1.9097%。论文称所有指标都显著，且尚未收敛。

q_en: Does MixFormer have online evidence, and how long was the A/B?
q_zh: MixFormer 有线上证据吗，A/B 做了多久？
gold_en: Online evidence: Online numbers. A/B duration: Two weeks. A/B traffic: not reported.
gold_zh: 线上证据：有线上数据。A/B 时长：两周。A/B 流量：未报告。

q_en: What should I keep in mind when reading the results of MixFormer?
q_zh: 读 MixFormer 的结果时要注意什么？
gold_en: Table 2 reports relative improvements only, with no confidence intervals, traffic share or launch status; the paper says A/B experiments were run, not that MixFormer replaced the production ranker. The offline dataset is Douyin-internal; the paper evaluates no public dataset.
gold_zh: 表 2 只报告相对提升，没有置信区间、流量占比或上线状态；论文说做了 A/B 实验，但没有说 MixFormer 已取代线上排序模型。 离线数据集是抖音内部的；论文没有在公开数据集上评估。

q_en: How is MixFormer trained?
q_zh: MixFormer 是怎么训练的？
gold_en: Training mode: Offline training on Douyin logs in a hybrid framework, with the sparse part async on Adagrad and the dense part sync on RMSProp at lr 0.01. Objectives: CTR-style binary classification for Finish and Skip tasks (AUC, UAUC).
gold_zh: 训练方式：在抖音日志上以混合框架做离线训练，稀疏部分用 Adagrad 异步更新，稠密部分用 RMSProp 同步更新，lr 为 0.01。 训练目标：Finish 和 Skip 任务的 CTR 风格二分类，指标为 AUC 和 UAUC。

q_en: Is there code for MixFormer?
q_zh: MixFormer 有代码吗？
gold_en: Code status: Third-party code only.
gold_zh: 代码状态：仅有第三方代码。

q_en: What is NextGen, in one sentence?
q_zh: NextGen 一句话是什么？
gold_en: Taobao's NextGen is a full-candidate autoregressive re-ranker; 14-day 5% A/B on Miaosha vs the prior generative re-ranker Sort-gen: GMV +18.85%, orders +12.35%.
gold_zh: 淘宝 NextGen 是一个全候选自回归重排模型；秒杀上对比此前的生成式重排模型 Sort-gen，做 14 天 5% A/B：GMV +18.85%，订单 +12.35%。

q_en: Who built NextGen and where does it run?
q_zh: NextGen 是谁做的，用在哪里？
gold_en: NextGen comes from Alibaba Taobao & Tmall Group, 2026. Deployed in: Taobao Miaosha re-ranking, tested on 5% of traffic.
gold_zh: NextGen 来自 阿里巴巴淘天集团，2026 年。上线位置：淘宝秒杀重排，在 5% 流量上测试。

q_en: What is the core idea of NextGen?
q_zh: NextGen 的核心思路是什么？
gold_en: An encoder-decoder builds the page by choosing items one at a time from the full candidate set under several business objectives.
gold_zh: Encoder-decoder 模型在多个业务目标下，每次从全候选集中选一个 item，逐步构建页面。

q_en: What results does NextGen report?
q_zh: NextGen 报告了哪些结果？
gold_en: Online 14-day A/B on 5% of Miaosha traffic, all lifts significant at p < 0.01. Against the deployed generative re-ranker Sort-gen, NextGen gives GMV +18.85%, order volume +12.35%, CTR +18.77% and visit-to-purchase rate +11.78%. Against the RULE baseline, NextGen gives GMV +24.73%, order volume +15.61%, CTR +20.08% and visit-to-purchase rate +14.84%. A 14-day A/A test showed no significant difference. Offline, average CTR AUC is 0.8123 and CVR AUC 0.8433 for NextGen against 0.7705 and 0.7739 for Sort-gen.
gold_zh: 在 5% 秒杀流量上做 14 天线上 A/B，所有提升在 p < 0.01 下显著。对比线上的生成式重排模型 Sort-gen，NextGen 的 GMV +18.85%，订单量 +12.35%，CTR +18.77%，访问购买率 +11.78%。对比 RULE 基线，NextGen 的 GMV +24.73%，订单量 +15.61%，CTR +20.08%，访问购买率 +14.84%。14 天的 A/A 测试没有显著差异。离线结果：NextGen 的平均 CTR AUC 为 0.8123，CVR AUC 为 0.8433；Sort-gen 分别为 0.7705 和 0.7739。

q_en: Does NextGen have online evidence, and how long was the A/B?
q_zh: NextGen 有线上证据吗，A/B 做了多久？
gold_en: Online evidence: Online numbers. A/B duration: 14 days. A/B traffic: 5% of traffic.
gold_zh: 线上证据：有线上数据。A/B 时长：14 天。A/B 流量：5% 流量。

q_en: What should I keep in mind when reading the results of NextGen?
q_zh: 读 NextGen 的结果时要注意什么？
gold_en: The headline gains are against Sort-gen, an earlier method from the same team, as redeployed under a new diversity constraint; the paper notes Sort-gen numbers differ from its original paper for that reason. NextGen scores the top 100 candidates while Sort-gen scored the top 30, and the authors state that this pool effect is not separated in an online test.
gold_zh: 主要提升是相对 Sort-gen 得到的，它是同一团队更早的方法，并在新的多样性约束下重新部署；论文指出，Sort-gen 的数字因此与其原始论文不同。 NextGen 对前 100 个候选打分，而 Sort-gen 只对前 30 个打分，作者说明，这种候选池的影响没有在线上测试中被单独分离出来。

q_en: Is there code for NextGen?
q_zh: NextGen 有代码吗？
gold_en: Code status: No code found.
gold_zh: 代码状态：未发现公开代码。

q_en: What inputs does NextGen use?
q_zh: NextGen 用了哪些输入？
