gold_en: IDs and tokenization: No semantic IDs; item ID embeddings plus frozen TBStar multimodal LLM embeddings. Input signals: User ID, device type and temporal features; Candidate item IDs, categories, brands and historical CTR and CVR; Upstream ranking CTR and CVR scores and position; Frozen LLM semantic embeddings of title and image; Historical click sequence and logged exposure sequence.
gold_zh: ID 与 token 化：不使用 Semantic ID；item ID embedding 加冻结的 TBStar 多模态大模型 embedding。 输入特征：用户 ID、设备类型和时间特征；候选 item 的 ID、类目、品牌以及历史 CTR 和 CVR；上游排序的 CTR 和 CVR 分数以及位置；标题和图片的冻结大模型语义 embedding；历史点击序列和曝光日志序列。

q_en: What is OneMall, in one sentence?
q_zh: OneMall 一句话是什么？
gold_en: OneMall unifies Kuaishou e-commerce retrieval with a business-aware Semantic ID tokenizer, a sparse MoE decoder and ranking-reward RL; A/B lifts GMV up to +14.71% and serves over 400 million DAU.
gold_zh: OneMall 用业务感知语义 ID 分词器加 Sparse MoE 解码器与排序奖励 RL 统一快手电商检索；A/B 使 GMV 最高提升 +14.71%，服务超 4 亿日活。

q_en: Who built OneMall and where does it run?
q_zh: OneMall 是谁做的，用在哪里？
gold_en: OneMall comes from Kuaishou, 2026. Deployed in: Kuaishou e-commerce candidate generation across Product-Card, Short-Video and Live-Streaming.
gold_zh: OneMall 来自 快手，2026 年。上线位置：快手电商的商品卡、短视频、直播场景候选生成。

q_en: What is the core idea of OneMall?
q_zh: OneMall 的核心思路是什么？
gold_en: Tokenize items into three-level business-aware Semantic IDs, generate candidates with a sparse MoE decoder, and train the retriever against ranking-model rewards with DPO and GRPO.
gold_zh: 把物品编码成业务感知的三级语义 ID，用 Sparse MoE 解码器生成候选，再以排序模型奖励经 DPO 与 GRPO 训练检索器。

q_en: Does OneMall have online evidence, and how long was the A/B?
q_zh: OneMall 有线上证据吗，A/B 做了多久？
gold_en: Online evidence: Online numbers. A/B duration: not reported. A/B traffic: not reported.
gold_zh: 线上证据：有线上数据。A/B 时长：未报告。A/B 流量：未报告。

q_en: What should I keep in mind when reading the results of OneMall?
q_zh: 读 OneMall 的结果时要注意什么？
gold_en: The paper does not name the online control arm and gives no A/B traffic share or duration. Table 4 states neither offline nor online measurement for its CTR, CTCVR, GPM and Reward figures.
gold_zh: 论文未指名线上对照臂，也没给 A/B 流量占比与时长。 表 4 未注明 CTR、CTCVR、GPM 与 Reward 数字属离线还是线上测量。

q_en: How is OneMall trained?
q_zh: OneMall 是怎么训练的？
gold_en: Training mode: Next-token-prediction pre-training followed by RL post-training, in streaming training aligned to the LLM pre-train and post-train recipe; the online ranking model serves as the reward model. Objectives: Autoregressive next-item Semantic ID generation as the main objective; Two-tower style in-batch contrastive task as the auxiliary objective, on the final Semantic ID state against the item embedding, reaching over 98% accuracy@1; DPO and GRPO policy optimization against the fused ranking reward, with loss weight NTP plus 0.5 times RL.
gold_zh: 训练方式：先下一 token 预测预训练、再 RL 后训练，流式训练，整体对齐 LLM 预训练加后训练范式；线上排序模型充当奖励模型。 训练目标：自回归下一物品语义 ID 生成为主目标；双塔式批内对比任务作辅助目标，用最终语义 ID 状态对物品向量，accuracy@1 超 98%；以融合排序奖励为信号做 DPO 与 GRPO 策略优化，损失权重为 NTP 加 0.5 倍 RL。

q_en: Is there code for OneMall?
q_zh: OneMall 有代码吗？
gold_en: Code status: No code found.
gold_zh: 代码状态：未发现公开代码。

q_en: What inputs does OneMall use?
q_zh: OneMall 用了哪些输入？
gold_en: IDs and tokenization: Three-level Semantic IDs: two Res-Kmeans layers plus a 16-bit FSQ layer with a 4096 code, over LLM-aligned item embeddings, extending QARM's Res-Kmeans into ResKmeansFSQ. Input signals: Exposure, Click and Buy behavior sequences, each compressed by its own Query-Former; Item-side attributes such as product category, price and shop information, fed to an item tower for the auxiliary contrastive task; Multimodal tokenizer inputs: product main image 224*224 and title; short-video sample 6 frames 224*224 with title, OCR and ASR; Real-time selling-product Semantic IDs as an additional feature for live-streaming items; Ranking-model outputs CTR, CTCVR and EGPM fused into the RL reward.
gold_zh: ID 与 token 化：三级语义 ID：两层 Res-Kmeans 加一层 16 比特 FSQ、末层 4096 码，量化对象是 LLM 对齐的物品向量，沿 QARM 的 Res-Kmeans 扩展成 ResKmeansFSQ。 输入特征：曝光、点击、购买行为序列，各由一个 Query-Former 压缩；物品侧属性，如商品类目、价格、店铺信息，进物品塔做辅助对比任务；分词器的多模态输入：商品主图 224*224 加标题；短视频抽 6 帧画面 224*224 加标题、OCR 与 ASR；直播物品的实时在售商品语义 ID 附加特征；排序模型输出的 CTR、CTCVR、EGPM 融合成 RL 奖励。

q_en: What is QuaSID, in one sentence?
q_zh: QuaSID 一句话是什么？
gold_en: Kuaishou's QuaSID learns semantic IDs that repel only genuinely colliding items; 5% traffic, 5-day A/B on e-commerce: ranking GMV-S2 +2.38%, cold-start retrieval completed orders up to +6.42%.
gold_zh: 快手 QuaSID 学习 Semantic ID，只排斥真正发生冲突的 item；电商 5% 流量、5 天 A/B：排序 GMV-S2 +2.38%，冷启动召回成交订单最高 +6.42%。

q_en: Who built QuaSID and where does it run?
q_zh: QuaSID 是谁做的，用在哪里？
gold_en: QuaSID comes from Kuaishou, 2026. Deployed in: Kuaishou e-commerce recommendation, in generative retrieval, discriminative retrieval and ranking.
gold_zh: QuaSID 来自 快手，2026 年。上线位置：快手电商推荐，用于生成式召回、判别式召回和排序。

q_en: What is the core idea of QuaSID?
q_zh: QuaSID 的核心思路是什么？
gold_en: A semantic-ID tokenizer pushes apart only the item pairs whose code collisions are real conflicts, scaled by severity.
gold_zh: Semantic ID 分词器只推开那些码冲突属于真实冲突的 item 对，并按严重程度缩放。

q_en: What results does QuaSID report?
q_zh: QuaSID 报告了哪些结果？
gold_en: In a 5-day A/B on about 5% of Kuaishou e-commerce traffic, over 20 million users, all results significant, replacing the tokenizer with QuaSID gives in generative retrieval completed orders +0.21%, GMV-S1 +1.03% and GMV-S2 +0.55%, and in ranking GMV-S2 +2.38%, GMV-S1 +1.44% and completed orders +0.20%. On cold-start retrieval, completed orders rise +6.42% for videos under 100 views and +4.69% under 600 views, and retrieval overall gains +1.09% completed orders and +1.69% GMV. Offline on Amazon Beauty with the TIGER backbone, HR@10 is 0.0392 against 0.0379 for RQ-Kmeans and 0.0300 for RQ-VAE, and NDCG@10 is 0.0230 against 0.0211; the paper reports 5.9% better top-K ranking quality than the best baseline. Adding the repulsion loss to other tokenizers lifts NDCG@10 by up to 15.3% on Beauty and 20.1% on Toys.
gold_zh: 在快手电商约 5% 流量、超过两千万用户上做 5 天 A/B，所有结果显著；把分词器换成 QuaSID 后，生成式召回的成交订单 +0.21%，GMV-S1 +1.03%，GMV-S2 +0.55%；排序的 GMV-S2 +2.38%，GMV-S1 +1.44%，成交订单 +0.20%。冷启动召回上，观看次数不足 100 的视频成交订单 +6.42%，不足 600 的 +4.69%；召回整体成交订单 +1.09%，GMV +1.69%。在 Amazon Beauty 上用 TIGER 骨干做离线实验，HR@10 为 0.0392，RQ-Kmeans 为 0.0379，RQ-VAE 为 0.0300；NDCG@10 为 0.0230，对比 0.0211；论文称 top-K 排序质量比最佳基线高 5.9%。把排斥损失加到其他分词器上，NDCG@10 在 Beauty 上最多提升 15.3%，在 Toys 上最多提升 20.1%。

q_en: Does QuaSID have online evidence, and how long was the A/B?
q_zh: QuaSID 有线上证据吗，A/B 做了多久？
gold_en: Online evidence: Online numbers. A/B duration: 5 days. A/B traffic: About 5% of traffic, over 20 million users.
gold_zh: 线上证据：有线上数据。A/B 时长：5 天。A/B 流量：约 5% 流量，超过两千万用户。

q_en: What should I keep in mind when reading the results of QuaSID?
q_zh: 读 QuaSID 的结果时要注意什么？
gold_en: The online control is the same stack with its previous tokenizer, which the paper does not name. The arXiv v1 PDF used here carries a template conference placeholder, so it is not confirmed as the camera-ready KDD text; the DOI is registered.
gold_zh: 线上对照组是同一条链路加上它此前的分词器，论文没有说明是哪一个。 这里使用的 arXiv v1 PDF 带有模板会议占位符，因此无法确认它就是 KDD 定稿版文本；DOI 已注册。

q_en: What serving latency, QPS, cost or hardware does QuaSID report?
q_zh: QuaSID 报告了怎样的服务延迟、QPS、成本和硬件？
gold_en: Serving latency: not reported. Serving QPS: not reported. Inference cost: not reported. Hardware: not reported.
gold_zh: 服务延迟：未报告。 服务 QPS：未报告。 推理成本：未报告。 硬件：未报告。

q_en: How is QuaSID trained?
q_zh: QuaSID 是怎么训练的？
gold_en: Training mode: Offline periodic training of the tokenizer, then application in retrieval and ranking. Objectives: Reconstruction and residual quantization; Hamming-guided margin repulsion; Dual-tower contrastive loss.
gold_zh: 训练方式：离线周期性训练分词器，再应用到召回和排序中。 训练目标：重建和残差量化；Hamming 引导的 margin 排斥；双塔对比损失。

q_en: What is RQ-Reg, in one sentence?
q_zh: RQ-Reg 一句话是什么？
gold_en: RQ-Reg turns GMV prediction into coarse-to-fine code generation; a 7-day 10% A/B on Kuaishou ads lifted advertiser value +4.19% and long-tail +4.76%.
gold_zh: RQ-Reg 把 GMV 预测变成粗到细码生成；快手广告 7 天 10% A/B 广告主价值 +4.19%、长尾 +4.76%。

q_en: Who built RQ-Reg and where does it run?
q_zh: RQ-Reg 是谁做的，用在哪里？
gold_en: RQ-Reg comes from Kuaishou, 2026. Deployed in: Kuaishou advertising ranker, GMV prediction model.
gold_zh: RQ-Reg 来自 快手，2026 年。上线位置：快手广告排序器的 GMV 预测模型。

q_en: What is the core idea of RQ-Reg?
q_zh: RQ-Reg 的核心思路是什么？
gold_en: Decompose a continuous target into coarse-to-fine quantization codes and generate them autoregressively, with an ordinal objective keeping code embeddings continuous.
gold_zh: 把连续目标分解为粗到细的量化码并自回归生成，用序数目标让码嵌入保持连续。

q_en: What results does RQ-Reg report?
q_zh: RQ-Reg 报告了哪些结果？
gold_en: Online A/B, Table 7, seven days at 10% per arm against the WLR production baseline: overall AUC +0.12% and advertiser value ADVV +4.19%; on long-tailed commodity prices AUC +0.23% and ADVV +4.76%. Figure 5 daily trajectory: ADVV gains stay consistent and statistically significant across days 1 to 7; on day 8 the experimental bucket switched back to WLR, and the A/A test on days 9 to 13 shows a clear drop in ADVV, which the paper offers as evidence the gains come from the model. Offline, Table 1 and Table 2: RQ-Reg compares favorably against regression, classification and ordinal baselines on watch-time and LTV benchmarks; Table 3 ablations show consistent degradation without the representation objective or scheduled sampling; Table 5: RQ K-means beats K-means and dynamic quantile; Table 6: reconstruction MAE 1.33e-3 against 3.28e-3 for dynamic quantile with shorter fixed code length; Figure 3: error and MAE decrease monotonically with RQ levels up to plateau at L 3 and above.
gold_zh: 线上 A/B 见表 7，每臂 10% 流量共七天，基线为 WLR 生产模型：整体 AUC +0.12%、广告主价值 ADVV +4.19%；长尾商品价位上 AUC +0.23%、ADVV +4.76%。图 5 逐日轨迹：第 1 至 7 天 ADVV 增益一致且统计显著；第 8 天实验桶切回 WLR，第 9 至 13 天 A/A 测试的 ADVV 明显回落，论文以此作为增益来自模型的证据。离线方面，表 1 与表 2：RQ-Reg 在观看时长与 LTV 基准上优于回归、分类与序数基线；表 3 消融显示去掉表示目标或计划采样一致退化；表 5：RQ K-means 胜过 K-means 与动态分位；表 6：重建 MAE 1.33e-3 对动态分位 3.28e-3 且码长更短固定；图 3：随 RQ 级数增加误差与 MAE 单调下降，L 至 3 后趋平。

q_en: Does RQ-Reg have online evidence, and how long was the A/B?
q_zh: RQ-Reg 有线上证据吗，A/B 做了多久？
gold_en: Online evidence: Online numbers. A/B duration: Seven days, followed by a 5-day A/A holdout after switching back. A/B traffic: 10% of traffic per arm, about 40 million unique users per model.
gold_zh: 线上证据：有线上数据。A/B 时长：七天，随后切回基线再做 5 天 A/A 留白。A/B 流量：每臂 10% 流量，每模型约 4000 万独立用户。

q_en: What should I keep in mind when reading the results of RQ-Reg?
q_zh: 读 RQ-Reg 的结果时要注意什么？
gold_en: The paper reports relative lifts over the production baseline; absolute AUC and ADVV values are not published. The A/B allocates 10% of traffic to each arm, matching arms at about 40 million users; bucket construction beyond that is not described.
gold_zh: 论文报告相对生产基线的提升；绝对 AUC 与 ADVV 值未公布。 A/B 每臂 10% 流量，两臂各约 4000 万用户；此之外的桶构造未描述。

q_en: Which stages of the pipeline does RQ-Reg cover?
q_zh: RQ-Reg 覆盖链路的哪些阶段？
gold_en: Ranking: GMV prediction model inside the two-stage advertising ranker, a 3 by 32 RQ codebook with an LSTM backbone, predicting a coarse-to-fine code sequence whose reconstruction is the GMV estimate.
gold_zh: 精排：两阶段广告排序器中的 GMV 预测模型：3×32 RQ 码本加 LSTM 骨干，预测粗到细码序列并重建为 GMV 估计。

q_en: What scale does RQ-Reg report?
q_zh: RQ-Reg 报告了哪些规模信息？
gold_en: Platform: Kuaishou short-video platform, over 400 million DAU, billions of daily impressions. A/B scale: 10% of traffic per arm, about 40 million unique users per model, seven days. Codebook: 3 RQ levels of 32 codes in the deployed configuration.
gold_zh: 平台：快手短视频平台，超 4 亿日活，日数十亿曝光。 A/B 规模：每臂 10% 流量，每模型约 4000 万独立用户，七天。 码本：部署配置为 3 层 RQ 每层 32 码。

q_en: What is RankGraph-2, in one sentence?
q_zh: RankGraph-2 一句话是什么？
gold_en: Meta graph retrieval co-designing graph construction, GNN training and a learned cluster index; up to +0.96% CTR and +2.75% CVR in 14-day A/B tests, serving cost -83%, 20+ retrieval launches.
gold_zh: Meta 的图召回系统，联合设计图构建、GNN 训练和学习得到的聚类索引；14 天 A/B 中 CTR 最高 +0.96%，CVR 最高 +2.75%，在线服务成本 -83%，共 20+ 次召回上线。

q_en: Who built RankGraph-2 and where does it run?
q_zh: RankGraph-2 是谁做的，用在哪里？
gold_en: RankGraph-2 comes from Meta, 2026. Deployed in: U2I2I and U2U2I retrieval sources on two unnamed content recommendation surfaces.
gold_zh: RankGraph-2 来自 Meta，2026 年。上线位置：两个未具名内容推荐场景上的 U2I2I 和 U2U2I 召回源。

q_en: What is the core idea of RankGraph-2?
q_zh: RankGraph-2 的核心思路是什么？
gold_en: A heterogeneous co-engagement graph with a co-learned cluster index replaces online KNN.
gold_zh: 异构共同互动图加上联合学习的聚类索引，取代在线 KNN。

q_en: What results does RankGraph-2 report?
q_zh: RankGraph-2 报告了哪些结果？
gold_en: Online, from a 14-day A/B on two surfaces with RankGraph-2 added as a retrieval source and all results significant at p < 0.05: U2I2I CTR +0.96% / +0.33% and CVR +2.75% / +0.76% on Surface 1 / Surface 2; U2U2I CTR +0.40% / +0.20% and CVR +1.01% / +0.17%. Cluster index serving cost -83% vs online KNN at comparable CTR and CVR; 20+ retrieval launches. Offline (100K users, Table 2) Recall@5 0.143 vs 0.038 for GAT-DGI (3.8x) and 0.013 for HSTU; item embeddings per Table 3 Recall@100 0.775 vs 0.374 for PBG (2.1x) and 0.434 for HSTU. Index hitrate@1 0.846 vs 0.871 for original embeddings, 0.717 without regularization.
gold_zh: 线上结果来自两个场景上 14 天的 A/B，把 RankGraph-2 作为召回源加入，所有结果在 p < 0.05 下显著：场景 1 和场景 2 上，U2I2I 的 CTR 分别为 +0.96% 和 +0.33%，CVR 分别为 +2.75% 和 +0.76%；U2U2I 的 CTR 分别为 +0.40% 和 +0.20%，CVR 分别为 +1.01% 和 +0.17%。聚类索引的在线服务成本比在线 KNN 低 83%，CTR 和 CVR 相当；共 20+ 次召回上线。离线结果见表 2，100K 用户：Recall@5 为 0.143，GAT-DGI 为 0.038，即 3.8x，HSTU 为 0.013；item embedding 见表 3，Recall@100 为 0.775，PBG 为 0.374，即 2.1x，HSTU 为 0.434。索引 hitrate@1 为 0.846，原始 embedding 为 0.871，去掉正则为 0.717。

q_en: Does RankGraph-2 have online evidence, and how long was the A/B?
q_zh: RankGraph-2 有线上证据吗，A/B 做了多久？
gold_en: Online evidence: Online numbers. A/B duration: 14 days. A/B traffic: not reported.
gold_zh: 线上证据：有线上数据。A/B 时长：14 天。A/B 流量：未报告。

q_en: What should I keep in mind when reading the results of RankGraph-2?
q_zh: 读 RankGraph-2 的结果时要注意什么？
gold_en: Surfaces are anonymized as Surface 1 and Surface 2; absolute metric values are not given. Offline baselines are GAT-DGI, PyTorch-BigGraph and HSTU, evaluated on Meta internal data with samples of 100K users or 1,000 edges.
gold_zh: 两个场景被匿名为场景 1 和场景 2；没有给出指标的绝对值。 离线基线为 GAT-DGI、PyTorch-BigGraph 和 HSTU，在 Meta 内部数据上评估，样本为 100K 用户或 1,000 条边。

q_en: How is RankGraph-2 trained?
q_zh: RankGraph-2 是怎么训练的？
gold_en: Training mode: Continuous training on edge-centric data from a graph rebuilt every 3 hours from 24 hours of engagement. Objectives: Margin ranking loss plus InfoNCE (tau 0.06) per edge type, weighted by uncertainty weighting; Reconstruction loss, contrastive loss on reconstructed embeddings and code-imbalance regularization for the cluster index.
gold_zh: 训练方式：在每 3 小时用 24 小时互动数据重建一次的图上，基于以边为中心的数据持续训练。 训练目标：每种边类型各用 margin ranking loss 加 InfoNCE，tau 为 0.06，并用不确定性加权；聚类索引使用重建损失、对重建 embedding 的对比损失以及码不均衡正则。

q_en: Is there code for RankGraph-2?
q_zh: RankGraph-2 有代码吗？
gold_en: Code status: No code found.
gold_zh: 代码状态：未发现公开代码。

q_en: What is S-GRec, in one sentence?
q_zh: S-GRec 一句话是什么？
gold_en: Tencent's S-GRec trains a lightweight semantic-ID generator with an offline LLM judge and business-anchored RL; 5% WeChat Channels ad A/B: GMV +1.19%, CTR +1.16%.
gold_zh: 腾讯 S-GRec 用离线大模型评审和以业务为锚点的 RL，训练轻量的 Semantic ID 生成器；微信视频号广告 5% A/B：GMV +1.19%，CTR +1.16%。

q_en: Who built S-GRec and where does it run?
q_zh: S-GRec 是谁做的，用在哪里？
gold_en: S-GRec comes from Tencent, 2026. Deployed in: WeChat Channels advertising, tested online on 5% of ad traffic.
gold_zh: S-GRec 来自 腾讯，2026 年。上线位置：微信视频号广告，在 5% 广告流量上做过线上测试。

q_en: What is the core idea of S-GRec?
q_zh: S-GRec 的核心思路是什么？
gold_en: An offline LLM judge supplies semantic rewards while business rewards steer a lightweight semantic-ID generator.
gold_zh: 离线大模型评审提供语义奖励，业务奖励则引导轻量的 Semantic ID 生成器。

q_en: What results does S-GRec report?
q_zh: S-GRec 报告了哪些结果？
gold_en: Online A/B on 5% of WeChat Channels advertising traffic against the production baseline: GMV +1.19%, GMV-Normal +1.55%, CTR +1.16%, dislike rate -2.02%; a simulation environment first showed eCPM +5.5%. Offline on Amazon Industrial and Office against the MiniOneRec base model: Industrial HR@10 +2.9% and NDCG@10 +3.0%, Office HR@10 +3.4% and NDCG@10 +5.3%. Judge aspect scoring after GRPO reaches PairAUC 0.8116 and PointAcc 0.8687 on 1,000 held-out samples.
gold_zh: 在微信视频号 5% 广告流量上做线上 A/B，对比线上基线：GMV +1.19%，GMV-Normal +1.55%，CTR +1.16%，不喜欢率 -2.02%；此前在仿真环境中 eCPM +5.5%。在 Amazon Industrial 和 Office 上对比 MiniOneRec 基础模型的离线结果：Industrial 的 HR@10 +2.9%，NDCG@10 +3.0%；Office 的 HR@10 +3.4%，NDCG@10 +5.3%。在 1,000 个留出样本上，GRPO 之后评审模型的维度打分达到 PairAUC 0.8116 和 PointAcc 0.8687。

q_en: Does S-GRec have online evidence, and how long was the A/B?
q_zh: S-GRec 有线上证据吗，A/B 做了多久？
gold_en: Online evidence: Online numbers. A/B duration: not reported. A/B traffic: 5% of ad traffic.
gold_zh: 线上证据：有线上数据。A/B 时长：未报告。A/B 流量：5% 广告流量。

q_en: What should I keep in mind when reading the results of S-GRec?
q_zh: 读 S-GRec 的结果时要注意什么？
gold_en: The offline comparison uses the public Amazon Industrial and Office sets, not production data; the production A/B has no offline counterpart. The paper does not say the model was fully launched after the A/B.
gold_zh: 离线对比使用公开的 Amazon Industrial 和 Office 数据集，不是线上数据；线上 A/B 没有对应的离线结果。 论文没有说明模型在 A/B 之后是否已全量上线。

q_en: What inputs does S-GRec use?
q_zh: S-GRec 用了哪些输入？
gold_en: IDs and tokenization: Fixed-length semantic ID token sequence per ad, RQ-VAE tokenization. Input signals: User profile and long-term interests; Recent behavior sequence; Request-time context such as time and location; Ad exposure, click and conversion logs, used to build judge training data; eCPM as the business reward in the online deployment.
gold_zh: ID 与 token 化：每个广告对应一条定长 Semantic ID token 序列，使用 RQ-VAE tokenization。 输入特征：用户画像和长期兴趣；近期行为序列；请求时的上下文，如时间和位置；广告的曝光、点击和转化日志，用于构建评审模型的训练数据；线上部署中以 eCPM 作为业务奖励。

q_en: What does the source of S-GRec not report?
q_zh: S-GRec 的原文有哪些没有报告？
gold_en: The source does not report: production generator size; production semantic-ID codebook sizes; serving latency; whether the model was fully launched; A/B duration.
gold_zh: 原文没有报告：线上生成器规模；线上 Semantic ID 码本大小；在线延迟；模型是否已全量上线；A/B 时长。

q_en: What is SARM, in one sentence?
q_zh: SARM 一句话是什么？
gold_en: Kuaishou's SARM lets an offline multimodal LLM write semantic anchors for each live stream and trains them end to end inside the ranker; a two-week A/B shows Watch Time +0.962% on Kuaishou Lite.
gold_zh: 快手的 SARM 让离线多模态 LLM 为每个直播间写语义锚点，并在排序模型内端到端训练；两周 A/B 中快手极速版 Watch Time +0.962%。

q_en: Who built SARM and where does it run?
q_zh: SARM 是谁做的，用在哪里？
gold_en: SARM comes from Kuaishou, 2026. Deployed in: Kuaishou and Kuaishou Lite live-streaming ranking, key pages.
gold_zh: SARM 来自 快手，2026 年。上线位置：快手和快手极速版直播排序，关键页面。

q_en: What is the core idea of SARM?
q_zh: SARM 的核心思路是什么？
gold_en: Let an offline multimodal LLM write text anchors for each live stream, and train their encoder end to end inside the ranker, with a memory bank so nothing heavy runs per request.
gold_zh: 让离线多模态 LLM 为每个直播间写文字锚点，并在排序模型内端到端训练其编码器，再用 memory bank 保证每个请求都不用运行重计算。

q_en: What results does SARM report?
q_zh: SARM 报告了哪些结果？
gold_en: Offline, with the deployed HoME as the base ranker, CTR AUC and GAUC go from 0.8387 and 0.6453 to 0.8411 and 0.6485 with SARM, and LVTR AUC and GAUC from 0.8928 and 0.7542 to 0.8959 and 0.7580. The two-stage baselines with tags, SIDs, or MLLM embeddings from MMBee and SIM reach CTR AUC 0.8390, 0.8389, 0.8385 and 0.8394. Gated fusion after every layer was the best fusion variant, and the stratified analysis shows larger relative gains for low-exposure authors. Replacing the Qwen2.5-VL-7B anchors with Qwen3-VL-8B raises the CTR AUC increment over the base from +0.19% to +0.24%. A two-week online A/B on key pages reports, for Kuaishou, Exposure +0.424%, Watch Count +0.189%, Watch Time +0.092%, Click +0.982%, Gift +0.482%, Effective View +0.070% and Follow +0.805%; for Kuaishou Lite, Exposure +1.190%, Watch Count +0.397%, Watch Time +0.962%, Click +0.562%, Gift +1.287%, Effective View +0.340% and Follow +0.522%. Table 5 puts training CPU at 51.71% against 48.69% for the base, GPU at 80.29% against 77.54%, training time per pass at 1.08x, inference QPS at 271.30 against 280.71 and time per query at 1.02x, with no statistically significant degradation reported.
gold_zh: 离线，以线上的 HoME 为基础排序模型，SARM 把 CTR 的 AUC 和 GAUC 从 0.8387 和 0.6453 提高到 0.8411 和 0.6485，LVTR 的 AUC 和 GAUC 从 0.8928 和 0.7542 提高到 0.8959 和 0.7580。使用标签、SID 或 MMBee 与 SIM 的 MLLM embedding 的两阶段基线，CTR AUC 分别为 0.8390、0.8389、0.8385 和 0.8394。每一层之后做门控融合是最好的融合方式，分层分析显示低曝光主播的相对收益更大。把 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 锚点换成 Qwen3-VL-8B，相对基础模型的 CTR AUC 提升从 +0.19% 增加到 +0.24%。关键页面上为期两周的线上 A/B：快手的 Exposure +0.424%，Watch Count +0.189%，Watch Time +0.092%，Click +0.982%，Gift +0.482%，Effective View +0.070%，Follow +0.805%；快手极速版的 Exposure +1.190%，Watch Count +0.397%，Watch Time +0.962%，Click +0.562%，Gift +1.287%，Effective View +0.340%，Follow +0.522%。Table 5 中训练 CPU 利用率为 51.71%，基础模型为 48.69%；GPU 为 80.29%，基础模型为 77.54%；每轮训练时间为 1.08x；推理 QPS 为 271.30，基础模型为 280.71；每次查询时间为 1.02x，论文没有报告统计显著的退化。

q_en: Does SARM have online evidence, and how long was the A/B?
q_zh: SARM 有线上证据吗，A/B 做了多久？
gold_en: Online evidence: Online numbers. A/B duration: Two weeks. A/B traffic: not reported.
gold_zh: 线上证据：有线上数据。A/B 时长：两周。A/B 流量：未报告。

q_en: What should I keep in mind when reading the results of SARM?
q_zh: 读 SARM 的结果时要注意什么？
gold_en: The arXiv version read is a preprint in a placeholder ACM template, with the conference line still reading Conference acronym XX; the final CIKM 2026 text was not read. Online results are relative percentage changes against the production ranker over two weeks, with no traffic share, user count or confidence intervals given.
gold_zh: 读的 arXiv 版本是占位 ACM 模板下的预印本，会议行仍写着 Conference acronym XX，最终的 CIKM 2026 正文没有读。 线上结果是相对线上排序模型的相对百分比变化，周期两周，没有给出流量占比、用户数或置信区间。

q_en: What scale does SARM report?
q_zh: SARM 报告了哪些规模信息？
gold_en: Users served: over 400 million users daily. Semantic anchors per stream: six dimensions, POI, Theme, Topic, Target audience, Format and Scene. Encoder depth: four blocks.
gold_zh: 服务用户数：每天超过 4 亿用户。 每个直播间的语义锚点：六个维度，POI、Theme、Topic、Target audience、Format 和 Scene。 编码器深度：四个 block。

q_en: What serving latency, QPS, cost or hardware does SARM report?
q_zh: SARM 报告了怎样的服务延迟、QPS、成本和硬件？
gold_en: Serving latency: Time per query 1.02x of the base ranker, with no statistically significant degradation reported; absolute latency not reported. Serving QPS: Inference QPS 271.30 against 280.71 for the base ranker, in the units of Table 5. Inference cost: The memory bank turns author-side encoding into a constant-time lookup at inference; no LLM runs per request. Hardware: not reported.
gold_zh: 服务延迟：每次查询时间是基础排序模型的 1.02x，论文没有报告统计显著的退化；绝对延迟未报告。 服务 QPS：推理 QPS 为 271.30，基础排序模型为 280.71，单位按 Table 5。 推理成本：memory bank 让主播侧编码在推理时变成常数时间的查表，每个请求都不运行 LLM。 硬件：未报告。

q_en: What is SORT, in one sentence?
q_zh: SORT 一句话是什么？
gold_en: Alibaba International's SORT is a Transformer ranker with request-centric samples and generative pre-training; on AliExpress it gives orders +7.47%, GMV +8.65% and latency -62%.
gold_zh: 阿里国际的 SORT 是以请求为中心组织样本、带生成式预训练的 Transformer 排序模型；在 AliExpress 上订单 +7.47%，GMV +8.65%，延迟 -62%。

q_en: Who built SORT and where does it run?
q_zh: SORT 是谁做的，用在哪里？
gold_en: SORT comes from Alibaba International, 2026. Deployed in: AliExpress, all users, four main recommendation scenarios.
gold_zh: SORT 来自 Alibaba International，2026 年。上线位置：AliExpress，全部用户，四个主要推荐场景。

q_en: What is the core idea of SORT?
q_zh: SORT 的核心思路是什么？
gold_en: Rebuild the DLRM ranker as a Transformer over one request-centric sequence, and make it trainable with generative pre-training of frozen item embeddings.
gold_zh: 把 DLRM 排序模型重建为基于单条以请求为中心序列的 Transformer，并用冻结 item embedding 的生成式预训练让它能够稳定训练。

q_en: What results does SORT report?
q_zh: SORT 报告了哪些结果？
gold_en: Online A/B over one month in four AliExpress scenarios, SORT against the production DLRM. Macro average: orders +7.47%, buyers +6.67%, GMV +8.65%, latency -62%, throughput +589%. By scenario, orders are HomePage +2.37%, DetailPage +8.99%, ShoppingCart +7.10% and AfterPayment +11.43%; GMV is +10.01%, +11.49%, +6.98% and +6.12%; latency is -62%, -51%, -64% and -72%; throughput is +325%, +405%, +448% and +1180%. Offline, base scale CTR AUC is SORT 0.7497, Transformer 0.7456, HSTU 0.7438 and OneTrans 0.7476; large scale SORT reaches CTR AUC 0.7536 against 0.7485 for the Transformer, +0.51pt, with 188G against 322G FLOPs. Generative pre-training with sparse transfer and freeze lifts base Transformer CTR AUC by +2.81pt, while transfer alone changes it by -0.13pt. Local window 256 was best of 64, 128 and 256. Inference optimizations give a 29.4% throughput increase and a 29.3% latency reduction over the unoptimized baseline. Scaling of data, model and sequence length each improves AUC, with data scaling the steepest.
gold_zh: 四个 AliExpress 场景上为期一个月的线上 A/B，SORT 对比线上 DLRM。宏平均：订单 +7.47%，买家 +6.67%，GMV +8.65%，延迟 -62%，吞吐 +589%。分场景看，订单为 HomePage +2.37%、DetailPage +8.99%、ShoppingCart +7.10%、AfterPayment +11.43%；GMV 为 +10.01%、+11.49%、+6.98%、+6.12%；延迟为 -62%、-51%、-64%、-72%；吞吐为 +325%、+405%、+448%、+1180%。离线方面，base 规模的 CTR AUC：SORT 0.7497，Transformer 0.7456，HSTU 0.7438，OneTrans 0.7476；large 规模 SORT 达到 CTR AUC 0.7536，Transformer 为 0.7485，即 +0.51pt，FLOPs 为 188G 对 322G。采用稀疏迁移加冻结的生成式预训练，使 base Transformer 的 CTR AUC 提升 +2.81pt，而只做迁移则变化 -0.13pt。局部窗口在 64、128、256 中 256 最好。推理优化相比未优化基线带来 29.4% 的吞吐提升和 29.3% 的延迟下降。数据、模型和序列长度的扩展各自都提升 AUC，其中数据扩展斜率最陡。

q_en: Does SORT have online evidence, and how long was the A/B?
q_zh: SORT 有线上证据吗，A/B 做了多久？
gold_en: Online evidence: Online numbers. A/B duration: One month. A/B traffic: not reported.
gold_zh: 线上证据：有线上数据。A/B 时长：一个月。A/B 流量：未报告。

q_en: What should I keep in mind when reading the results of SORT?
q_zh: 读 SORT 的结果时要注意什么？
gold_en: Latency and throughput are reported only as relative changes against the production DLRM; absolute latency, QPS, serving hardware and traffic share are not given. The comparison is against a DLRM trained incrementally on over a year of data, while SORT uses three months of data, and the two also differ in model family, request-centric organization and the inference stack, so the gain is not attributable to the Transformer alone.
gold_zh: 延迟和吞吐只报告相对线上 DLRM 的变化；绝对延迟、QPS、线上服务硬件和流量占比均未给出。 对比的 DLRM 是增量训练了一年多的模型，而 SORT 只用三个月数据，两者在模型族、以请求为中心的样本组织和推理栈上也都不同，所以增益不能全部归功于 Transformer。

q_en: What serving latency, QPS, cost or hardware does SORT report?
q_zh: SORT 报告了怎样的服务延迟、QPS、成本和硬件？
gold_en: Serving latency: Latency -62% on average against the production DLRM, from -51% to -72% by scenario; absolute values not reported. Serving QPS: Throughput +589% on average, from +325% to +1180% by scenario; absolute QPS not reported. Inference cost: Inference optimizations give a 29.4% throughput increase and a 29.3% latency reduction over the unoptimized baseline; the base model needs 24G FLOPs per sample. Hardware: A100 GPUs for training; serving hardware not reported.
gold_zh: 服务延迟：相对线上 DLRM 平均延迟 -62%，分场景从 -51% 到 -72%；绝对值未报告。 服务 QPS：平均吞吐 +589%，分场景从 +325% 到 +1180%；绝对 QPS 未报告。 推理成本：推理优化相对未优化基线带来 29.4% 的吞吐提升和 29.3% 的延迟下降；base 模型每个样本需要 24G FLOPs。 硬件：训练使用 A100 GPU；线上服务硬件未报告。

q_en: How is SORT trained?
q_zh: SORT 是怎么训练的？
gold_en: Training mode: Offline training on request-centric samples, one epoch by default, with item embeddings pre-trained and frozen. Objectives: Binary cross-entropy for click, cart and purchase, summed with weights; Generative pre-training of item embeddings by next-item prediction over click sequences, then sparse transfer and sparse freeze.
gold_zh: 训练方式：在以请求为中心的样本上离线训练，默认一个 epoch，item embedding 先预训练再冻结。 训练目标：点击、加购和购买的二元交叉熵，加权求和；用点击序列上的下一个 item 预测做 item embedding 的生成式预训练，然后做稀疏迁移和稀疏冻结。

q_en: What is Semantic Search, in one sentence?
q_zh: Semantic Search 一句话是什么？
gold_en: LinkedIn distills LLM relevance and engagement teachers into a compact SLM ranker for Semantic Search; Job Search NDCG@10 +7.73%, Poor Match Rate@10 -46.88%, DAU over +1.2% since launch.
gold_zh: LinkedIn 把 LLM 相关性与互动教师蒸馏进紧凑的 SLM 排序模型服务 Semantic Search；Job Search NDCG@10 +7.73%，Poor Match Rate@10 -46.88%，上线后 DAU 超 +1.2%。

q_en: Who built Semantic Search and where does it run?
q_zh: Semantic Search 是谁做的，用在哪里？
gold_en: Semantic Search comes from LinkedIn, 2026. Deployed in: LinkedIn AI Job Search and AI People Search retrieval and ranking.
gold_zh: Semantic Search 来自 LinkedIn，2026 年。上线位置：LinkedIn AI Job Search 与 AI People Search 的检索与排序。

q_en: What is the core idea of Semantic Search?
q_zh: Semantic Search 的核心思路是什么？
gold_en: Distill relevance and engagement teachers into one compact SLM ranker and serve it with prefill-only GPU inference, making LLM-based semantic search practical at production scale.
gold_zh: 把相关性与互动教师蒸馏进一个紧凑的 SLM 排序模型，用仅预填充的 GPU 推理服务，让基于 LLM 的语义搜索能在生产规模运行。

q_en: Does Semantic Search have online evidence, and how long was the A/B?
q_zh: Semantic Search 有线上证据吗，A/B 做了多久？
gold_en: Online evidence: Online numbers. A/B duration: not reported. A/B traffic: not reported.
gold_zh: 线上证据：有线上数据。A/B 时长：未报告。A/B 流量：未报告。

q_en: What should I keep in mind when reading the results of Semantic Search?
q_zh: 读 Semantic Search 的结果时要注意什么？
gold_en: The launch gains are reported in the Online Deployment section without experiment design details; the paper gives no A/B traffic share, duration or confidence intervals. The abstract reports ranking throughput over 75× under a fixed latency constraint, while Sec 2.3.3 reports about 76× for MixLM over raw-text SLMs and about 10× over summarized-text SLMs; the two comparisons use different baselines.
gold_zh: 上线收益在 Online Deployment 一节给出，但没有实验设计细节；论文未给 A/B 流量占比、时长或置信区间。 摘要写的是固定延迟约束下排序吞吐超过 75×，2.3.3 节写的是 MixLM 对原文 SLM 约 76×、对摘要 SLM 约 10×；两个比较的基线不同。

q_en: Is there code for Semantic Search?
q_zh: Semantic Search 有代码吗？
gold_en: Code status: Partial official code.
gold_zh: 代码状态：部分官方代码。

q_en: What inputs does Semantic Search use?
q_zh: Semantic Search 用了哪些输入？
gold_en: IDs and tokenization: Structured raw-text prompts and embeddings; no item IDs or semantic IDs. Input signals: Query Understanding outputs: routing decisions, normalized attributes and query reformulations shared across stages; Shared searcher context in the prompt prefix: searcher profile and interactions; Member summary generated by an RL-trained summarizer over profiles, professional content, search activity and historical queries; Member text features such as headlines, past positions and locations; Activity history text, for example the last 10 job titles the member interacted with; Numerical features such as common connections, network distance and historical CTR with explicit clicks and impressions, truncated to 2 decimal places.
gold_zh: ID 与 token 化：结构化原文提示与嵌入表示，没有物品 ID 或 Semantic ID。 输入特征：Query Understanding 输出：路由决策、归一化属性与查询改写，全阶段共享；提示前缀中的共享搜索者上下文：搜索者资料与互动；由强化学习训练的摘要器生成的会员摘要，覆盖资料、职业内容、搜索活动与历史查询；会员文本特征，如 headline、过往职位与地点；活动历史文本，如会员最近互动的 10 个职位标题；数值特征，如共同人脉数、网络距离与带显式点击和曝光的历史 CTR，截断到 2 位小数。

q_en: What does the source of Semantic Search not report?
q_zh: Semantic Search 的原文有哪些没有报告？
gold_en: The source does not report: A/B traffic share, duration and experiment design for the launch gains; Measured online QPS and absolute end-to-end serving latency; Relevance teacher parameter count and serving fleet size; Embedding dimensionality values; Total training compute.
gold_zh: 原文没有报告：上线收益的 A/B 流量占比、时长与实验设计；实测线上 QPS 与端到端绝对服务延迟；相关性教师参数量与服务集群规模；嵌入维度取值；总训练算力。

q_en: What is SequenceO1, in one sentence?
q_zh: SequenceO1 一句话是什么？
gold_en: Douyin's fine-ranker compresses 100K behaviors into a cacheable fixed-size sketch with Sketch Attention, plus STCA over a recent 10K; replaces TWIN V2; 1-month A/B: Finish +2.33%, Duration +1.5%.
gold_zh: 抖音精排模型用 Sketch Attention 把 100K 个行为压缩成可缓存的定长 sketch，再对最近 10K 个行为做 STCA；取代 TWIN V2；1 个月 A/B：Finish +2.33%，时长 +1.5%。

q_en: Who built SequenceO1 and where does it run?
q_zh: SequenceO1 是谁做的，用在哪里？
gold_en: SequenceO1 comes from ByteDance, 2026. Deployed in: Douyin and Douyin Lite short-video fine-ranking.
gold_zh: SequenceO1 来自 字节跳动，2026 年。上线位置：抖音和抖音极速版短视频精排。

q_en: What is the core idea of SequenceO1?
q_zh: SequenceO1 的核心思路是什么？
gold_en: Compress up to 100K history events into a fixed-size sketch, then attend over the sketch.
gold_zh: 把最多 100K 个历史事件压缩成定长 sketch，再对 sketch 做注意力。

q_en: What results does SequenceO1 report?
q_zh: SequenceO1 报告了哪些结果？
gold_en: Online one-month A/B on Douyin and Douyin Lite replacing TWIN V2 in the STCA 10K baseline (all significant). Douyin overall: 30-Day Activeness +0.1968%, Duration +1.4999%, Finish +2.3256%, Comment +3.5910%, Like +2.3617%, Dislike -6.9829%. Douyin Lite overall: Activeness +0.2335%, Duration +1.6655%, Finish +3.4872%, Comment +8.6132%, Like +2.9399%, Dislike -5.9972%. Offline production setting vs STCA 10K + TWIN V2: Finish AUC +0.29% (UAUC +0.40%), Skip AUC +0.23%, Share UAUC +0.94%, Favourite UAUC +1.47%. Ablation (Finish AUC over STCA(512)): SA +1.07% vs KMeans clustering +0.30%, chunk mean pooling +0.46%, position-bucket queries +0.72%, Lightning-Attention +0.83%, recent-behavior query init +0.78%; directly scaled STCA +1.29%, so SA retains 83%. FLOPs of the ultra-long branch at 100K are 49.9x (training, hit 0.5, R=40) and 63.9x (inference, hit 0.6, R=300) below direct STCA.
gold_zh: 抖音和抖音极速版上，在 STCA 10K 基线中替换 TWIN V2，做一个月线上 A/B，全部显著。抖音整体：30 日活跃度 +0.1968%，时长 +1.4999%，Finish +2.3256%，评论 +3.5910%，点赞 +2.3617%，不喜欢 -6.9829%。抖音极速版整体：活跃度 +0.2335%，时长 +1.6655%，Finish +3.4872%，评论 +8.6132%，点赞 +2.9399%，不喜欢 -5.9972%。线上设置下的离线结果，对比 STCA 10K + TWIN V2：Finish AUC +0.29%，其 UAUC +0.40%，Skip AUC +0.23%，Share UAUC +0.94%，Favourite UAUC +1.47%。消融实验，指标为相对 STCA-512 的 Finish AUC：SA +1.07%，KMeans 聚类 +0.30%，分块均值池化 +0.46%，位置分桶 query +0.72%，Lightning-Attention +0.83%，用最近行为初始化 query +0.78%；直接扩展 STCA 为 +1.29%，因此 SA 保留了 83%。100K 下超长分支的 FLOPs 比直接用 STCA 低 49.9x，即训练，命中率 0.5，R=40，以及 63.9x，即推理，命中率 0.6，R=300。

q_en: Does SequenceO1 have online evidence, and how long was the A/B?
q_zh: SequenceO1 有线上证据吗，A/B 做了多久？
gold_en: Online evidence: Online numbers. A/B duration: One month. A/B traffic: not reported.
gold_zh: 线上证据：有线上数据。A/B 时长：一个月。A/B 流量：未报告。

q_en: What should I keep in mind when reading the results of SequenceO1?
q_zh: 读 SequenceO1 的结果时要注意什么？
gold_en: The online baseline is ByteDance's own STCA 10K + TWIN V2 production ranker, so gains are specific to that stack. Reported FLOP reductions are analytical under the observed cache-hit rates (0.5 training, 0.6 serving); no measured latency or throughput numbers are given.
gold_zh: 线上基线是字节跳动自己的 STCA 10K + TWIN V2 线上排序模型，因此提升只适用于这套链路。 报告的 FLOPs 降低是在观测到的缓存命中率下，即训练 0.5，在线 0.6，分析推算出来的；没有给出实测的延迟或吞吐数字。

q_en: Is there code for SequenceO1?
q_zh: SequenceO1 有代码吗？
gold_en: Code status: Third-party code only.
gold_zh: 代码状态：仅有第三方代码。

q_en: What inputs does SequenceO1 use?
q_zh: SequenceO1 用了哪些输入？
gold_en: Input signals: User interaction history up to 100K events, with item embeddings fused with action-type embeddings by a SwiGLU; Recent 10K suffix as a separate branch; Target and candidate item features, user/request and non-sequential dense features.
gold_zh: 输入特征：最多 100K 个事件的用户交互历史，item embedding 与行为类型 embedding 通过 SwiGLU 融合；最近的 10K 后缀，作为单独的分支；目标和候选 item 特征，用户和请求特征，以及非序列稠密特征。

q_en: What is Shape Your Feed, in one sentence?
q_zh: Shape Your Feed 一句话是什么？
gold_en: Meta's Shape Your Feed turns user feedback into a Semantic Profile that an 8B LLM uses to prune and re-rank feed candidates; the online A/B shows post dislike -2.74% and post dismiss -1.70%.
gold_zh: Meta 的 Shape Your Feed 把用户反馈变成语义画像，由一个 8B 的 LLM 据此剔除并重排信息流候选；线上 A/B 中不喜欢帖子 -2.74%，忽略帖子 -1.70%。

q_en: Who built Shape Your Feed and where does it run?
q_zh: Shape Your Feed 是谁做的，用在哪里？
gold_en: Shape Your Feed comes from Meta, 2026. Deployed in: Meta social feed, A/B restricted to the feedback pills interface.
gold_zh: Shape Your Feed 来自 Meta，2026 年。上线位置：Meta 社交信息流，A/B 仅限反馈药丸界面。

q_en: What is the core idea of Shape Your Feed?
q_zh: Shape Your Feed 的核心思路是什么？
gold_en: Keep a text Semantic Profile of what the user asked for and use an 8B LLM to prune and re-rank candidates against it on top of the production ranker.
gold_zh: 维护一份记录用户所说偏好的文本语义画像，用 8B 的 LLM 在生产排序之上据此剔除并重排候选。

q_en: What results does Shape Your Feed report?
q_zh: Shape Your Feed 报告了哪些结果？
gold_en: Offline, the alignment scorer on a judge-annotated evaluation set: few-shot baseline accuracy 83.84% with latency 650 ms, SFT 98.21% with 325 ms and SFT plus DPO 98.85% with 323 ms; F1 53.00%, 76.97% and 79.51%. On the independent golden set of 1029 human samples, SFT plus DPO reaches accuracy 95.8%, precision 75.6%, recall 74.7% and F1 75.1%; zero-shot Llama 3 8B scores accuracy 87.0% and Llama 3 70B 94.6% on that set. Online, a large-scale A/B over several months on a randomized subset of production traffic, with users in the US and Canada aged 18 and above, restricted to the Context-Aware Feedback Pills interface: post dismiss -1.70%, post dislike -2.74% and interest consumption +0.16%, all against the production baseline. Context-Aware Pills took 76.02% of pill interactions against 23.98% for static pills. The full system adds +0.043% critical-path latency and +0.412% direct-tier latency.
gold_zh: 离线，对齐打分器在评审团标注的评测集上：few-shot 基线的准确率为 83.84%，延迟 650 ms，SFT 为 98.21%，延迟 325 ms，SFT 加 DPO 为 98.85%，延迟 323 ms；F1 分别为 53.00%、76.97% 和 79.51%。在 1029 条人工样本组成的独立 golden 集上，SFT 加 DPO 的准确率为 95.8%，精确率 75.6%，召回率 74.7%，F1 为 75.1%；零样本的 Llama 3 8B 在该集合上准确率为 87.0%，Llama 3 70B 为 94.6%。线上，在一小部分随机化的生产流量上做了持续数月的大规模 A/B，用户为 18 岁以上的美国和加拿大用户，只开放上下文感知反馈药丸界面：忽略帖子 -1.70%，不喜欢帖子 -2.74%，兴趣消费 +0.16%，均相对生产基线。上下文感知药丸占药丸交互的 76.02%，静态药丸为 23.98%。整套系统给关键路径增加 +0.043% 的延迟，给直接层增加 +0.412% 的延迟。

q_en: Does Shape Your Feed have online evidence, and how long was the A/B?
q_zh: Shape Your Feed 有线上证据吗，A/B 做了多久？
gold_en: Online evidence: Online numbers. A/B duration: Several months. A/B traffic: A randomized subset of live production traffic, US and Canada users aged 18 and above; share not reported.
gold_zh: 线上证据：有线上数据。A/B 时长：数月。A/B 流量：一小部分随机化的线上生产流量，用户为 18 岁以上的美国和加拿大用户；占比未报告。

q_en: What should I keep in mind when reading the results of Shape Your Feed?
q_zh: 读 Shape Your Feed 的结果时要注意什么？
gold_en: The paper does not name the host app or the feed surface; the card says Meta social feed. The headline offline accuracy of 98.85% is measured on labels from the same LLM judge ensemble that produced the training labels; on the independent human-labeled set accuracy is 95.8% and F1 is 75.1%.
gold_zh: 论文没有说明所在的 App 和信息流场景；本卡写作 Meta 社交信息流。 离线准确率 98.85% 这个头条数字，是在与训练标签同一个 LLM 评审团给出的标签上测得的；在独立的人工标注集上准确率为 95.8%，F1 为 75.1%。

q_en: How is Shape Your Feed trained?
q_zh: Shape Your Feed 是怎么训练的？
gold_en: Training mode: Offline SFT and recurring DPO of the alignment scorer. Objectives: SFT on labels from an LLM-as-a-Judge ensemble, with rationales generated by Llama 4 Maverick; DPO on chosen and rejected pairs from explicit user feedback and judge-annotated contexts.
gold_zh: 训练方式：对齐打分器的离线 SFT 和定期 DPO。 训练目标：用 LLM 评审团的标签做 SFT，推理理由由 Llama 4 Maverick 生成；用来自显式用户反馈和评审标注上下文的选中与拒绝样本对做 DPO。

q_en: Is there code for Shape Your Feed?
q_zh: Shape Your Feed 有代码吗？
gold_en: Code status: No code found.
gold_zh: 代码状态：未发现公开代码。

q_en: What is SiDec, in one sentence?
q_zh: SiDec 一句话是什么？
gold_en: Dual-purpose Semantic IDs compress dense content embeddings into tokens reconstructed on the fly; at YouTube they lifted satisfied engagement +0.80% on Watchpage and broke the I/O bottleneck.
gold_zh: 双用途 Semantic ID 把稠密内容嵌入压成 token 按需重建；在 YouTube 使观看页满足感互动 +0.80%，并打破 I/O 瓶颈。

q_en: Who built SiDec and where does it run?
q_zh: SiDec 是谁做的，用在哪里？
gold_en: SiDec comes from Google / YouTube, 2026. Deployed in: YouTube watchpage and homepage ranking and a foundational retrieval model.
gold_zh: SiDec 来自 Google / YouTube，2026 年。上线位置：YouTube 观看页与首页排序及一个基础检索模型。

q_en: What is the core idea of SiDec?
q_zh: SiDec 的核心思路是什么？
gold_en: Compress dense content embeddings into Semantic-ID tokens and reconstruct them on demand inside the model, so one token sequence serves both collaborative identity and content.
gold_zh: 把稠密内容嵌入压成 Semantic ID token 并在模型内按需重建，让同一串 token 同时承担协同身份与内容两种角色。

q_en: What results does SiDec report?
q_zh: SiDec 报告了哪些结果？
gold_en: Online Satisfied Engagement, a proprietary composite of prolonged watch time and positive interactions, Table 1: Watchpage Ranking +0.09% sitewide and +0.80% watchpage; Homepage Ranking +0.08% sitewide and +0.22% homepage; the Retrieval Model +0.06% sitewide, +0.13% homepage and +0.09% watchpage. The table notes that reported metrics may represent proprietary variants of the listed descriptors, and the paper calls these absolute improvements highly statistically significant at YouTube's scale, with outsized benefit for nascent accounts and long-tail content. Offline I/O study on the retrieval model, Table 2: the Control reaches 16.80 steps/s at loss 2.766 and Hit Rate at 100 of 0.2811; ingesting raw 64-dim content embeddings lifts Hit Rate to 0.2844 but cuts throughput 28.2% to 12.07 steps/s; SID v0 codebook decoding recovers 15.41 steps/s, +27.7% over raw embeddings, at 0.2816; SID v1 with a 256-dim latent space reaches 0.2870 at 15.26 steps/s; SID v1 plus scaling reaches the best loss 2.681 and Hit Rate 0.2910 at 14.53 steps/s, a 20.4% throughput advantage over raw embeddings. Ranking ablations, Tables 3 and 4, in absolute CTR AUC points: keeping only candidate and watch SIDs -0.04%, only watch-history SIDs -0.03%, removing the lightweight decoder -0.01%, ablating the contrastive SSL loss -0.05%, cross-attention -0.08% and multi-modal content -0.06%.
gold_zh: Online Satisfied Engagement 是反映长时观看与点赞、收藏等正向互动的专有综合指标，表 1：观看页排序全站 +0.09%、观看页 +0.80%；首页排序全站 +0.08%、首页 +0.22%；检索模型全站 +0.06%、首页 +0.13%、观看页 +0.09%。表注说明报告的指标可能是所列名称的专有变体；论文称这些绝对提升在 YouTube 的规模下高度统计显著，并对新账户和长尾内容收益更大。检索模型的离线 I/O 研究，表 2：Control 为 16.80 steps/s、loss 2.766、Hit Rate@100 0.2811；直接摄入 64 维原始内容嵌入把 Hit Rate 提到 0.2844，但吞吐下降 28.2% 到 12.07 steps/s；SID v0 码本解码恢复到 15.41 steps/s，比原始嵌入快 27.7%，Hit Rate 0.2816；SID v1 用 256 维隐空间达到 0.2870、15.26 steps/s；SID v1 加扩展达到最优 loss 2.681 与 Hit Rate 0.2910，吞吐 14.53 steps/s，比原始嵌入快 20.4%。排序消融，表 3 与表 4，CTR AUC 绝对百分点：只留候选与观看 SID -0.04%，只留观看历史 SID -0.03%，去掉轻量解码器 -0.01%，去掉对比 SSL 损失 -0.05%，去掉交叉注意力 -0.08%，去掉多模态内容 -0.06%。

q_en: Does SiDec have online evidence, and how long was the A/B?
q_zh: SiDec 有线上证据吗，A/B 做了多久？
gold_en: Online evidence: Online numbers. A/B duration: not reported. A/B traffic: not reported.
gold_zh: 线上证据：有线上数据。A/B 时长：未报告。A/B 流量：未报告。

q_en: What should I keep in mind when reading the results of SiDec?
q_zh: 读 SiDec 的结果时要注意什么？
gold_en: The online metric is a proprietary composite, Online Satisfied Engagement, and Table 1 notes that reported metrics may represent proprietary variants of the listed descriptors. The paper states that because the baseline systems already employ Semantic-ID token-based embeddings, the reported metrics isolate the pure performance lift generated solely by adding the SiDec component.
gold_zh: 线上指标是专有综合指标 Online Satisfied Engagement，表 1 注明报告的指标可能是所列名称的专有变体。 论文说明因基线系统已使用 Semantic ID token 嵌入，报告的指标隔离的是仅新增 SiDec 组件带来的纯性能提升。

q_en: What scale does SiDec report?
q_zh: SiDec 报告了哪些规模信息？
gold_en: Embedding compression: typically 50-100x against FP32 vectors. Deployment: production ranking and retrieval systems at a major video sharing platform.
gold_zh: 嵌入压缩：相对 FP32 向量典型 50-100 倍。 部署：大型视频分享平台的生产排序与检索系统。

q_en: What serving latency, QPS, cost or hardware does SiDec report?
q_zh: SiDec 报告了怎样的服务延迟、QPS、成本和硬件？
gold_en: Serving latency: not reported. Serving QPS: not reported. Inference cost: Item storage falls from d x 32 bits to K x log2 V bits, typically 50-100x; reconstruction is described as costing no more than a normal sparse embedding feature, with tokens already cached in the baseline serving path. Hardware: not reported.
gold_zh: 服务延迟：未报告。 服务 QPS：未报告。 推理成本：每物品存储从 d x 32 比特降到 K x log2 V 比特，典型 50-100 倍；重建成本被描述为不超过一个普通稀疏嵌入特征，token 在基线服务路径中已缓存。 硬件：未报告。

q_en: What is SnapLGR, in one sentence?
q_zh: SnapLGR 一句话是什么？
gold_en: Snap's LLM-based generative retriever, a Qwen3-0.6B LLM over multimodal semantic IDs, launched as a retrieval source; 7-day A/B vs a TIGER-style baseline: View Time +0.37%, Time Spent +0.09%.
gold_zh: Snap 基于大模型的生成式召回模型，即基于多模态 Semantic ID 的 Qwen3-0.6B 大模型，已作为召回源上线；对比 TIGER 风格基线做 7 天 A/B：View Time +0.37%，Time Spent +0.09%。

q_en: Who built SnapLGR and where does it run?
q_zh: SnapLGR 是谁做的，用在哪里？
gold_en: SnapLGR comes from Snap, 2026. Deployed in: Snapchat short-form video recommendation, as a retrieval source.
gold_zh: SnapLGR 来自 Snap，2026 年。上线位置：Snapchat 短视频推荐，作为召回源。

q_en: What is the core idea of SnapLGR?
q_zh: SnapLGR 的核心思路是什么？
gold_en: Residual-quantized multimodal semantic IDs and a decoder-only LLM generate videos through daily batch beam search.
gold_zh: 残差量化的多模态 Semantic ID 加 decoder-only 大模型，通过每天的批量 beam search 生成视频。

q_en: What results does SnapLGR report?
q_zh: SnapLGR 报告了哪些结果？
gold_en: Online 7-day A/B vs the legacy TIGER-style T5 generative retrieval, where the launched system changes tokenizer, backbone and serving stack together: View Time +0.37% (+/-0.27%, p=0.007), Time Spent +0.09% (p=0.048), Deep Sessions +0.18% (p=0.027), Deep Sessions Unique User +0.11% (p=0.017). Offline SID retrieval vs a 13M T5 on the same Qwen3-VL SIDs: Pass@10 21.78% vs 8.685% (2.51x), Pass@32 2.27x, Recall@32 11.11% vs 4.624% (2.40x). Decoder-only architecture is the largest offline gain; CPT adds +0.83% Pass@10 and +1.51% Recall@10 over pretrained+SFT. SID uniqueness 32.1% vs 16.8% without co-engagement; training +3.63x, inference +45.7x per-GPU throughput.
gold_zh: 7 天线上 A/B，对比旧的 TIGER 风格 T5 生成式召回；上线的系统同时更换了 tokenizer、骨干和在线服务栈：View Time +0.37%，置信区间 +/-0.27%，p=0.007；Time Spent +0.09%，p=0.048；Deep Sessions +0.18%，p=0.027；Deep Sessions Unique User +0.11%，p=0.017。离线 SID 召回，对比使用同一套 Qwen3-VL SID 的 13M T5：Pass@10 为 21.78%，对比 8.685%，即 2.51x；Pass@32 为 2.27x；Recall@32 为 11.11%，对比 4.624%，即 2.40x。decoder-only 架构是离线收益最大的一项；在预训练加 SFT 的基础上，CPT 使 Pass@10 再提高 +0.83%，Recall@10 提高 +1.51%。SID 唯一率为 32.1%，没有共同互动时为 16.8%；训练的单 GPU 吞吐 +3.63x，推理 +45.7x。

q_en: Does SnapLGR have online evidence, and how long was the A/B?
q_zh: SnapLGR 有线上证据吗，A/B 做了多久？
gold_en: Online evidence: Online numbers. A/B duration: 7 days. A/B traffic: not reported.
gold_zh: 线上证据：有线上数据。A/B 时长：7 天。A/B 流量：未报告。

q_en: What should I keep in mind when reading the results of SnapLGR?
q_zh: 读 SnapLGR 的结果时要注意什么？
gold_en: The A/B compares the whole launched system against a T5 TIGER-style baseline with CLIP-based SIDs, so it does not isolate the LLM, tokenizer or serving contributions. Lifts are small in relative terms and absolute metric values are not given.
gold_zh: 这次 A/B 对比的是整个上线系统与基于 CLIP 的 SID 的 T5 TIGER 风格基线，因此没有分离出大模型、tokenizer 或在线服务各自的贡献。 提升的相对幅度较小，也没有给出指标的绝对值。

q_en: Is there code for SnapLGR?
q_zh: SnapLGR 有代码吗？
gold_en: Code status: No code found.
gold_zh: 代码状态：未发现公开代码。

q_en: What inputs does SnapLGR use?
q_zh: SnapLGR 用了哪些输入？
gold_en: IDs and tokenization: RQ-VAE residual quantization of Qwen3-VL-Embedding-8B multimodal embeddings (first 1024 of 4096 dims) with PPR co-engagement contrastive loss. Input signals: Video multimodal embeddings (video plus text description); User interaction histories as chronological SID sequences; Bipartite user-video engagement graph for PPR co-engagement pairs; Engagement rates used by the value-weighted SID-to-video materialization.
gold_zh: ID 与 token 化：对 Qwen3-VL-Embedding-8B 的多模态 embedding，取 4096 维中的前 1024 维，做 RQ-VAE 残差量化，并加 PPR 共同互动对比损失。 输入特征：视频多模态 embedding，由视频和文本描述组成；用户交互历史，按时间顺序的 SID 序列；用户与视频的二部互动图，用于构造 PPR 共同互动对；互动率，用于按价值加权的 SID 到视频物化。

q_en: What is TGR, in one sentence?
q_zh: TGR 一句话是什么？
gold_en: Tencent's TGR report covers generative ranking, SID retrieval and slate generation in production: CCFormer video CTR +3.57%, BARGE retrieval CTR +0.60%, HiGR watch time +1.22%. Preprint only.
gold_zh: 腾讯 TGR 报告涵盖线上的生成式排序、SID 召回和 slate 生成：CCFormer 视频 CTR +3.57%，BARGE 召回 CTR +0.60%，HiGR 观看时长 +1.22%。仅有预印本。

q_en: Who built TGR and where does it run?
q_zh: TGR 是谁做的，用在哪里？
gold_en: TGR comes from Tencent, 2026. Deployed in: Tencent PCG news, video, web novel and advertising surfaces serving hundreds of millions of users.
gold_zh: TGR 来自 腾讯，2026 年。上线位置：腾讯 PCG 的资讯、视频、网络小说和广告场景，服务数亿用户。

q_en: What is the core idea of TGR?
q_zh: TGR 的核心思路是什么？
gold_en: A generative stack replaces the cascade piece by piece, with a generative ranker, semantic-ID retrieval and slate generation, and offline LLM reasoning tokens.
gold_zh: 生成式技术栈逐段取代级联，包括生成式排序模型、Semantic ID 召回和 slate 生成，以及离线大模型推理 token。

q_en: What results does TGR report?
q_zh: TGR 报告了哪些结果？
gold_en: CCFormer was A/B-tested in five scenarios over two weeks, all lifts significant at p < 0.05. In the video scenario it replaced a long-standing DLRM and gained CTR +3.57%, page view +3.86%, watch time +1.29% and unique viewers +2.61%; in the advertising-ranking scenario it replaced HSTU and gained advertising revenue +1.71%. Both were then fully launched. It also trains 2.21x faster than HSTU at about half the GFLOPs. BARGE ran on 6% of traffic for two weeks against the multi-stage incumbent: CTR +0.60%, unique clicking users +1.34% and total reading time +1.70%, then was fully rolled out as a retrieval channel. Offline it beats OneRec by 10.2-16.9% in Hit@5. HiGR lifted average watch time +1.22% and average video views +1.73% in one scenario on 5% of traffic, and CTR +0.68% with advertising revenue +0.56% in another. TGR-Reason raised cold-start new-user Hit@1 from 0.0451 to 0.2606, +477.8%, and online gained Effective Consumption Rate +1.75% and new-user Exposure-to-Conversion Rate +13.09%.
gold_zh: CCFormer 在五个场景中做了两周 A/B，所有提升在 p < 0.05 下显著。在视频场景中，它取代了长期使用的 DLRM，CTR +3.57%，page view +3.86%，观看时长 +1.29%，独立观看用户 +2.61%；在广告排序场景中，它取代了 HSTU，广告收入 +1.71%。两者随后都已全量上线。它的训练速度比 HSTU 快 2.21x，GFLOPs 约为一半。BARGE 在 6% 流量上跑了两周，对比多阶段的原有系统：CTR +0.60%，点击用户数 +1.34%，总阅读时长 +1.70%，随后作为召回通道全量上线。离线 Hit@5 比 OneRec 高 10.2-16.9%。HiGR 在一个场景的 5% 流量上，平均观看时长 +1.22%，平均视频观看数 +1.73%；在另一个场景中 CTR +0.68%，广告收入 +0.56%。TGR-Reason 使冷启动新用户的 Hit@1 从 0.0451 提高到 0.2606，即 +477.8%，线上有效消费率 +1.75%，新用户曝光到转化率 +13.09%。

q_en: Does TGR have online evidence, and how long was the A/B?
q_zh: TGR 有线上证据吗，A/B 做了多久？
gold_en: Online evidence: Online numbers. A/B duration: Two weeks for CCFormer and BARGE. A/B traffic: CCFormer over one million exposed users per day per group; BARGE 6% of live traffic; HiGR 5% in one scenario.
gold_zh: 线上证据：有线上数据。A/B 时长：CCFormer 和 BARGE 为两周。A/B 流量：CCFormer 每组每天超过一百万曝光用户；BARGE 6% 线上流量；HiGR 在一个场景中 5%。

q_en: What should I keep in mind when reading the results of TGR?
q_zh: 读 TGR 的结果时要注意什么？
gold_en: This is an arXiv technical report with no peer-reviewed venue; HiGR and the Think model are also reported as separate papers, with HiGR first posted in December 2025. The online control differs by component: a DLRM, a deployed HSTU, a multi-stage cascade or the incumbent production generator.
gold_zh: 这是一份 arXiv 技术报告，没有经同行评审的发表渠道；HiGR 和 Think 模型也有各自单独的论文，其中 HiGR 首次发布于 December 2025。 线上对照组因组件而异：DLRM、已部署的 HSTU、多阶段级联，或线上原有的生成器。

q_en: What does the source of TGR not report?
q_zh: TGR 的原文有哪些没有报告？
gold_en: The source does not report: model parameter counts; absolute metric values; production GPU fleet size; code.
gold_zh: 原文没有报告：模型参数量；指标的绝对值；线上 GPU 集群规模；代码。

q_en: Which stages of the pipeline does TGR cover?
q_zh: TGR 覆盖链路的哪些阶段？
gold_en: Ranking: CCFormer, a scalable Transformer ranker with feature-field separated cross attention and subspace token mixing. Retrieval: BARGE, hierarchical semantic-ID generation with dual-path decoding. Re-ranking: HiGR, whole-slate generation with a slate planner and item generator.
gold_zh: 精排：CCFormer，可扩展的 Transformer 排序模型，带有按特征域分离的 cross attention 和子空间 token 混合。 召回：BARGE，层级 Semantic ID 生成，采用双路径解码。 重排：HiGR，整个 slate 的生成，包含 slate 规划器和 item 生成器。

q_en: What is Tlow, in one sentence?
q_zh: Tlow 一句话是什么？
gold_en: Tlow normalizes item embeddings with a flow so tokenization is independent and parallel; WeChat A/B lifted new-picture CTR +1.94% and pathway UCTR +10.32%.
gold_zh: Tlow 用流把物品嵌入归一化，tokenization 独立且可并行；微信 A/B 新图 CTR +1.94%，通路 UCTR +10.32%。

q_en: Who built Tlow and where does it run?
q_zh: Tlow 是谁做的，用在哪里？
gold_en: Tlow comes from Tencent, 2026. Deployed in: WeChat picture recommendation as a supplemental retrieval pathway.
gold_zh: Tlow 来自 腾讯，2026 年。上线位置：微信图片推荐，作为补充检索通路。

q_en: What is the core idea of Tlow?
q_zh: Tlow 的核心思路是什么？
gold_en: Normalize item embeddings to a standard normal latent space with a flow, so tokenization becomes independent, parallel and semantically clean.
gold_zh: 用流把物品嵌入归一化到标准正态隐空间，使 tokenization 独立、可并行且语义干净。

q_en: What results does Tlow report?
q_zh: Tlow 报告了哪些结果？
gold_en: Online pathway comparison, Table 6: in single-domain the Tlow pathway shows CTR +4.79% and UCTR +10.32%, and on new items CTR +8.46% with UCTR +11.64%; in the cross-domain scenario CTR +6.23% and UCTR +7.20%, and on new items CTR +9.09% with UCTR +9.45%. Core A/B metrics beyond pathway comparison: in single-domain, 24-hour overall CTR +0.78% and newly-published-picture CTR +1.94%; in cross-domain, per-capita picture CTR +1.05% with a 1.15% decrease in top-tier accounts' exposure share, which the paper reads as long-tail benefit. The abstract summarizes global CTR +10.32% and new-item +11.64% for the retrieval model based on token IDs. Offline, four public datasets show tokenization and codebook guidance significantly improving recommendation performance, with cross-domain and multimodal evaluations confirming the benefit in a simplified embedding space.
gold_zh: 在线通路对比见表 6：单域下 Tlow 通路 CTR +4.79%、UCTR +10.32%，新物品 CTR +8.46%、UCTR +11.64%；跨域场景 CTR +6.23%、UCTR +7.20%，新物品 CTR +9.09%、UCTR +9.45%。通路之外的核心 A/B 指标：单域 24 小时整体 CTR +0.78%、新发布图片 CTR +1.94%；跨域人均图片 CTR +1.05%，头部账号曝光份额下降 1.15%，论文解读为长尾受益。摘要把基于 token ID 的检索模型概括为全球 CTR +10.32%、新物品 +11.64%。离线在四个公开数据集上 tokenization 与码本引导显著提升推荐表现，跨域与多模态评估确认在简化嵌入空间中的收益。

q_en: Does Tlow have online evidence, and how long was the A/B?
q_zh: Tlow 有线上证据吗，A/B 做了多久？
gold_en: Online evidence: Online numbers. A/B duration: Both arms trained two weeks on identical data; test duration not reported. A/B traffic: not reported.
gold_zh: 线上证据：有线上数据。A/B 时长：两组用同一数据各训两周；测试时长未报告。A/B 流量：未报告。

q_en: What should I keep in mind when reading the results of Tlow?
q_zh: 读 Tlow 的结果时要注意什么？
gold_en: The paper reports only relative differences for online metric comparisons due to privacy considerations.
gold_zh: 论文因隐私考虑，在线指标对比只报告相对差异。

q_en: What scale does Tlow report?
q_zh: Tlow 报告了哪些规模信息？
gold_en: Online platform: WeChat picture recommendation, China's largest social media platform. Training data: two weeks, over 70 and 200 million interaction records per day in single-domain and cross-domain scenarios. Token vocabulary: 4,096 token embeddings from 16 codebooks of 256, replacing tens of millions of item embeddings.
gold_zh: 在线平台：微信图片推荐，中国最大社交媒体平台。 训练数据：两周，单域与跨域日交互分别超 70M 与 200M 条。 token 词表：16 个 256 码本共 4096 个 token 嵌入，取代数千万物品嵌入。

q_en: What serving latency, QPS, cost or hardware does Tlow report?
q_zh: Tlow 报告了怎样的服务延迟、QPS、成本和硬件？
gold_en: Serving latency: not reported. Serving QPS: not reported. Inference cost: Sequential model learns 4,096 token embeddings instead of tens of millions of item embeddings; tokenization of new items runs off the request path. Hardware: A single GPU for daily tokenization of new items.
gold_zh: 服务延迟：未报告。 服务 QPS：未报告。 推理成本：序列模型学 4096 个 token 嵌入而非数千万物品嵌入；新物品 tokenization 在请求路径之外。 硬件：单张 GPU 用于每日新物品 tokenization。

q_en: What is UNIQUE, in one sentence?
q_zh: UNIQUE 一句话是什么？
gold_en: Baidu feed model that predicts single-layer semantic codes for retrieval and scores candidates in the same early-fusion Transformer; one-week A/B: watch duration +0.96%, distribution volume +1.08%.
gold_zh: 百度信息流模型在同一个早期融合 Transformer 中，为召回预测单层语义码，并为候选打分；一周 A/B：观看时长 +0.96%，分发量 +1.08%。

q_en: Who built UNIQUE and where does it run?
q_zh: UNIQUE 是谁做的，用在哪里？
gold_en: UNIQUE comes from Baidu, 2026. Deployed in: Mobile Baidu homepage feed, discovery page and short-video recommendation, retrieval stage.
gold_zh: UNIQUE 来自 百度，2026 年。上线位置：手机百度首页信息流、发现页和短视频推荐，召回阶段。

q_en: What is the core idea of UNIQUE?
q_zh: UNIQUE 的核心思路是什么？
gold_en: One Transformer does generative retrieval over a flat code book, then scores the retrieved items.
gold_zh: 一个 Transformer 在扁平码本上做生成式召回，再对召回出的 item 打分。

q_en: What results does UNIQUE report?
q_zh: UNIQUE 报告了哪些结果？
gold_en: Online (one-week full A/B vs previous production retrieval pipeline, p < 0.05): total watch duration +0.96%, total distribution volume +1.08%, user retention +0.70%; new users +1.44% watch time, high-activity +1.11%; UNIQUE accounts for 22.5% of the retrieval candidate pool. Serving: P80 35 ms, P99 89 ms, online inference MFU 44.23%, about 10,000 QPS peak, about $0.0013 per 1,000 requests. Codebook analysis: resource-count variance 1510.85 to 389.57 (flat vs hierarchical). Offline on KuaiRand-Pure: HR@10 0.0575, HR@50 0.1510, NDCG@10 0.0310, NDCG@50 0.0473, CTR-AUC 0.7252 vs UniGRF-HSTU 0.0511/0.1453/0.0298/0.0430/0.7168. Ablation (HR@50): w/o generative objective 0.1374 (-9.01%), w/o early fusion 0.1398 (-7.42%), w/o flat quantization 0.1421 (-5.89%).
gold_zh: 线上结果为一周全量 A/B，对比此前线上的召回链路，p < 0.05：总观看时长 +0.96%，总分发量 +1.08%，用户留存 +0.70%；新用户观看时长 +1.44%，高活跃用户 +1.11%；UNIQUE 占召回候选池的 22.5%。在线服务：P80 35 ms，P99 89 ms，线上推理 MFU 44.23%，峰值约 10,000 QPS，每 1,000 个请求约 $0.0013。码本分析：资源计数方差从 1510.85 降到 389.57，即从层级码本到扁平码本。在 KuaiRand-Pure 上的离线结果：HR@10 0.0575，HR@50 0.1510，NDCG@10 0.0310，NDCG@50 0.0473，CTR-AUC 0.7252，对比 UniGRF-HSTU 的 0.0511、0.1453、0.0298、0.0430、0.7168。消融实验的指标为 HR@50：去掉生成目标为 0.1374，即 -9.01%；去掉早期融合为 0.1398，即 -7.42%；去掉扁平量化为 0.1421，即 -5.89%。

q_en: Does UNIQUE have online evidence, and how long was the A/B?
q_zh: UNIQUE 有线上证据吗，A/B 做了多久？
gold_en: Online evidence: Online numbers. A/B duration: One week, full A/B. A/B traffic: not reported.
gold_zh: 线上证据：有线上数据。A/B 时长：一周，全量 A/B。A/B 流量：未报告。

q_en: What should I keep in mind when reading the results of UNIQUE?
q_zh: 读 UNIQUE 的结果时要注意什么？
gold_en: The paper gives two start dates: the introduction says deployed since February 2026, Section 4.1.2 says January 2026. Offline evidence is a small public benchmark (KuaiRand-Pure, 7,583 items) that the authors call a sanity check; production-scale offline metrics are not reported.
gold_zh: 论文给出了两个起始时间：引言称自 February 2026 起部署，第 4.1.2 节则称 January 2026。 离线证据是一个小型公开基准，即有 7,583 个 item 的 KuaiRand-Pure，作者称之为合理性检验；没有报告线上规模的离线指标。

q_en: Is there code for UNIQUE?
q_zh: UNIQUE 有代码吗？
gold_en: Code status: No code found.
gold_zh: 代码状态：未发现公开代码。

q_en: What inputs does UNIQUE use?
q_zh: UNIQUE 用了哪些输入？
gold_en: IDs and tokenization: Single-layer flat codebook (EMA vector quantization) with balanced assignment. Input signals: User profile token, short-term impressions (clicked and exposed-not-clicked), medium-term satisfied watches, long-term interests grouped by category; Item ID, category, publisher, title terms and other item metadata; Feedback signals covering relevance, CTR, dwell or duration, and completion.
gold_zh: ID 与 token 化：单层扁平码本，EMA 向量量化，带均衡分配。 输入特征：用户画像 token、短期曝光，包括点击的和曝光未点击的、中期的满意观看、按类目分组的长期兴趣；item ID、类目、发布者、标题词和其他 item 元数据；反馈信号，涵盖相关性、CTR、停留或时长以及完播。

q_en: What is Unity, in one sentence?
q_zh: Unity 一句话是什么？
gold_en: Meta ranking recipe of latent event tokenization, Pollen Transformer and masked-token SSL; Pollen A/B +2.76% to +3.68% WatchTime on video; Unity Encoder -0.06% to -0.14% NE on five ads models.
gold_zh: Meta 的排序方案：隐式事件 tokenization、Pollen Transformer 和 masked-token SSL；Pollen 的 A/B 中视频 WatchTime +2.76% 到 +3.68%；Unity Encoder 在五个广告模型上 NE -0.06% 到 -0.14%。

q_en: Who built Unity and where does it run?
q_zh: Unity 是谁做的，用在哪里？
gold_en: Unity comes from Meta, 2026. Deployed in: Meta ads ranking across five core ads models, and short-form video ranking for IFR and VDD.
gold_zh: Unity 来自 Meta，2026 年。上线位置：Meta 的五个核心广告模型的广告排序，以及 IFR 和 VDD 的短视频排序。

q_en: What is the core idea of Unity?
q_zh: Unity 的核心思路是什么？
gold_en: Tokenize engagement events into latent tokens, then add a Transformer that generalizes DCN v2 and a masked self-supervised loss.
gold_zh: 把互动事件 tokenize 成隐式 token，再加一个推广了 DCN v2 的 Transformer 和 masked 自监督损失。

q_en: What results does Unity report?
q_zh: Unity 报告了哪些结果？
gold_en: Production (Meta): Pollen first launched April 2023 on short-form video; A/B +2.76% WatchTime on VDD and +3.68% WatchTime on IFR (statistically significant); offline VDD NE gains -0.34% to -0.49% per Table 2 and IFR click NE -0.66%, like -0.97% per Table 3. Pollen on one core ads model: -0.15% NE. Unity tokenization: ads -0.15% NE (RQ) vs mid-2025 baseline per Table 4; VDD -0.38% to -0.58% NE per Table 5. Unity Encoder on five core ads models (vs July 2025 baselines): -0.06% to -0.14% NE (Table 6; models A-E -0.08, -0.1, -0.06, -0.14, -0.08). Adding SSL gives about -0.05% NE more on average. Scaling per Table 7: Unity Tiny/XS/S/M reach -0.05/-0.08/-0.10/-0.13% NE at +4/+14/+72/+260% FLOPs, claimed 2.3x-4.9x scaling efficiency vs the existing scaling curve. Public datasets per Table 8: small AUC gains over DCNv2 and Wukong on KuaiVideo, AmazonElectronics, TaobaoAds.
gold_zh: Meta 线上：Pollen 于 April 2023 首次在短视频上线；A/B 中 VDD 的 WatchTime +2.76%，IFR 的 WatchTime +3.68%，均统计显著；按表 2，离线 VDD 的 NE 提升为 -0.34% 到 -0.49%，按表 3，IFR 点击 NE -0.66%，点赞 -0.97%。Pollen 在一个核心广告模型上：NE -0.15%。Unity tokenization：按表 4，相对 mid-2025 基线，广告 NE -0.15%，用 RQ；按表 5，VDD NE -0.38% 到 -0.58%。Unity Encoder 在五个核心广告模型上，相对 July 2025 基线：NE -0.06% 到 -0.14%，表 6；模型 A-E 为 -0.08、-0.1、-0.06、-0.14、-0.08。加入 SSL 平均再多带来约 -0.05% NE。按表 7 的扩展：Unity Tiny/XS/S/M 在 FLOPs +4/+14/+72/+260% 时达到 NE -0.05/-0.08/-0.10/-0.13%，声称相对现有扩展曲线的扩展效率为 2.3x-4.9x。按表 8 的公开数据集：在 KuaiVideo、AmazonElectronics、TaobaoAds 上，相对 DCNv2 和 Wukong 有小幅 AUC 提升。

q_en: Does Unity have online evidence, and how long was the A/B?
q_zh: Unity 有线上证据吗，A/B 做了多久？
gold_en: Online evidence: Online numbers. A/B duration: not reported. A/B traffic: not reported.
gold_zh: 线上证据：有线上数据。A/B 时长：未报告。A/B 流量：未报告。

q_en: What should I keep in mind when reading the results of Unity?
q_zh: 读 Unity 的结果时要注意什么？
gold_en: Several Unity Encoder ads configurations are described as "in the process of full-scale production launch" with "early online A/B" showing gains, but no A/B figures are given for them; the only quoted online numbers are the 2023 Pollen WatchTime gains. Ads results are offline NE only. NE differences are relative to moving production baselines; models A-E are anonymized.
gold_zh: Unity Encoder 的若干广告配置被描述为「in the process of full-scale production launch」，并称「early online A/B」显示有收益，但没有给出它们的 A/B 数字；唯一引用的线上数字是 2023 年 Pollen 的 WatchTime 收益。 广告结果只有离线 NE。NE 的差异是相对不断变化的线上基线；模型 A-E 已匿名。

q_en: What serving latency, QPS, cost or hardware does Unity report?
q_zh: Unity 报告了怎样的服务延迟、QPS、成本和硬件？
gold_en: Serving latency: not reported. Serving QPS: not reported. Inference cost: not reported. Hardware: not reported.
gold_zh: 服务延迟：未报告。 服务 QPS：未报告。 推理成本：未报告。 硬件：未报告。

q_en: How is Unity trained?
q_zh: Unity 是怎么训练的？
gold_en: Training mode: Pretrain-style joint SSL plus supervised loss; production models are recurrently trained on fresh data at near-real-time cadence. Objectives: Supervised engagement prediction across click, conversion, like and watch-time tasks; Masked latent-token reconstruction (SSL).
gold_zh: 训练方式：预训练式的 SSL 与有监督损失联合训练；线上模型以近实时的节奏在新数据上持续训练。 训练目标：跨点击、转化、点赞和观看时长任务的有监督互动预测；Masked 隐 token 重建，SSL。

q_en: What is VLM, in one sentence?
q_zh: VLM 一句话是什么？
gold_en: Versioned late materialization stores each user's history once and rebuilds it at training time; it cuts primary read bandwidth up to -70.3% and unlocked 4K-to-64K sequences at Meta.
gold_zh: 版本化晚物化让每份用户历史只存一份、训练时重建；主读取带宽最高降 70.3%，并在 Meta 解锁了 4K 到 64K 的序列扩展。

q_en: Who built VLM and where does it run?
q_zh: VLM 是谁做的，用在哪里？
gold_en: VLM comes from Meta, 2026. Deployed in: Production training pipelines on multiple Meta recommendation surfaces.
gold_zh: VLM 来自 Meta，2026 年。上线位置：Meta 多个推荐场景的生产训练管线。

q_en: What is the core idea of VLM?
q_zh: VLM 的核心思路是什么？
gold_en: Store the append-only user history once in an immutable tier and rebuild the exact inference-time state at training time from lightweight version pointers.
gold_zh: 把只追加的用户历史在不可变层只存一份，训练时用轻量版本指针重建精确的推理时状态。

q_en: What results does VLM report?
q_zh: VLM 报告了哪些结果？
gold_en: System efficiency, Table 1, against the Fat Row baseline on three model tenants sharing one union dataset: primary write bandwidth -46.2% shared across tenants; primary read bandwidth Model A -70.3%, Model B -50.9%, Model C -47.7%; sequence lookup bandwidth added by late materialization, streaming, Model A +62.7%, Model B +16.2%, Model C +8.7%, batch, +24.6%, +6.5% and +3.4%; per-batch data loading latency Model A +9.7%, Model B -26.4%, Model C -36.2%. The immutable store delivers 3.4x read throughput per unit host resource; tuning the disaggregated preprocessing base batch adds 15% per-worker throughput; pipelined I/O prefetching adds 10% on heavy-lookup models; data-affinity bucketing and symmetric sharding cut batch read bandwidth by 60% and raise per-worker throughput by 28%. Model quality, Section 5.2: the Fat Row Wall sits at about 4K where data-service usage exceeds 0.75 of GPU training power; Platform A gains 1.2% cumulative Normalized Entropy from 4K to 64K, above 5% total, and Platform B gains 0.65% from 4K to 10K, where a 1% NE improvement is considered a success. Online A/B, Table 2, with anonymized metrics: Platform A at 4K to 16K lifts Metric-Topline +0.22%, Metrics-C +4.1%, Metrics-E-1 +2.3% and Metrics-E-2 +4.3%; Platform B at 4K to 10K lifts Metric-Topline +0.14%, Metrics-C +0.79%, Metrics-E-3 +1.4% and Metrics-E-4 +1.7%.
gold_zh: 系统效率，表 1，相对 Fat Row 基线、共享同一并集数据集的三个模型租户：主写入带宽 -46.2%，由租户共享；主读取带宽 Model A -70.3%、Model B -50.9%、Model C -47.7%；晚物化新增的序列查找带宽，流式下 Model A +62.7%、Model B +16.2%、Model C +8.7%，批式下 +24.6%、+6.5%、+3.4%；每批数据加载延迟 Model A +9.7%、Model B -26.4%、Model C -36.2%。不可变存储每单位主机资源读吞吐为 3.4 倍；分离式预处理的基础批大小调优带来每 worker 吞吐 15% 提升；流水线 I/O 预取在重查找模型上带来 10%；数据亲和分桶与对称分片把批式读取带宽降 60%、每 worker 吞吐提升 28%。模型质量见 5.2 节：Fat Row 墙约在 4K，此时数据服务资源超过 GPU 训练算力的 0.75；Platform A 从 4K 到 64K 累计 Normalized Entropy 提升 1.2%，总计超过 5%，Platform B 从 4K 到 10K 提升 0.65%，论文说明该生产规模下 1% 的 NE 提升即被视为成功。线上 A/B 见表 2，指标匿名化：Platform A 在 4K 到 16K 使 Metric-Topline +0.22%、Metrics-C +4.1%、Metrics-E-1 +2.3%、Metrics-E-2 +4.3%；Platform B 在 4K 到 10K 使 Metric-Topline +0.14%、Metrics-C +0.79%、Metrics-E-3 +1.4%、Metrics-E-4 +1.7%。

q_en: Does VLM have online evidence, and how long was the A/B?
q_zh: VLM 有线上证据吗，A/B 做了多久？
gold_en: Online evidence: Online numbers. A/B duration: not reported. A/B traffic: not reported.
gold_zh: 线上证据：有线上数据。A/B 时长：未报告。A/B 流量：未报告。

gold_zh: 线上 A/B 指标沿用先前工作的做法做了匿名化，分为 Metric-Topline、Metrics-C 和 Metrics-E 三类，场景名与指标身份未公开。 论文说明两个平台由不同模型架构驱动，但未给出平台名称。

q_en: How is VLM trained?

q_en: What is X For You Phoenix, in one sentence?
q_zh: X For You Phoenix 一句话是什么？
gold_en: Open reference for X's For You feed: two-tower Phoenix retrieval and a transformer ranker with candidate isolation, combining multi-action probabilities in a weighted scorer.
gold_zh: X 的「为你推荐」信息流的开放参考：双塔 Phoenix 召回，以及带候选隔离的 transformer 排序器，在加权打分器中合并多种行为的概率。

q_en: Who built X For You Phoenix and where does it run?

gold_en: X For You Phoenix comes from X / xAI, 2026. Deployed in: X For You feed, open repository.
gold_zh: X For You Phoenix 来自 X / xAI，2026 年。上线位置：X 的「为你推荐」信息流，开放仓库。

q_en: What is the core idea of X For You Phoenix?
q_zh: X For You Phoenix 的核心思路是什么？
gold_en: Two-tower Phoenix retrieval and a transformer ranker with candidate isolation, written in JAX with Rust serving.
gold_zh: 双塔 Phoenix 召回，以及带候选隔离的 transformer 排序器，用 JAX 编写、Rust 服务。

q_en: What results does X For You Phoenix report?
q_zh: X For You Phoenix 报告了哪些结果？

q_en: Does X For You Phoenix have online evidence, and how long was the A/B?
q_zh: X For You Phoenix 有线上证据吗，A/B 做了多久？

q_en: What should I keep in mind when reading the results of X For You Phoenix?

q_en: What serving latency, QPS, cost or hardware does X For You Phoenix report?
q_zh: X For You Phoenix 报告了怎样的服务延迟、QPS、成本和硬件？
