q_en: What is OneLoc, in one sentence?
q_zh: OneLoc 一句话是什么？
gold_en: OneLoc generates geo-aware semantic IDs end to end for Kuaishou local life; a one-week A/B at 10% traffic lifted GMV +21.016% and now serves full traffic.
gold_zh: OneLoc 为快手本地生活端到端生成地理感知语义 ID；10% 流量一周 A/B GMV +21.016%，现已全量。

q_en: Who built OneLoc and where does it run?
q_zh: OneLoc 是谁做的，用在哪里？
gold_en: OneLoc comes from Kuaishou, 2025. Deployed in: Kuaishou local life service, full traffic.
gold_zh: OneLoc 来自 快手，2025 年。上线位置：快手本地生活服务，全量流量。

q_en: What is the core idea of OneLoc?
q_zh: OneLoc 的核心思路是什么？
gold_en: Fuse location into semantic IDs, attention and decoder prompts, then align generation with distance and GMV rewards.
gold_zh: 把位置融入语义 ID、注意力和解码器提示，再用距离与 GMV 奖励对齐生成。

q_en: What results does OneLoc report?
q_zh: OneLoc 报告了哪些结果？
gold_en: Online A/B, Table 4, one week, which Sec 5 describes as run on Kuaishou's primary short-video recommendation scenario, at 10% treatment traffic against the production-level multi-stage pipeline with identical candidate pools: GMV +21.016%, order volume +17.891%, number of paying users +18.585% and new paying users +23.027%, all significant at p < 0.01 under two-tailed t-tests. Offline, Sec 4.2: on KuaiLLSR, OneLoc improves Recall@5 +13.46%, Recall@20 +10.44%, NDCG@5 +14.47% and NDCG@20 +12.97% over the second-best baseline; on the Foursquare global dataset the average gains are +13.18% Recall@5 and +16.34% NDCG@5. Ablations, Table 3: removing location scores drops Recall@5 from 0.3565 to 0.3476, removing the location gate to 0.3501, and removing geo-aware self-attention entirely to 0.3315. Scaling from 0.05B to 0.3B brings an average +6.96% recall and +7.29% NDCG.
gold_zh: 线上 A/B 见表 4，一周，5 节称在快手主要短视频推荐场景进行，实验组 10% 流量，基线为候选池一致的生产级多阶段管线：GMV +21.016%、订单量 +17.891%、本地生活付费用户数 +18.585%、新付费用户 +23.027%，双尾 t 检验 p < 0.01。离线见 4.2 节：KuaiLLSR 上 Recall@5 +13.46%、Recall@20 +10.44%、NDCG@5 +14.47%、NDCG@20 +12.97%；Foursquare 全球集平均 Recall@5 +13.18%、NDCG@5 +16.34%。消融见表 3：去掉位置分数 Recall@5 从 0.3565 降到 0.3476，去掉位置门控降到 0.3501，整个地理感知自注意力去掉降到 0.3315。模型从 0.05B 扩到 0.3B 平均召回 +6.96%、NDCG +7.29%。

q_en: Does OneLoc have online evidence, and how long was the A/B?
q_zh: OneLoc 有线上证据吗，A/B 做了多久？
gold_en: Online evidence: Online numbers. A/B duration: One week. A/B traffic: 10% of traffic in the treatment group, control on the production pipeline.
gold_zh: 线上证据：有线上数据。A/B 时长：一周。A/B 流量：实验组 10% 流量，对照组用生产管线。

q_en: What should I keep in mind when reading the results of OneLoc?
q_zh: 读 OneLoc 的结果时要注意什么？
gold_en: The paper states that local life service is disabled when a user forbids the app from visiting her real-time location. Offline baselines include traditional and generative recommenders, but the online comparison is against the production multi-stage pipeline only.
gold_zh: 论文说明当用户禁止 App 访问其实时位置时，本地生活服务会被停用。 离线基线含传统与生成式推荐器，但线上仅与生产多阶段管线对比。

q_en: What inputs does OneLoc use?
q_zh: OneLoc 用了哪些输入？
gold_en: IDs and tokenization: Geo-aware semantic IDs from residual quantization with 3 codebooks of 8192 clusters. Input signals: Watch, click and pay behavior sequences with location IDs and location context embeddings; User real-time location as a gate and as the decoder query, with surrounding locations as keys and values; Geographic reward by user-store distance and GMV reward for DPO preference pairs.
gold_zh: ID 与 token 化：残差量化 3 个 8192 聚类码本的地理感知语义 ID。 输入特征：带位置 ID 与位置上下文嵌入的观看、点击、支付行为序列；用户实时位置作为门控与解码器 Query，周边位置作为 Key 和 Value；按用户门店距离的地理奖励与 GMV 奖励，用于 DPO 偏好对。

q_en: What does the source of OneLoc not report?
q_zh: OneLoc 的原文有哪些没有报告？
gold_en: The source does not report: A/B control-group share beyond the 10% treatment allocation; Inference latency numbers; Training compute beyond the A800 GPU mention; Official code.
gold_zh: 原文没有报告：10% 实验组之外的 A/B 对照组流量占比；推理延迟数字；A800 之外的训练算力；官方代码。

q_en: What is OneRec, in one sentence?
q_zh: OneRec 一句话是什么？
gold_en: OneRec-V2: a lazy decoder-only generator over semantic IDs with real-feedback RL; A/B vs OneRec-V1 gave App Stay Time +0.467% (Kuaishou), +0.741% (Lite).
gold_zh: OneRec-V2：在 Semantic ID 上的 lazy decoder-only 生成器，带真实反馈的 RL；A/B 对比 OneRec-V1，App 停留时长 +0.467%，快手，+0.741%，极速版。

q_en: Who built OneRec and where does it run?
q_zh: OneRec 是谁做的，用在哪里？
gold_en: OneRec comes from Kuaishou, 2025. Deployed in: Kuaishou and Kuaishou Lite short-video feeds, A/B on a 5% traffic group.
gold_zh: OneRec 来自 快手，2025 年。上线位置：快手和快手极速版的短视频信息流，A/B 用 5% 的流量组。

q_en: What is the core idea of OneRec?
q_zh: OneRec 的核心思路是什么？
gold_en: A lazy decoder-only generator over 3-level semantic IDs, post-trained with real user-feedback rewards.
gold_zh: 在 3 级 Semantic ID 上的 lazy decoder-only 生成器，用真实的用户反馈奖励做后训练。

q_en: What results does OneRec report?
q_zh: OneRec 报告了哪些结果？
gold_en: A/B of OneRec-V2 on the Kuaishou and Kuaishou Lite feeds versus OneRec-V1 (5% traffic group, one week, 1B model, user-feedback signals only): App Stay Time +0.467% / +0.741%, LT7 +0.069% / +0.034% (Table 8). Platform with 400 million daily active users. Compared with OneRec-V1 at 1B parameters in Fig 1 right and Table 7.
gold_zh: OneRec-V2 在快手和快手极速版信息流上相对 OneRec-V1 的 A/B：5% 流量组，一周，1B 模型，只用用户反馈信号：App 停留时长 +0.467% / +0.741%，LT7 +0.069% / +0.034%，见表 8。平台有四亿日活用户。在图 1 右侧和表 7 中，与 1B 参数的 OneRec-V1 对比。

q_en: Does OneRec have online evidence, and how long was the A/B?
q_zh: OneRec 有线上证据吗，A/B 做了多久？
gold_en: Online evidence: Online numbers. A/B duration: One week. A/B traffic: 5% traffic group.
gold_zh: 线上证据：有线上数据。A/B 时长：一周。A/B 流量：5% 流量组。

q_en: What should I keep in mind when reading the results of OneRec?
q_zh: 读 OneRec 的结果时要注意什么？
gold_en: Gains are relative to OneRec-V1, not to a non-OneRec baseline; the A/B used only user-feedback reward signals, to reduce system complexity. In a separate 1% experiment with caching disabled (Appendix D), the paper reports cold-start video views down 44.7% on Kuaishou and 36.7% on Kuaishou Lite, an ecosystem-level cost.
gold_zh: 收益是相对 OneRec-V1，而不是相对非 OneRec 的基线；A/B 只用用户反馈奖励信号，以降低系统复杂度。 在一个单独的 1% 实验中，关闭缓存，见附录 D，论文报告冷启动视频的播放量在快手下降 44.7%，在快手极速版下降 36.7%，这是生态层面的代价。

q_en: What serving latency, QPS, cost or hardware does OneRec report?
q_zh: OneRec 报告了怎样的服务延迟、QPS、成本和硬件？
gold_en: Serving latency: 36 ms online latency with context length 3000 and beam size 512. Serving QPS: not reported. Inference cost: not reported. Hardware: L20 GPUs with 62% model FLOPs utilization.
gold_zh: 服务延迟：线上延迟 36 ms，上下文长度 3000，beam 大小 512。 服务 QPS：未报告。 推理成本：未报告。 硬件：L20 GPU，模型 FLOPs 利用率 62%。

q_en: How is OneRec trained?
q_zh: OneRec 是怎么训练的？
gold_en: Training mode: Pretraining of the generator, then post-training with preference alignment on real user interaction signals. Objectives: Next semantic-ID token prediction; Duration-Aware Reward Shaping to reduce video-duration bias; Adaptive Ratio Clipping / GBPO (Gradient-Bounded Policy Optimization) for stable policy updates.
gold_zh: 训练方式：先预训练生成器，再用真实的用户交互信号做偏好对齐的后训练。 训练目标：下一个 Semantic ID token 的预测；Duration-Aware Reward Shaping，用于降低视频时长偏差；Adaptive Ratio Clipping 和 GBPO，即 Gradient-Bounded Policy Optimization，用于稳定策略更新。

q_en: What is OneSearch, in one sentence?
q_zh: OneSearch 一句话是什么？
gold_en: One encoder-decoder generates item semantic IDs for Kuaishou mall search, replacing the recall/pre-rank/rank cascade; online orders +3.22% with reward-model selection.
gold_zh: 一个 encoder-decoder 为快手商城搜索生成 item Semantic ID，取代召回、预排序和排序的级联；选用奖励模型后，线上订单 +3.22%。

q_en: Who built OneSearch and where does it run?
q_zh: OneSearch 是谁做的，用在哪里？
gold_en: OneSearch comes from Kuaishou, 2025. Deployed in: Kuaishou e-commerce search, mall search and detail-page search.
gold_zh: OneSearch 来自 快手，2025 年。上线位置：快手电商搜索，商城搜索和详情页搜索。

q_en: What is the core idea of OneSearch?
q_zh: OneSearch 的核心思路是什么？
gold_en: One encoder-decoder generates item semantic IDs and replaces the recall, pre-rank and rank cascade.
gold_zh: 一个 encoder-decoder 生成 item Semantic ID，取代召回、预排序和排序的级联。

q_en: What results does OneSearch report?
q_zh: OneSearch 报告了哪些结果？
gold_en: Online A/B on Kuaishou mall search (OneSearch with additional reward-model selection vs online cascade): search PVs +1.10%, item CTR +1.67%, PV CTR +3.14%, PV CVR +1.78%, buyers +2.40%, orders +3.22%. Pure OneSearch (no reward-model selection) is comparable to the online cascade. A cascade with only recall + pre-rank (no ranking) lost 9.97% item CTR and 39.14% orders.
gold_zh: 快手商城搜索的线上 A/B，即额外选用奖励模型的 OneSearch 对比线上级联：搜索 PV +1.10%，item CTR +1.67%，PV CTR +3.14%，PV CVR +1.78%，买家数 +2.40%，订单 +3.22%。纯 OneSearch，不选用奖励模型，与线上级联相当。只有召回加预排序、没有排序的级联，item CTR 下降 9.97%，订单下降 39.14%。

q_en: Does OneSearch have online evidence, and how long was the A/B?
q_zh: OneSearch 有线上证据吗，A/B 做了多久？
gold_en: Online evidence: Online numbers. A/B duration: not reported. A/B traffic: not reported.
gold_zh: 线上证据：有线上数据。A/B 时长：未报告。A/B 流量：未报告。

q_en: What should I keep in mind when reading the results of OneSearch?
q_zh: 读 OneSearch 的结果时要注意什么？
gold_en: Title calls this a 'preliminary exploration'; deployment is partial (100% / 50% / 20% on three surfaces). Best online gains require the added reward-model selection; the pure generative model only matches the cascade.
gold_zh: 标题称这是「preliminary exploration」；部署是部分的，三个场景上分别为 100%、50% 和 20%。 最好的线上收益需要额外选用奖励模型；纯生成式模型只能与级联持平。

q_en: What serving latency, QPS, cost or hardware does OneSearch report?
q_zh: OneSearch 报告了怎样的服务延迟、QPS、成本和硬件？
gold_en: Serving latency: not reported. Serving QPS: not reported. Inference cost: Operational expenditure reduced by 75.40%. Hardware: not reported.
gold_zh: 服务延迟：未报告。 服务 QPS：未报告。 推理成本：运营支出降低 75.40%。 硬件：未报告。

q_en: How is OneSearch trained?
q_zh: OneSearch 是怎么训练的？
gold_en: Training mode: SFT + reward-weighted ranking.
gold_zh: 训练方式：SFT 加奖励加权排序。

q_en: What is PLUM, in one sentence?
q_zh: PLUM 一句话是什么？
gold_en: Adapts pretrained LLMs to recommendation with Semantic-ID tokenization and generative retrieval; launched to billions of users, beating the embedding-table production model.
gold_zh: 用 Semantic ID 的 tokenization 和生成式召回，把预训练的 LLM 适配到推荐；已面向数十亿用户上线，优于基于 embedding 表的线上模型。

q_en: Who built PLUM and where does it run?
q_zh: PLUM 是谁做的，用在哪里？
gold_en: PLUM comes from Google / YouTube, 2025. Deployed in: YouTube video recommendation retrieval in LFV and Shorts.
gold_zh: PLUM 来自 Google / YouTube，2025 年。上线位置：YouTube 在 LFV 和 Shorts 中的视频推荐召回。

q_en: What is the core idea of PLUM?
q_zh: PLUM 的核心思路是什么？
gold_en: Adapt pretrained LLMs with semantic-ID tokenization, continued pretraining and fine-tuning for generative retrieval.
gold_zh: 用 Semantic ID 的 tokenization、继续预训练和微调，适配预训练的 LLM，做生成式召回。

q_en: What results does PLUM report?
q_zh: PLUM 报告了哪些结果？
gold_en: Abstract: substantial improvements for retrieval over a heavily optimised embedding-table production model.
gold_zh: 摘要：相对经过深度优化的基于 embedding 表的线上模型，召回有明显提升。

q_en: Does PLUM have online evidence, and how long was the A/B?
q_zh: PLUM 有线上证据吗，A/B 做了多久？
gold_en: Online evidence: Online, no figures. A/B duration: not reported. A/B traffic: not reported.
gold_zh: 线上证据：有线上描述，无具体数字。A/B 时长：未报告。A/B 流量：未报告。

q_en: What should I keep in mind when reading the results of PLUM?
q_zh: 读 PLUM 的结果时要注意什么？
gold_en: Specific online metric deltas are in the paper body but not captured.
gold_zh: 具体的线上指标变化在论文正文里，但没有被记录。

q_en: What does the source of PLUM not report?
q_zh: PLUM 的原文有哪些没有报告？
gold_en: The source does not report: online metric deltas; latency.
gold_zh: 原文没有报告：线上指标变化；延迟。

q_en: Which stages of the pipeline does PLUM cover?
q_zh: PLUM 覆盖链路的哪些阶段？
gold_en: Retrieval: Pretrained LLM (MoE; ~4.2B parameters total per PDF) generating Semantic IDs.
gold_zh: 召回：预训练的 LLM，MoE，据 PDF 总计约 4.2B 参数，生成 Semantic ID。

q_en: What is PinFM, in one sentence?
q_zh: PinFM 一句话是什么？
gold_en: A 20B+ parameter pretrained user-sequence foundation model coupled into Home Feed and Related Items rankers; DCAT gives +600% throughput, +20% new-item engagement.
gold_zh: 一个 20B+ 参数、预训练的用户序列基础模型，耦合进 Home Feed 和 Related Items 的排序器；DCAT 带来 +600% 吞吐，新 item 互动 +20%。

q_en: Who built PinFM and where does it run?
q_zh: PinFM 是谁做的，用在哪里？
gold_en: PinFM comes from Pinterest, 2025. Deployed in: Pinterest Home Feed and Related Items Feed.
gold_zh: PinFM 来自 Pinterest，2025 年。上线位置：Pinterest 的 Home Feed 和 Related Items Feed。

q_en: What is the core idea of PinFM?
q_zh: PinFM 的核心思路是什么？
gold_en: A pretrained user-activity sequence model feeds downstream rankers through a deduplicated cross-attention transformer.
gold_zh: 预训练的用户行为序列模型，通过去重的 cross-attention transformer 为下游排序器提供输入。

q_en: What results does PinFM report?
q_zh: PinFM 报告了哪些结果？
gold_en: Throughput +600% from DCAT (internal data); +20% engagement with new (fresh) items attributed to learning user-sequence/candidate interactions; deployed to Home Feed and Related Items Feed with neutral cost and marginal latency increase. Per-surface online lifts are in the paper's tables and are not reproduced here.
gold_zh: DCAT 带来吞吐 +600%，内部数据；对新 item，即 fresh item 的互动 +20%，归因于学习用户序列和候选之间的交互；已部署到 Home Feed 和 Related Items Feed，成本持平，延迟略有增加。各场景的线上提升在论文的表中，这里未复现。

q_en: Does PinFM have online evidence, and how long was the A/B?
q_zh: PinFM 有线上证据吗，A/B 做了多久？
gold_en: Online evidence: Online numbers. A/B duration: not reported. A/B traffic: not reported.
gold_zh: 线上证据：有线上数据。A/B 时长：未报告。A/B 流量：未报告。

q_en: What should I keep in mind when reading the results of PinFM?
q_zh: 读 PinFM 的结果时要注意什么？
gold_en: Per-surface online A/B percentages were not extracted, so only abstract-level claims are listed. The 20% fresh-item engagement figure is from the paper's abstract; its experimental setup was not re-derived here.
gold_zh: 没有提取各场景的线上 A/B 百分比，所以只列出摘要层面的结论。 新 item 互动 20% 的数字来自论文摘要；这里没有重新推导它的实验设置。

q_en: What does the source of PinFM not report?
q_zh: PinFM 的原文有哪些没有报告？
gold_en: The source does not report: per-surface online metric lifts; GPU type and count; absolute latency.
gold_zh: 原文没有报告：各场景的线上指标提升；GPU 型号和数量；绝对延迟。

q_en: Which stages of the pipeline does PinFM cover?
q_zh: PinFM 覆盖链路的哪些阶段？
gold_en: Ranking: PinFM pretrained transformer over user action sequences (item id, action type, surface, timestamp), fine-tuned inside existing ranking models.
gold_zh: 精排：PinFM 在用户行为序列上预训练的 transformer，序列元素包括 item id、行为类型、场景和时间戳，在现有排序模型内部微调。

q_en: What is PinRec, in one sentence?
q_zh: PinRec 一句话是什么？
gold_en: Pinterest's PinRec is one generative retriever pre-trained across surfaces and fine-tuned per surface, with outcome-conditioned generation; Search A/B gives fulfillment +2.24% and saves +3.88%.
gold_zh: Pinterest 的 PinRec 是跨场景预训练、再按场景微调的统一生成式召回模型，带结果条件生成；Search A/B 中 fulfillment +2.24%，saves +3.88%。

q_en: Who built PinRec and where does it run?
q_zh: PinRec 是谁做的，用在哪里？
gold_en: PinRec comes from Pinterest, 2025. Deployed in: Pinterest Home Feed, Related Pins and Search.
gold_zh: PinRec 来自 Pinterest，2025 年。上线位置：Pinterest 的 Home Feed、Related Pins 和 Search。

q_en: What is the core idea of PinRec?
q_zh: PinRec 的核心思路是什么？
gold_en: Pre-train one generative retriever on all surfaces, fine-tune it per surface, and condition generation on the outcome each surface cares about.
gold_zh: 预训练一个跨所有场景的生成式召回模型，按场景微调，并让生成以各场景关心的结果为条件。

q_en: What results does PinRec report?
q_zh: PinRec 报告了哪些结果？
gold_en: Online A/B as a candidate generator, passed through unmodified ranking and blending. Search, PinRec-OC against a control group: search fulfillment rate +2.24%, search saves +3.88% and search shares +5.30%. Home Feed, OC against UC: fulfilled sessions +0.21% against +0.02%, site-wide grid clicks +1.76% against +0.58%, Home Feed grid clicks +4.01% against +1.87%. Related Pins, OC: fulfilled sessions +0.21%, time spent +0.38%, site-wide grid clicks +0.76%, sitewide saves +0.26%, and in Search fulfillment +0.42% and saves +0.39%. Zero-shot, Related Searches fulfilled sessions +1.66% and module click rate +4.04%, and for Ads cost per acquisition -1.83% and cost per click -1.41%. Against a production two-tower model, corpus coverage +17.3% for OC and +6.2% for UC. Offline unordered recall at 10 on Home Feed, Related Pins and Search: SASRec 0.382, 0.426, 0.142; PinnerFormer 0.461, 0.412, 0.257; TIGER 0.208, 0.230, 0.090; HSTU 0.596, 0.539, 0.179; PinRec-UC 0.608, 0.521, 0.350; PinRec-OC 0.625, 0.537, 0.352. Removing outcome conditioning costs -7.5% to -12.6% recall and removing fine-tuning costs -2.0% to -4.5%. Autoregressive generation with 16 steps lifts recall by +71.4% on Related Pins, +8.8% on Home Feed and +11.1% on Search against 1 step. Serving latency is 3-4x a two-tower model at p50 and adds under 1% end-to-end.
gold_zh: 作为候选生成器的线上 A/B，候选原样进入排序和混排。Search 上，PinRec-OC 对比 control group：search fulfillment rate +2.24%，search saves +3.88%，search shares +5.30%。Home Feed 上，OC 对比 UC：fulfilled sessions +0.21% 对 +0.02%，site-wide grid clicks +1.76% 对 +0.58%，Home Feed grid clicks +4.01% 对 +1.87%。Related Pins 上，OC：fulfilled sessions +0.21%，time spent +0.38%，site-wide grid clicks +0.76%，sitewide saves +0.26%，同时 Search 的 fulfillment +0.42%，saves +0.39%。零样本方面，Related Searches 的 fulfilled sessions +1.66%，module click rate +4.04%，Ads 的 cost per acquisition -1.83%，cost per click -1.41%。对比线上的生产双塔模型，corpus coverage OC 为 +17.3%，UC 为 +6.2%。离线 unordered recall at 10，依次为 Home Feed、Related Pins、Search：SASRec 0.382、0.426、0.142；PinnerFormer 0.461、0.412、0.257；TIGER 0.208、0.230、0.090；HSTU 0.596、0.539、0.179；PinRec-UC 0.608、0.521、0.350；PinRec-OC 0.625、0.537、0.352。去掉结果条件，recall 下降 -7.5% 到 -12.6%；去掉微调，下降 -2.0% 到 -4.5%。与 1 步相比，16 步自回归生成使 recall 在 Related Pins 上提升 +71.4%，Home Feed 上 +8.8%，Search 上 +11.1%。服务延迟在 p50 上是双塔模型的 3-4x，端到端只增加不到 1%。

q_en: Does PinRec have online evidence, and how long was the A/B?
q_zh: PinRec 有线上证据吗，A/B 做了多久？
gold_en: Online evidence: Online numbers. A/B duration: not reported. A/B traffic: not reported.
gold_zh: 线上证据：有线上数据。A/B 时长：未报告。A/B 流量：未报告。

q_en: What should I keep in mind when reading the results of PinRec?
q_zh: 读 PinRec 的结果时要注意什么？
gold_en: The A/B tests give no duration, traffic share or user count, and the paper reports only relative lifts; the Pareto figures omit absolute values as non-public. Table 7 compares PinRec-OC with a control group that is not described further; Tables 5 and 6 do not name a baseline either, and the candidates are added next to other candidate generators.
gold_zh: A/B 没有给出时长、流量占比或用户数，论文只报告相对提升；Pareto 图因属于非公开信息而省略了绝对值。 Table 7 的对照是一个没有进一步描述的 control group；Table 5 和 Table 6 也没有写明基线，候选还是与其他候选生成器并列加入的。

q_en: What scale does PinRec report?
q_zh: PinRec 报告了哪些规模信息？
gold_en: Transformer size: about 100 million parameters, 12 layers and 768 hidden dimensions. GPU memory per model: about 1.6GiB including KV cache and CUDA graphs. Latency at 80 QPS: PinRec-OC p50 40ms and p90 65ms; PinRec-UC p50 23ms and p90 46ms.
gold_zh: Transformer 规模：约 1 亿参数，12 层，768 隐层维度。 每个模型的 GPU 显存：约 1.6GiB，含 KV cache 和 CUDA graphs。 Latency at 80 QPS：PinRec-OC 的 p50 为 40ms、p90 为 65ms；PinRec-UC 的 p50 为 23ms、p90 为 46ms。

q_en: What serving latency, QPS, cost or hardware does PinRec report?
q_zh: PinRec 报告了怎样的服务延迟、QPS、成本和硬件？
gold_en: Serving latency: At 80 QPS, p50 40ms and p90 65ms for PinRec-OC, p50 23ms and p90 46ms for PinRec-UC; 3-4x a two-tower model at p50 and under 1% added end-to-end latency when parallelized. Serving QPS: Latency was measured at 80 QPS; total production QPS is not reported. Inference cost: About 1.6GiB of GPU memory with KV cache and CUDA graphs, and about 250 MiB without them, the same as the existing two-tower retrieval. Hardware: NVIDIA L40S GPUs for the transformer; Faiss IVF-HNSW on CPU hosts.
gold_zh: 服务延迟：80 QPS 下，PinRec-OC 的 p50 为 40ms、p90 为 65ms，PinRec-UC 的 p50 为 23ms、p90 为 46ms；p50 是双塔模型的 3-4x，并行化后端到端延迟增加不到 1%。 服务 QPS：延迟是在 80 QPS 下测得的；生产总 QPS 未报告。 推理成本：含 KV cache 和 CUDA graphs 时约 1.6GiB GPU 显存，不含时约 250 MiB，与现有双塔召回相当。 硬件：Transformer 使用 NVIDIA L40S GPU；Faiss IVF-HNSW 运行在 CPU 主机上。

q_en: What is RankMixer, in one sentence?
q_zh: RankMixer 一句话是什么？
gold_en: Ranking backbone with parameter-free token mixing and per-token FFNs instead of self-attention; Douyin Feed full launch gave active days +0.3%, in-app duration +1.08%.
gold_zh: 排序骨干用无参数的 token mixing 和每个 token 独立的 FFN，取代 self-attention；抖音信息流全量上线后，活跃天数 +0.3%，应用内时长 +1.08%。

q_en: Who built RankMixer and where does it run?
q_zh: RankMixer 是谁做的，用在哪里？
gold_en: RankMixer comes from ByteDance, 2025. Deployed in: Douyin feed ranking, full traffic.
gold_zh: RankMixer 来自 字节跳动，2025 年。上线位置：抖音信息流排序，全量流量。

q_en: What is the core idea of RankMixer?
q_zh: RankMixer 的核心思路是什么？
gold_en: Turn feature groups into tokens, mix them without self-attention, and give each token its own FFN.
gold_zh: 把特征组变成 token，不用 self-attention 来混合它们，并给每个 token 配独立的 FFN。

q_en: What results does RankMixer report?
q_zh: RankMixer 报告了哪些结果？
gold_en: Full-traffic launch on Douyin Feed ranking: active days +0.3%, total in-app duration +1.08% (abstract); A/B tests also in an advertisement scenario. Inference latency roughly unchanged while parameters scale by about two orders of magnitude.
gold_zh: 抖音信息流排序全量上线：活跃天数 +0.3%，应用内总时长 +1.08%，来自摘要；广告场景中也做了 A/B 测试。参数量扩大约两个数量级，推理延迟大致不变。

q_en: Does RankMixer have online evidence, and how long was the A/B?
q_zh: RankMixer 有线上证据吗，A/B 做了多久？
gold_en: Online evidence: Online numbers. A/B duration: not reported. A/B traffic: not reported.
gold_zh: 线上证据：有线上数据。A/B 时长：未报告。A/B 流量：未报告。

q_en: What should I keep in mind when reading the results of RankMixer?
q_zh: 读 RankMixer 的结果时要注意什么？
gold_en: The paper gives different scale-up factors, namely 70x, over 100x and two orders of magnitude; the exact baseline used is not pinned in the sections read. Douyin is stated for the full-traffic launch; the second A/B scenario is advertising, details not reproduced here.
gold_zh: 论文给出了不同的扩大倍数，即 70x、over 100x 和两个数量级；在所读章节中没有确定具体使用的基线。 全量上线说明的是抖音；第二个 A/B 场景是广告，这里没有复现细节。

q_en: Which stages of the pipeline does RankMixer cover?
q_zh: RankMixer 覆盖链路的哪些阶段？
gold_en: Ranking: RankMixer: stacked blocks of multi-head token mixing + per-token FFN (SMoE variant for ~1B parameters).
gold_zh: 精排：RankMixer：多头 token mixing 加每个 token 的 FFN 堆叠成的 block，SMoE 变体用于约 1B 参数。

q_en: What scale does RankMixer report?
q_zh: RankMixer 报告了哪些规模信息？
gold_en: Model size: 1B dense-parameter RankMixer launched for full-traffic serving; paper states a 70x parameter scale-up without increasing inference cost (contributions) and 'over 100x' / 'two orders of magnitude' elsewhere. MFU: 4.5% -> 45% by replacing handcrafted modules. Training data: 'trillion-scale' production dataset.
gold_zh: 模型规模：1B 稠密参数的 RankMixer 已用于全量流量的在线服务；论文在贡献部分称参数扩大 70x 而推理成本不增加，其他地方称「over 100x」或「two orders of magnitude」。 MFU：通过替换人工设计的模块，从 4.5% 提高到 45%。 训练数据：「万亿规模」的线上数据集。

q_en: What is URM, in one sentence?
q_zh: URM 一句话是什么？
gold_en: URM turns a fine-tuned Qwen-7B LLM into a universal generative retriever driven by text objectives; an online A/B lifted advertising revenue +3.01%.
gold_zh: URM 把微调后的 Qwen-7B LLM 变成由文本目标驱动的通用生成式检索器；线上 A/B 广告收入 +3.01%。

q_en: Who built URM and where does it run?
q_zh: URM 是谁做的，用在哪里？
gold_en: URM comes from Alibaba, 2025. Deployed in: Retrieval on the Alibaba advertising platform.
gold_zh: URM 来自 阿里巴巴，2025 年。上线位置：阿里巴巴广告平台的检索。

q_en: What is the core idea of URM?
q_zh: URM 的核心思路是什么？
gold_en: One fine-tuned LLM generates retrieval results for any text-described objective over the full candidate set.
gold_zh: 一个微调后的 LLM 按任意文本描述的目标在完整候选集上生成检索结果

q_en: Does URM have online evidence, and how long was the A/B?
q_zh: URM 有线上证据吗，A/B 做了多久？
gold_en: Online evidence: Online numbers. A/B duration: April 28 to May 14, 2025. A/B traffic: not reported.
gold_zh: 线上证据：有线上数据。A/B 时长：2025 年四月 28 日至五月 14 日。A/B 流量：未报告。

q_en: What should I keep in mind when reading the results of URM?
q_zh: 读 URM 的结果时要注意什么？
gold_en: Retrieval results are precomputed asynchronously per 10-minute window, so the online path is not per-request LLM inference. The abstract states the core metric improved by 3% and the introduction says over 3%; Sec 5.5 Table 6 gives the exact +3.01% for advertising revenue.
gold_zh: 检索结果按 10 分钟窗口异步预计算，线上路径不是每次请求都跑一遍 LLM 推理。 摘要写核心指标提升 3%，引言写超过 3%；5.5 节表 6 给出广告收入的精确值 +3.01%。

q_en: How is URM trained?
q_zh: URM 是怎么训练的？
gold_en: Training mode: Offline supervised fine-tuning on a 5% sample of daily data, aggregated hourly to fit a 24-hour budget. Objectives: Noise Contrastive Estimation loss over the max of M query-representation scores, with 10,000 negatives per batch sampled by the 3/4 power of item frequency.
gold_zh: 训练方式：对每日数据抽样 5% 后做离线监督微调，按小时聚合以适配 24 小时预算。 训练目标：以 M 个查询表示得分最大值上的 NCE 损失为目标，每批 10,000 个负例按物品频次 3/4 次幂采样。

q_en: Is there code for URM?
q_zh: URM 有代码吗？
gold_en: Code status: No code found.
gold_zh: 代码状态：未发现公开代码。

q_en: What inputs does URM use?
q_zh: URM 用了哪些输入？
gold_en: IDs and tokenization: Full item IDs, not semantic IDs. Input signals: Serialized user features: static attributes, statistical features and behavior sequences, with empty features omitted and sequences truncated without padding; Retrieval objectives expressed as natural-language text, such as multi-scenario, multi-behavior, long-tail, serendipity, long-term interest and search; Fixed learnable query tokens appended to the input sequence; Item-side serialized text features through a General Text Embedding.
gold_zh: ID 与 token 化：完整物品 ID，不用 Semantic ID。 输入特征：序列化用户特征：静态属性、统计特征与行为序列，空特征直接省略，序列只截断不填充；检索目标用自然语言文本表达，如多场景、多行为、长尾、惊喜度、长期兴趣与搜索；输入序列末尾附加固定可学习查询 token；物品侧序列化文本特征经 General Text Embedding 处理。

q_en: What is Generative Recommenders / HSTU, in one sentence?
q_zh: Generative Recommenders / HSTU 一句话是什么？
gold_en: Recasts retrieval and ranking as sequence transduction with the HSTU attention encoder in place of DLRM interactions; reports +12.4% online on topline metrics.
gold_zh: 把召回和排序重新表述为序列转导，用 HSTU 注意力编码器取代 DLRM 的特征交互；报告线上头条指标 +12.4%。

q_en: Who built Generative Recommenders / HSTU and where does it run?
q_zh: Generative Recommenders / HSTU 是谁做的，用在哪里？
gold_en: Generative Recommenders / HSTU comes from Meta, 2024. Deployed in: Multiple surfaces of an unnamed large internet platform.
gold_zh: Generative Recommenders / HSTU 来自 Meta，2024 年。上线位置：一个未具名大型互联网平台的多个场景。

q_en: What is the core idea of Generative Recommenders / HSTU?
q_zh: Generative Recommenders / HSTU 的核心思路是什么？
gold_en: Recast retrieval and ranking as sequential transduction with a pointwise-aggregated-attention encoder.
gold_zh: 用 pointwise 聚合注意力的编码器，把召回和排序重新表述为序列转导。

q_en: What results does Generative Recommenders / HSTU report?
q_zh: Generative Recommenders / HSTU 报告了哪些结果？
gold_en: +12.4% online A/B on topline metrics, deployed on multiple surfaces (abstract); per-task online deltas in Table 6 (retrieval, above). Public datasets: HSTU-large beats SASRec by up to +65.8% NDCG@10 (Amazon Books).
gold_zh: 线上 A/B 头条指标 +12.4%，已部署在多个场景，来自摘要；各任务的线上变化见表 6，召回部分见上文。公开数据集：HSTU-large 在 NDCG@10 上最高比 SASRec 高 +65.8%，Amazon Books。

q_en: Does Generative Recommenders / HSTU have online evidence, and how long was the A/B?
q_zh: Generative Recommenders / HSTU 有线上证据吗，A/B 做了多久？
gold_en: Online evidence: Online numbers. A/B duration: not reported. A/B traffic: not reported.
gold_zh: 线上证据：有线上数据。A/B 时长：未报告。A/B 流量：未报告。

q_en: What should I keep in mind when reading the results of Generative Recommenders / HSTU?
q_zh: 读 Generative Recommenders / HSTU 的结果时要注意什么？
gold_en: Platform and surfaces are not named as a 'large internet platform with billions of users'; this card labels the company Meta from author affiliation only. The +12.4% is a topline figure; its metric definition is not given in the abstract/intro.
gold_zh: 论文没有说出平台和场景，只称为「拥有数十亿用户的大型互联网平台」；这张卡片仅根据作者所属单位把公司标为 Meta。 +12.4% 是头条数字；摘要和引言中没有给出它的指标定义。

q_en: What does the source of Generative Recommenders / HSTU not report?
q_zh: Generative Recommenders / HSTU 的原文有哪些没有报告？
gold_en: The source does not report: named product surface; absolute QPS / latency numbers; exact metric behind +12.4%.
gold_zh: 原文没有报告：具体的产品场景；绝对 QPS 和延迟数字；+12.4% 背后的具体指标。

q_en: Which stages of the pipeline does Generative Recommenders / HSTU cover?
q_zh: Generative Recommenders / HSTU 覆盖链路的哪些阶段？
gold_en: Retrieval: HSTU generative retrieval (user-sequence encoder). Ranking: HSTU generative ranking, multi-task (engagement 'E-Task' and consumption 'C-Task'), evaluated with Normalized Entropy.
gold_zh: 召回：HSTU 生成式召回，用户序列编码器。 精排：HSTU 生成式排序，多任务，包含互动 E-Task 和消费 C-Task，用 Normalized Entropy 评估。

q_en: What is KuaiFormer, in one sentence?
q_zh: KuaiFormer 一句话是什么？
gold_en: Pure-Transformer real-time retrieval for short video: next-action prediction with multiple interest query tokens; offline HR@500 15.61% vs 11.31% for the best other method.
gold_zh: 面向短视频的纯 Transformer 实时召回：带多个兴趣 query token 的下一行为预测；离线 HR@500 为 15.61%，最好的其他方法为 11.31%。

q_en: Who built KuaiFormer and where does it run?
q_zh: KuaiFormer 是谁做的，用在哪里？
gold_en: KuaiFormer comes from Kuaishou, 2024. Deployed in: Kuaishou short-video retrieval, one extra pathway since May 2024.
gold_zh: KuaiFormer 来自 快手，2024 年。上线位置：快手短视频召回，自 May 2024 起作为一条额外通路。

q_en: What is the core idea of KuaiFormer?
q_zh: KuaiFormer 的核心思路是什么？
gold_en: A pure Transformer with learnable query tokens for multiple interests and adaptive item compression.
gold_zh: 纯 Transformer，用可学习的 query token 表示多个兴趣，并做自适应 item 压缩。

q_en: What results does KuaiFormer report?
q_zh: KuaiFormer 报告了哪些结果？
gold_en: Offline hit rate against real viewed items on replayed online requests per Table 1, KuaiFormer vs best other method: HR@50 4.21% vs GNN 3.97%; HR@100 6.58% vs GPRP 5.21%; HR@500 15.61% vs GPRP 11.31%; HR@1000 19.88% vs GPRP 15.70%. SASRec scores 1.17/2.51/5.37/7.22. Online A/B, one week with 10% of users in three scenarios per Table 2: video watch time +0.360% (Kuaishou single page), +0.126% (Kuaishou Lite single page), +0.411% (Kuaishou double page); also usage-time and engagement columns (likes, follows, comments, Novel Surprise views) positive in Table 2; the column headers are garbled in the extracted text so individual non-watch-time values are not quoted here. The paper calls it one of the most significant retrieval experiments at Kuaishou in 2024. Ablations: accuracy rises from 0.325 (length 8) to 0.441 (256); layers 1 to 5 raise accuracy from 0.391 to 0.435 with diminishing returns after 4 (0.433); query tokens saturate near 6; compressed 256 gives 0.445 vs 0.441 uncompressed and 0.417 at length 64.
gold_zh: 在回放的线上请求上，用真实观看过的 item 计算离线命中率，见表 1，KuaiFormer 对比最好的其他方法：HR@50 为 4.21%，GNN 为 3.97%；HR@100 为 6.58%，GPRP 为 5.21%；HR@500 为 15.61%，GPRP 为 11.31%；HR@1000 为 19.88%，GPRP 为 15.70%。SASRec 得分为 1.17/2.51/5.37/7.22。线上 A/B，一周，三个场景各取 10% 的用户，见表 2：视频观看时长 +0.360%，快手单列；+0.126%，快手极速版单列；+0.411%，快手双列；表 2 中使用时长和互动列，包括点赞、关注、评论和 Novel Surprise 观看，也都为正；提取出的文本里列标题是乱码，所以这里没有引用观看时长以外的各项数值。论文称这是快手 2024 年最显著的召回实验之一。消融：准确率从 0.325，长度 8，升到 0.441，长度 256；1 到 5 层使准确率从 0.391 升到 0.435，4 层之后收益递减，为 0.433；query token 在 6 个左右饱和；压缩后的 256 为 0.445，未压缩为 0.441，长度 64 为 0.417。

q_en: Does KuaiFormer have online evidence, and how long was the A/B?
q_zh: KuaiFormer 有线上证据吗，A/B 做了多久？
gold_en: Online evidence: Online numbers. A/B duration: One week. A/B traffic: 10% of users.
gold_zh: 线上证据：有线上数据。A/B 时长：一周。A/B 流量：10% 的用户。

q_en: What should I keep in mind when reading the results of KuaiFormer?
q_zh: 读 KuaiFormer 的结果时要注意什么？
gold_en: The paper's abstract says the system serves over 400 million DAU; the online A/B was on 10% of users for one week. The paper's Table 3 appears in the text as 'Table 3 (a)-(c)' for hyperparameter plots that are drawn in Figure 3; the numbers cited here come from the text and the compression table.
gold_zh: 论文摘要称系统服务超过四亿日活用户；线上 A/B 是在 10% 的用户上做了一周。 论文的表 3 在正文中写作「Table 3 [a]-[c]」，指画在图 3 中的超参数图；这里引用的数字来自正文和压缩表。

q_en: What serving latency, QPS, cost or hardware does KuaiFormer report?
q_zh: KuaiFormer 报告了怎样的服务延迟、QPS、成本和硬件？
gold_en: Serving latency: The paper says retrieval must finish within a few milliseconds; no measured number. Serving QPS: Peak over 100,000 requests per second. Inference cost: not reported. Hardware: GPU brute-force top-K search in practice; no GPU type or count.
gold_zh: 服务延迟：论文称召回必须在几毫秒内完成；没有实测数字。 服务 QPS：峰值超过每秒 100,000 个请求。 推理成本：未报告。 硬件：实际使用 GPU 暴力 top-K 搜索；没有给出 GPU 型号和数量。

q_en: How is KuaiFormer trained?
q_zh: KuaiFormer 是怎么训练的？
gold_en: Training mode: Online learning on a distributed training framework; the model continuously consumes new logs and updates parameters to the online service at minute-level frequency. Sparse embeddings sit on a dedicated embedding server and dense parameters are shipped periodically. Objectives: next-item prediction with smoothed logQ-corrected in-batch softmax.
gold_zh: 训练方式：在分布式训练框架上在线学习；模型持续消费新日志，并以分钟级频率把参数更新到在线服务。稀疏 embedding 放在专门的 embedding 服务器上，稠密参数定期下发。 训练目标：下一个 item 预测，使用平滑且经 logQ 校正的 batch 内 softmax。

q_en: What is Learning to Rank for Maps, in one sentence?
q_zh: Learning to Rank for Maps 一句话是什么？
gold_en: Airbnb finds the order of top map pins doesn't matter, so it drops rank-based attention and a Bookability Filter shows fewer pins; alpha 1.0 gave +1.7% uncanceled bookings.
gold_zh: Airbnb 发现排在前面的地图标记点顺序并不重要，于是去掉基于排名的注意力，并用 Bookability Filter 显示更少的标记点；alpha 为 1.0 时未取消预订 +1.7%。

q_en: Who built Learning to Rank for Maps and where does it run?
q_zh: Learning to Rank for Maps 是谁做的，用在哪里？
gold_en: Learning to Rank for Maps comes from Airbnb, 2024. Deployed in: Airbnb map and list search results.
gold_zh: Learning to Rank for Maps 来自 Airbnb，2024 年。上线位置：Airbnb 地图和列表搜索结果。

q_en: What is the core idea of Learning to Rank for Maps?
q_zh: Learning to Rank for Maps 的核心思路是什么？
gold_en: Show only listings close to the best one as map pins, instead of a fixed 18.
gold_zh: 只把与最优房源接近的房源显示为地图标记点，不再固定显示 18 个。

q_en: What results does Learning to Rank for Maps report?
q_zh: Learning to Rank for Maps 报告了哪些结果？
gold_en: Randomization of top map results on mobile showed no booking difference, while the same randomization on search-box queries costs about 8% bookings and up to 5% NDCG. Bookability Filter, offline vs 18-pin baseline per Table 1: alpha 1.0/2.0/4.0/8.0 gives -39%/-25%/-9%/-1% pins. Online per Table 2: alpha 1.0 gives +1.7% uncanceled bookings, +1.6% 5-star trips, -14% avg impressions to discovery, -5.7% avg clicks to discovery. Final larger run at alpha 1.0: +1.9% uncanceled bookings, +2% 5-star trips, -16% results seen before the booked listing, -6.8% results clicked. Robust anchor (second-highest listing): pins +6%, searcher-to-listing-viewer conversion +0.15%; anchor as function of listing count adds another +2.6% pins. Focus vs urgency: randomly choosing 14 of 18 pins gave -1.5% bookings, so urgency is not the cause. Desktop two-tier pins (Table 3, alpha 1.0): +0.7% uncanceled bookings, +0.5% 5-star trips, -21% impressions to discovery, -1.7% clicks to discovery. Map-center feature: +0.27% bookings, +2% pin CTR. Algorithm 2 vs Algorithm 1: +0.39% bookings for new guests (p = 0.006).
gold_zh: 在移动端对排在前面的地图结果做随机化，预订没有差异；而对搜索框查询做同样的随机化，会损失约 8% 的预订和最多 5% 的 NDCG。Bookability Filter 的离线结果，对比 18 个标记点的基线，见表 1：alpha 为 1.0、2.0、4.0、8.0 时，标记点分别减少 -39%、-25%、-9%、-1%。线上结果见表 2：alpha 为 1.0 时，未取消预订 +1.7%，5 星行程 +1.6%，到发现页的平均曝光 -14%，到发现页的平均点击 -5.7%。alpha 为 1.0 的最终更大规模实验：未取消预订 +1.9%，5 星行程 +2%，订到房源之前看到的结果 -16%，被点击的结果 -6.8%。稳健锚点，即第二高的房源：标记点 +6%，搜索用户到房源浏览用户的转化 +0.15%；把锚点设为房源数量的函数，标记点再 +2.6%。聚焦与紧迫感的对比：在 18 个标记点中随机选 14 个，预订 -1.5%，因此紧迫感不是原因。桌面端双层标记点，见表 3，alpha 为 1.0：未取消预订 +0.7%，5 星行程 +0.5%，到发现页的曝光 -21%，到发现页的点击 -1.7%。地图中心特征：预订 +0.27%，标记点 CTR +2%。算法 2 对比算法 1：新用户预订 +0.39%，p = 0.006。

q_en: What is the core idea of LiGNN?
q_zh: LiGNN 的核心思路是什么？
gold_en: A GraphSAGE-style encoder over a hundred-billion-node graph, with temporal modeling and 2-hop PPR sampling.

q_en: What results does LiGNN report?
q_zh: LiGNN 报告了哪些结果？
gold_en: Abstract-level approximate relative production gains: 1% job application hearing-back rate, 2% Ads CTR, 0.5% Feed engaged DAU, 0.2% sessions and 0.1% WAU from People Recommendation. Follow Feed (Table 4, incremental validation AUC): 200 vs 20 neighbors +3.2%, attention aggregator +0.9%, dual encoder +2.5%, ID embeddings +15.3%, graph densification +0.5%, 2-hop PPR sampling +0.6%, temporal graph +5.8%; offline recall +9.6% vs the rule-based candidate selection; online +0.5% Feed engaged DAU. Temporal ablation (Table 1, Feed): baseline AUC 0.71978; all combined 0.76176 (+5.83%). OON Feed: about +0.2% DAU engaging with professional content. Jobs per Table 5: offline AUC +1.1%, online renewal rate +0.3%, positive hearing-back rate +1.0%, company follows +1.8%; temporal model +6.8% AUC in Job Recommendation Ranking with +0.4% job viewers and +0.4% qualified applicants. People Recommendation per Table 7: offline recall +29.6%, sessions +0.2%, WAU +0.1%, new member connections +2.4%; PPR sampling beats weighted sampling by at least 2% (multi-hop PPR +2.3%, 2-hop PPR +2.1%). Ads per Table 8: member embeddings +0.17% AUC, all embeddings +0.39% AUC, about +2% online CTR.
gold_zh: 摘要中给出的线上相对收益，均为近似值：求职申请收到回复率 1%，广告 CTR 2%，Feed 互动 DAU 0.5%，人的推荐带来的会话数 0.2% 和 WAU 0.1%。Follow Feed，见表 4，增量验证 AUC：200 个邻居对比 20 个 +3.2%，attention 聚合器 +0.9%，双编码器 +2.5%，ID embedding +15.3%，图稠密化 +0.5%，2 跳 PPR 采样 +0.6%，时序图 +5.8%；离线 recall 相比基于规则的候选选择 +9.6%；线上 Feed 互动 DAU +0.5%。时序消融，见表 1，Feed：基线 AUC 0.71978；全部组合 0.76176，即 +5.83%。OON Feed：与专业内容互动的 DAU 约 +0.2%。职位，见表 5：离线 AUC +1.1%，线上续订率 +0.3%，正向回复率 +1.0%，公司关注 +1.8%；时序模型在职位推荐排序中 AUC +6.8%，职位浏览者 +0.4%，合格申请者 +0.4%。人的推荐，见表 7：离线 recall +29.6%，会话数 +0.2%，WAU +0.1%，新增成员连接 +2.4%；PPR 采样至少比加权采样好 2%，多跳 PPR +2.3%，2 跳 PPR +2.1%。广告，见表 8：成员 embedding AUC +0.17%，全部 embedding AUC +0.39%，线上 CTR 约 +2%。

q_en: How is LiGNN trained?

gold_en: Training mode: Offline training on Kubernetes with a CPU Graph Engine (Microsoft DeepGNN) plus GPU trainers fetching sampled compute graphs over gRPC; Horovod with NCCL ring allreduce. Distributed training uses 6 to 24 workers. Objectives: link prediction with binary cross entropy and in-batch negative objectives; long-term loss predicting future events for the temporal model.
gold_zh: 训练方式：在 Kubernetes 上离线训练，用 CPU 图引擎 Microsoft DeepGNN，加上通过 gRPC 拉取采样计算图的 GPU 训练器；Horovod 搭配 NCCL ring allreduce。分布式训练使用 6 到 24 个 worker。 训练目标：链接预测，使用二元交叉熵和 batch 内负样本目标；预测未来事件的长期损失，用于时序模型。

q_en: What results does Etsy Unified Embedding Retrieval report?
q_zh: Etsy Unified Embedding Retrieval 报告了哪些结果？
gold_en: Offline per Table I, Recall@100 all / head / tail, Recall@1000: BM25 0.55/0.63/0.45, 0.62; Base 0.33/0.32/0.42, 0.61; Large vocab 0.45/0.45/0.49, 0.72; Random-walk 0.6/0.74/0.52, 0.72; UEPPR 0.674/0.71/0.69, 0.82; UEPPR boost 0.708/0.72/0.71, 0.85. Negative mining ablation per Table II: hard + uniform +3% R@100 and +1.2% R@1000; adding dynamic +9.3% and +5.1%; weighted +11% and +6%. Without hard negatives purchase recall@100 drops 7%. Feature importance relative to the Large vocab model per Table III: T5 title+tags 1.0%, attributes 3.9%, description 6.3%, graph 15%. Location features: 8% relative gain in purchase recall for US users; 98th percentile candidate distance 2600 vs 4200 miles. 1-layer transformer on user history: +2% offline recall. Online A/B tests on live traffic, aggregated: +2.63% site-wide conversion rate, +5.58% organic search purchase rate, larger for signed-in and habitual buyers.
gold_zh: 离线结果，见表 I，格式为 Recall@100 的全部 / 头部 / 长尾，以及 Recall@1000：BM25 0.55/0.63/0.45，0.62；Base 0.33/0.32/0.42，0.61；Large vocab 0.45/0.45/0.49，0.72；Random-walk 0.6/0.74/0.52，0.72；UEPPR 0.674/0.71/0.69，0.82；UEPPR boost 0.708/0.72/0.71，0.85。负样本挖掘消融，见表 II：hard 加 uniform 使 R@100 提升 +3%，R@1000 提升 +1.2%；加入 dynamic 后为 +9.3% 和 +5.1%；加权后为 +11% 和 +6%。没有 hard 负样本时，购买 recall@100 下降 7%。特征重要性，见表 III，相对 Large vocab 模型：T5 标题加标签 1.0%，属性 3.9%，描述 6.3%，图 15%。位置特征：美国用户的购买 recall 相对提升 8%；第 98 百分位的候选距离为 2600 对比 4200 英里。在用户历史上加 1 层 transformer：离线 recall 提升 +2%。线上 A/B 测试，在线上流量中汇总：全站转化率 +2.63%，自然搜索购买率 +5.58%，登录用户和老买家的提升更大。

q_en: Which stages of the pipeline does Etsy Unified Embedding Retrieval cover?
q_zh: Etsy Unified Embedding Retrieval 覆盖链路的哪些阶段？
gold_en: Retrieval: Two-tower. Score y = cos(P(p), Q(q,u)). Product encoder P: token/ID average embeddings in field groups, location encoder (K-means buckets with k = 50, 100, 500 and zip-code prefixes), transformer representation from a T5-small encoder pre-trained to generate the most-purchased query from product text, and a bipartite-graph encoder that averages sampled neighbor query embeddings from over a year of logs, with shared parameter updates frozen. Query-user encoder Q: query tokens, user location, recent searches, recent shop clicks, terms of recently clicked items and tags of purchased items, via a lightweight 1-layer transformer over [q, recent queries, recently clicked shops].
gold_zh: 召回：双塔。得分 y = cos[P[p], Q[q,u]]。商品编码器 P：按字段分组的 token 和 ID 平均 embedding，位置编码器，使用 k = 50、100、500 的 K-means 分桶和邮政编码前缀，来自 T5-small 编码器的 transformer 表示，该编码器经预训练，用于根据商品文本生成购买最多的 query，以及二部图编码器，对来自超过一年日志的采样邻居 query embedding 取平均，并冻结共享参数的更新。Query 与用户编码器 Q：query token、用户位置、最近的搜索、最近点击的店铺、最近点击商品的词项和已购商品的标签，通过对 q、最近的 query 和最近点击的店铺做 1 层轻量 transformer 得到。

q_en: What is TIGER, in one sentence?
q_zh: TIGER 一句话是什么？
gold_en: Items get Semantic IDs via RQ-VAE and a Transformer decodes the next item's ID, replacing embedding-table ANN retrieval; helps cold-start items on public datasets.

q_en: Who built TIGER and where does it run?

q_en: What is the core idea of TIGER?
q_zh: TIGER 的核心思路是什么？

gold_zh: 用 RQ-VAE 把内容 embedding 量化为 Semantic ID，再用 Transformer 解码下一个 item 的 Semantic ID。

q_en: What is TransAct, in one sentence?
q_zh: TransAct 一句话是什么？
gold_en: TransAct V2 adds lifelong sequences and a next-action loss to Pinterest's Homefeed ranker; the A/B lifted repin volume +6.35% and cut hides -12.80%.
gold_zh: TransAct V2 为首页排序器加入终身行为序列和下一动作损失；A/B 转发量 +6.35%、隐藏量 -12.80%。

q_en: Who built TransAct and where does it run?
q_zh: TransAct 是谁做的，用在哪里？
gold_en: TransAct comes from Pinterest, 2023. Deployed in: Pinterest Homefeed ranking, serving production traffic.
gold_zh: TransAct 来自 Pinterest，2023 年。上线位置：Pinterest 首页信息流排序，服务生产流量。

q_en: What is the core idea of TransAct?
q_zh: TransAct 的核心思路是什么？
gold_en: Anchor nearest-neighbor search on each candidate to mine lifelong, real-time and impression sequences, and add a next-action loss so one small transformer serves both ranking and behavior forecasting.
gold_zh: 用候选锚定的最近邻检索挖掘终身、实时和曝光序列，并加下一动作损失，让一个小 transformer 同时服务排序和行为预测。

q_en: What results does TransAct report?
q_zh: TransAct 报告了哪些结果？
gold_en: Online A/B, Table 3, each group at 1.5% of Homefeed visitors against the production TransAct with real-time sequences: TransAct V2 lifts Homefeed Repin Volume +6.35%, reduces Homefeed Hide Volume -12.80%, improves Impression Diversity +0.45% and Time Spent on App +1.41%; the note states that a 1% increase in repin volume is considered a substantial gain. Offline, Table 2, HIT@3 over repin: BST +6.04%, TransAct real-time +7.74%, adding in-batch NAL +8.41%, impression NAL +8.92%, and TransAct V2 with real-time, lifelong sequences and impression NAL +13.31%, while HIT@3 over hide falls -11.25% for V2 against -6.86% for the real-time TransAct. NAL ablation, Table 4: impression-based negatives reach +1.10% repin and -2.39% hide against +0.63% and -1.90% for in-batch. Serving ablations: the fused dequantization and NN search kernel cut model latency 20% against native PyTorch; the Single Kernel Unified Transformer reaches 85.09% lower latency and 13.24% less GPU memory at sequence length 192, with latency decreases from -59.29% at length 64 to -84.79% at 256 and -73.10% at 2048; copy time improves 85% at batch 128, 82% at 256 and 85% at 512; model run latency falls 75%, 75% and 81% at batches 128, 256 and 512; end-to-end inference latency improves 103x at p50, 338x at p90 and 250x at p99, with batch preparation 5x faster and queuing delay reduced about 1300x; the pinned memory arena alone adds up to 35% inference speed in the final setup.
gold_zh: 线上 A/B，表 3，每组 1.5% 首页访客，基线为带实时序列的生产 TransAct：TransAct V2 使首页转发量 +6.35%、首页隐藏量 -12.80%、曝光多样性 +0.45%、应用时长 +1.41%；表注说明转发量提升 1% 即被视为显著收益。离线见表 2，HIT@3/repin：BST +6.04%、实时 TransAct +7.74%、加批内 NAL +8.41%、加曝光 NAL +8.92%、带实时加终身序列加曝光 NAL 的 TransAct V2 达 +13.31%，同时 HIT@3/hide 下降 -11.25%，实时 TransAct 为 -6.86%。NAL 消融见表 4：曝光负样本达到 repin +1.10%、hide -2.39%，批内负样本为 +0.63% 和 -1.90%。服务消融：融合反量化与 NN 检索核较原生 PyTorch 降低模型延迟 20%；单核统一 transformer 在序列长度 192 时延迟低 85.09%、GPU 显存少 13.24%，长度 64 到 2048 的延迟降幅从 -59.29% 到 -84.79% 再到 -73.10%；批 128、256、512 的拷贝时间分别改善 85%、82%、85%；模型运行延迟在批 128、256、512 分别下降 75%、75%、81%；端到端推理延迟 p50 提升 103 倍、p90 提升 338 倍、p99 提升 250 倍，批处理加速 5 倍、排队延迟约降 1300 倍；固定内存竞技场在最终配置中带来最高 35% 的推理提速。

q_en: Does TransAct have online evidence, and how long was the A/B?
q_zh: TransAct 有线上证据吗，A/B 做了多久？
gold_en: Online evidence: Online numbers. A/B duration: not reported. A/B traffic: 1.5% of Homefeed page visitors per group.
gold_zh: 线上证据：有线上数据。A/B 时长：未报告。A/B 流量：每组 1.5% 的首页访客。

q_en: What should I keep in mind when reading the results of TransAct?
q_zh: 读 TransAct 的结果时要注意什么？
gold_en: The paper notes that TWIN is not compared because it relies on a computationally expensive offline inference system, and BERT4Rec-style models are omitted due to differences in problem formulation. The offline evaluation metric HIT@3 is a Pinterest-internal ranking metric computed over recommendation chunks.
gold_zh: 论文说明 TWIN 因依赖昂贵的离线推理系统而未比较，BERT4Rec 类模型因问题设定不同而未直接比较。 离线指标 HIT@3 是 Pinterest 内部按推荐 chunk 计算的排序指标。

q_en: What serving latency, QPS, cost or hardware does TransAct report?
q_zh: TransAct 报告了怎样的服务延迟、QPS、成本和硬件？
gold_en: Serving latency: p99 over one-minute windows in an environment of 29,000 examples per second per host; end-to-end inference latency improves 103x at p50, 338x at p90 and 250x at p99 over the unoptimized baseline; SKUT latency -85.09% at sequence length 192. Serving QPS: 29,000 examples per second per host in the serving evaluation. Inference cost: Request-level deduplication cuts PCIe transfers of sequence features 8x; the fused transformer is 6.6 times faster than PyTorch; copy time falls 85% at batch 128. Hardware: NVIDIA A10G GPUs with 8 MB shared memory.
gold_zh: 服务延迟：每主机每秒 29,000 样本环境下按一分钟窗口的 p99 评估；端到端推理延迟较未优化基线 p50 提升 103 倍、p90 提升 338 倍、p99 提升 250 倍；SKUT 在序列长度 192 延迟低 85.09%。 服务 QPS：服务评估中每主机每秒 29,000 个样本。 推理成本：请求级去重使序列特征 PCIe 传输降 8 倍；融合 transformer 比 PyTorch 快 6.6 倍；批 128 拷贝时间降 85%。 硬件：NVIDIA A10G GPU，8 MB 共享内存。

q_en: How is TransAct trained?
q_zh: TransAct 是怎么训练的？
gold_en: Training mode: Offline training from scratch on two weeks of Homefeed logs, evaluated on data collected 7 days after the training window. Objectives: Multi-head cross-entropy of the CTR model; Next-action loss: sampled softmax between the user embedding and the PinSage embedding of the next engaged Pin against in-batch or impression-based negatives.
gold_zh: 训练方式：两周首页日志上从零离线训练，评估集取训练窗口结束后第 7 天的数据。 训练目标：CTR 模型的多头交叉熵；下一动作损失：用户嵌入与下一正向互动 Pin 的 PinSage 嵌入对批内或曝光负样本的 sampled softmax。

q_zh: DoorDash homepage ranking 有线上证据吗，A/B 做了多久？
gold_en: Online evidence: Online, no figures. A/B duration: not reported. A/B traffic: not reported.
gold_zh: 线上证据：有线上描述，无具体数字。A/B 时长：未报告。A/B 流量：未报告。

q_en: What should I keep in mind when reading the results of DoorDash homepage ranking?
